 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m (pre-filtered to screen_name LIKE 'ptl%'); dated on event_date (UTC); grain user x interval x Browsing Live status x the global experiment phase (days on or after the first-ever allocation to arms 17/18, 36/37 and 44/45 across all users). Step flags are evaluated within each such part, so steps split across a part boundary do not combine. Arms: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (deleted = 'false', variant_id 17/18/36/37/44/45, created in epoch microseconds). Region: mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners. PTL segment: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (demand_status = 'FULFILLED', ptl_trip_rank). FTL segment: mp_analytics_core.fact_demands (trip_flag = 1, load_type = 'FTL').
 Filters: Interval (Day / Week / Month = date_trunc of event_date; blank = one Total row dated current_date). Lookback: event_date <= current_date and >= current_date - last_n_days if set, else Day 14 days, Week 14 weeks, Month 12 months, blank 14 days. Split: Overall / Cx Segment PTL (New = no fulfilled PTL trip or first event in the row at or before the 1st trip demand_time; 1-3 = at or before the 3rd; else 3+) / Cx Segment FTL (same rule on FTL trips ranked by demand_time) / Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region; consigners without a region are dropped) / Exp Type (Test1 - 17 SHOW_PTL, Control1 - 18 DISABLE_PTL, Control2 - 36 PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW, Test2 - 37 PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW, Browsing Control - 44 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT, Browsing Test - 45 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2; Other = no allocation; a user in several arms is counted under each) / Platform (event_platform of the home-page events, else of any event: Android / Ios / Other) / Upgrade Flag (home-page app_version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, web / mweb >= 240; blank or debug builds = Not Upgraded) / Browsing Live Status (event day on or after the user's own first allocation to arm 44 or 45). Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type (users allocated to any selected arm), exclude_exp_type (drops users allocated to any selected arm), experiment_timeline (per arm: keeps a user's row only if the user is in that arm and the first event timestamp in the row is strictly after the user's own allocation timestamp for that arm; Test2 - 37 and Control2 - 36 also require Upgrade Flag = 1), consigner_region, platform, Version (numeric app_version of the home-page events, else of any event, >= value) and Upgrade_flag. Dashboard: PTL : Overview (2938) > Product Funnel > card 51565
 
 Aliases: home to price check %.
 
 Share of PTL home-page users in the interval who also fired step 03 (Price Check Requested) and every earlier step 02..02 in the same interval; steps are cumulative.
 Formula: count(distinct user_code where landed_flag = 1 and MAX(step 02 flag) x ... x MAX(step 03 flag) = 1) * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(distinct user_code where landed_flag = 1), 0), per interval x split.
 Steps the user must fire (all within the same interval part; order and session are not checked):
 01. Home Page (base, landed_flag): any event with screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%'.
 02. Lane Entered: screen_name = 'ptl_pincode_input', OR event_name IN ('v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate') on screen ptl_select_transporter / ptl_select_transporter_per_kg / ptl_service_type_input.
 03. Price Check Requested: v1_ptl_submit on ptl_select_transporter / ptl_select_transporter_per_kg / ptl_service_type_input with COALESCE(miscellaneous,'') NOT ILIKE '%tpt:%' (payload st: = rate-API request), OR event_name IN ('v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate') on any PTL screen.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m (pre-filtered to screen_name LIKE 'ptl%'); dated on event_date (UTC); grain user x interval x Browsing Live status x the global experiment phase (days on or after the first-ever allocation to arms 17/18, 36/37 and 44/45 across all users). Step flags are evaluated within each such part, so steps split across a part boundary do not combine. Arms: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (deleted = 'false', variant_id 17/18/36/37/44/45, created in epoch microseconds). Region: mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners. PTL segment: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (demand_status = 'FULFILLED', ptl_trip_rank). FTL segment: mp_analytics_core.fact_demands (trip_flag = 1, load_type = 'FTL').
 Filters: Interval (Day / Week / Month = date_trunc of event_date; blank = one Total row dated current_date). Lookback: event_date <= current_date and >= current_date - last_n_days if set, else Day 14 days, Week 14 weeks, Month 12 months, blank 14 days. Split: Overall / Cx Segment PTL (New = no fulfilled PTL trip or first event in the row at or before the 1st trip demand_time; 1-3 = at or before the 3rd; else 3+) / Cx Segment FTL (same rule on FTL trips ranked by demand_time) / Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region; consigners without a region are dropped) / Exp Type (Test1 - 17 SHOW_PTL, Control1 - 18 DISABLE_PTL, Control2 - 36 PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW, Test2 - 37 PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW, Browsing Control - 44 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT, Browsing Test - 45 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2; Other = no allocation; a user in several arms is counted under each) / Platform (event_platform of the home-page events, else of any event: Android / Ios / Other) / Upgrade Flag (home-page app_version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, web / mweb >= 240; blank or debug builds = Not Upgraded) / Browsing Live Status (event day on or after the user's own first allocation to arm 44 or 45). Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type (users allocated to any selected arm), exclude_exp_type (drops users allocated to any selected arm), experiment_timeline (per arm: keeps a user's row only if the user is in that arm and the first event timestamp in the row is strictly after the user's own allocation timestamp for that arm; Test2 - 37 and Control2 - 36 also require Upgrade Flag = 1), consigner_region, platform, Version (numeric app_version of the home-page events, else of any event, >= value) and Upgrade_flag. Output: interval, split_part and the value, ordered by interval descending, limit 280 rows.

Numerator and denominator both apply every filter and the split, and both require landed_flag = 1. App and consigner web only; web portal users (blank user_code) are not counted. Because users who saw rates (v1_ptl_rates / v1_ptl_estimate_rate) also qualify, step 03 closely tracks step 04 (Rates Shown).

  SELECT
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (17,18) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS exp1_start,

  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 ),

  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 ev AS (
  SELECT a.user_code,
  (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', a.event_date) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', a.event_date) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', a.event_date) else current_date::timestamp end) AS interval,
  CASE WHEN t.browsing_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.browsing_live_date
  THEN 'Browsing Live' ELSE 'Browsing Not Live' END AS browsing_live_status,
  (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.exp1_start::date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.exp2_start::date THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.browsing_start::date THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) AS exp_phase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS landed_flag,

  CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''

 01. Home Page (base, landed_flag): any event with screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%'.
 02. Lane Entered: screen_name = 'ptl_pincode_input', OR event_name IN ('v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate') on screen ptl_select_transporter / ptl_select_transporter_per_kg / ptl_service_type_input.
 03. Price Check Requested: v1_ptl_submit on ptl_select_transporter / ptl_select_transporter_per_kg / ptl_service_type_input with COALESCE(miscellaneous,'') NOT ILIKE '%tpt:%' (payload st: = rate-API request), OR event_name IN ('v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate') on any PTL screen.
 04. Rates Shown: event_name IN ('v1_ptl_estimate_rate','v1_ptl_rates') on any PTL screen.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m (pre-filtered to screen_name LIKE 'ptl%'); dated on event_date (UTC); grain user x interval x Browsing Live status x the global experiment phase (days on or after the first-ever allocation to arms 17/18, 36/37 and 44/45 across all users). Step flags are evaluated within each such part, so steps split across a part boundary do not combine. Arms: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (deleted = 'false', variant_id 17/18/36/37/44/45, created in epoch microseconds). Region: mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners. PTL segment: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (demand_status = 'FULFILLED', ptl_trip_rank). FTL segment: mp_analytics_core.fact_demands (trip_flag = 1, load_type = 'FTL').
 Filters: Interval (Day / Week / Month = date_trunc of event_date; blank = one Total row dated current_date). Lookback: event_date <= current_date and >= current_date - last_n_days if set, else Day 14 days, Week 14 weeks, Month 12 months, blank 14 days. Split: Overall / Cx Segment PTL (New = no fulfilled PTL trip or first event in the row at or before the 1st trip demand_time; 1-3 = at or before the 3rd; else 3+) / Cx Segment FTL (same rule on FTL trips ranked by demand_time) / Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region; consigners without a region are dropped) / Exp Type (Test1 - 17 SHOW_PTL, Control1 - 18 DISABLE_PTL, Control2 - 36 PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW, Test2 - 37 PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW, Browsing Control - 44 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT, Browsing Test - 45 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2; Other = no allocation; a user in several arms is counted under each) / Platform (event_platform of the home-page events, else of any event: Android / Ios / Other) / Upgrade Flag (home-page app_version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, web / mweb >= 240; blank or debug builds = Not Upgraded) / Browsing Live Status (event day on or after the user's own first allocation to arm 44 or 45). Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type (users allocated to any selected arm), exclude_exp_type (drops users allocated to any selected arm), experiment_timeline (per arm: keeps a user's row if the user is in that arm and any event in the row falls on or after the user's own allocation date for that arm; Test2 - 37 and Control2 - 36 also require Upgrade Flag = 1), consigner_region, platform, Version (numeric app_version of the home-page events, else of any event, >= value) and Upgrade_flag. SQL:
-- PTL Product Funnel (clickstream fact_cx_events_l12m). Base = users who landed on ptl_home_page in the interval.
 -- Step 4 (CUMULATIVE): user must reach stages 02..04 in the same interval -> funnel can never increase
 -- Browsing Live/Not Live is mapped at DAY level against each user's own allocation date (config 44/45),
 -- then rolled up to the selected Interval, so Day / Week / Month all read correctly.
 WITH exp_start AS (
  -- Live start of each experiment = first allocation timestamp of its arms
  SELECT
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (17,18) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS exp1_start,
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (36,37) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS exp2_start,
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (44,45) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS browsing_start
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 ),
 exp_time AS (
  SELECT user_code,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(created)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_live_date
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 exp_arm AS (
  -- per-user, per-arm enrollment dates (user + config_id grain)
  SELECT user_code,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=17 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS test1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=18 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS control1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=36 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS control2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=37 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS test2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=44 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_control_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=45 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_test_enrolled_at
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 ev AS (
  SELECT a.user_code,
  (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', a.event_date) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', a.event_date) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', a.event_date) else current_date::timestamp end) AS interval,
  CASE WHEN t.browsing_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.browsing_live_date
  THEN 'Browsing Live' ELSE 'Browsing Not Live' END AS browsing_live_status,
  (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.exp1_start::date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.exp2_start::date THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.browsing_start::date THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) AS exp_phase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS landed_flag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_pincode_input' OR (a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg','ptl_service_type_input') AND a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN ((a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg','ptl_service_type_input') AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit' AND COALESCE(a.miscellaneous,'') NOT ILIKE '%tpt:%') OR a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_estimate_rate','v1_ptl_rates') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS step_flag,
  MIN(a.min_timestamp) AS min_timestamp,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN a.event_platform END),
  MAX(a.event_platform)) AS event_platform,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN
  CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN 0
  WHEN a.event_platform = 'android' AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 1770 THEN 1
  WHEN a.event_platform = 'ios' AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 1080 THEN 1
  WHEN a.event_platform IN ('web','mweb') AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 240 THEN 1
  ELSE 0 END END), 0) AS upgrade_flag,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN
  CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) END END),
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) END)) AS app_version_num,
  -- per-arm live flags: event day is on/after that user's OWN allocation date for that exact arm
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.test1_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.test1_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test1_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.control1_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.control1_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control1_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.control2_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.control2_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control2_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.test2_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.test2_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test2_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.browsing_control_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.browsing_control_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_control_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.browsing_test_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.browsing_test_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_test_live
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m a
  LEFT JOIN exp_time t ON t.user_code = a.user_code
  LEFT JOIN exp_arm ea ON ea.user_code = a.user_code
  CROSS JOIN exp_start s
  WHERE a.event_date::date <= current_date
  AND a.screen_name LIKE 'ptl%' -- PTL screens only (perf)
  AND a.event_date::date >= coalesce([[current_date - {{last_n_days}},]] CASE
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Day' THEN current_date - interval '14 days'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Week' THEN current_date - interval '14 weeks'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Month' THEN current_date - interval '12 months'
  ELSE current_date - interval '14 days' END)
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
 ),
 seg AS (
  SELECT consigner_user_code,
  MIN(CASE WHEN ptl_trip_rank = 1 THEN demand_time END) AS first_trip_time,
  MIN(CASE WHEN ptl_trip_rank = 3 THEN demand_time END) AS third_trip_time
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED'
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 exp AS (
  SELECT user_code,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 17 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 36 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 37 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 44 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_control,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_test
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 reg AS (
  SELECT consigner_user_code, MAX(consigner_region) AS consigner_region
  FROM mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 final AS (
  SELECT ev.interval,
  CASE {{split}}
  WHEN 'Cx Segment PTL' THEN (CASE
  WHEN bb.first_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.first_trip_time THEN 'New'
  WHEN bb.third_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.third_trip_time THEN '1-3'
  ELSE '3+' END)
 when 'Cx Segment FTL' then (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New' when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  WHEN 'Consigner Region' THEN COALESCE(r.consigner_region, 'OTHER')
  WHEN 'Exp Type' THEN COALESCE(el.exp_label, 'Other')::varchar
  WHEN 'Platform' THEN (CASE WHEN ev.event_platform = 'android' THEN 'Android'
  WHEN ev.event_platform = 'ios' THEN 'Ios' ELSE 'Other' END)
  WHEN 'Upgrade Flag' THEN (CASE WHEN ev.upgrade_flag = 1 THEN 'Upgraded' ELSE 'Not Upgraded' END)
  WHEN 'Browsing Live Status' THEN ev.browsing_live_status::varchar
  ELSE 'Overall'
  END AS split_part,
  ev.user_code,
  ev.step_flag AS searched
  FROM ev
  LEFT JOIN seg bb ON bb.consigner_user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN exp c ON c.user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT user_code,
  CASE variant_id
  WHEN 17 THEN 'Test1 - 17' WHEN 18 THEN 'Control1 - 18'
  WHEN 36 THEN 'Control2 - 36' WHEN 37 THEN 'Test2 - 37'
  WHEN 44 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' WHEN 45 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45'
  END AS exp_label
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1,2
  ) el ON el.user_code = ev.user_code
  AND {{split}} = 'Exp Type'
  [[ AND el.exp_label IN ({{exp_type}}) ]]
 [[and (el.exp_label IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})) is not true]]
  LEFT JOIN reg r ON r.consigner_user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN (
 Select consigner_user_code as ftl_cuc,
 min(case when rn = 1 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_first_trip_time,
 min(case when rn = 3 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_third_trip_time

 Select consigner_user_code, demand_time,

 )
 group by 1
 ) as ftl_seg on ftl_seg.ftl_cuc = ev.user_code
 WHERE ev.landed_flag = 1
  [[ AND (CASE
  WHEN bb.first_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.first_trip_time THEN 'New'
  WHEN bb.third_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.third_trip_time THEN '1-3'
  ELSE '3+' END) IN ({{cx_segment_ptl}}) ]]
 [[and (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New'

  (CASE WHEN c.test1 = 1 THEN 'Test1 - 17' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control1 = 1 THEN 'Control1 - 18' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})

  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_test = 1 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.test1,0)+COALESCE(c.control1,0)+COALESCE(c.control2,0)+COALESCE(c.test2,0)
  +COALESCE(c.browsing_control,0)+COALESCE(c.browsing_test,0) = 0
  THEN 'Other' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  ) ]]

  (CASE WHEN c.test1 = 1 THEN 'Test1 - 17' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control1 = 1 THEN 'Control1 - 18' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control2 = 1 THEN 'Control2 - 36' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.test2 = 1 THEN 'Test2 - 37' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})

  OR (CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.test1,0)+COALESCE(c.control1,0)+COALESCE(c.control2,0)+COALESCE(c.test2,0)
  +COALESCE(c.browsing_control,0)+COALESCE(c.browsing_test,0) = 0
  THEN 'Other' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  )) is not true]]
  [[and (
  -- Experiment Timeline: per-user, per-arm. Each arm pairs with that user's OWN

  ('Test1 - 17' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test1 = 1 and ev.test1_live = 1)
  or ('Control1 - 18' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control1 = 1 and ev.control1_live = 1)
  or ('Test2 - 37' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test2 = 1 and ev.test2_live = 1

  or ('Control2 - 36' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control2 = 1 and ev.control2_live = 1

 )]]
  [[ AND r.consigner_region IN ({{consigner_region}}) ]]

  [[ AND ev.app_version_num >= {{Version}} ]]

-- PTL Product Funnel (clickstream fact_cx_events_l12m). Base = users who landed on ptl_home_page in the interval.
 -- Step 4 (CUMULATIVE): user must reach stages 02..04 in the same interval -> funnel can never increase
 -- Browsing Live/Not Live is mapped at DAY level against each user's own allocation date (config 44/45),
 -- then rolled up to the selected Interval, so Day / Week / Month all read correctly.
 WITH exp_start AS (
  -- Live start of each experiment = first allocation timestamp of its arms
  SELECT
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (17,18) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS exp1_start,
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (36,37) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS exp2_start,
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (44,45) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS browsing_start
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 ),
 exp_time AS (
  SELECT user_code,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(created)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_live_date
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 ev AS (
  SELECT a.user_code,
  (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', a.event_date) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', a.event_date) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', a.event_date) else current_date::timestamp end) AS interval,
  CASE WHEN t.browsing_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.browsing_live_date
  THEN 'Browsing Live' ELSE 'Browsing Not Live' END AS browsing_live_status,
  (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.exp1_start::date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.exp2_start::date THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.browsing_start::date THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) AS exp_phase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS landed_flag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_pincode_input' OR (a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg','ptl_service_type_input') AND a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN ((a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg','ptl_service_type_input') AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit' AND COALESCE(a.miscellaneous,'') NOT ILIKE '%tpt:%') OR a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_estimate_rate','v1_ptl_rates') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS step_flag,
  MIN(a.min_timestamp) AS min_timestamp,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN a.event_platform END),
  MAX(a.event_platform)) AS event_platform,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN
  CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN 0
  WHEN a.event_platform = 'android' AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 1770 THEN 1
  WHEN a.event_platform = 'ios' AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 1080 THEN 1
  WHEN a.event_platform IN ('web','mweb') AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 240 THEN 1
  ELSE 0 END END), 0) AS upgrade_flag,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN
  CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) END END),
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) END)) AS app_version_num
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m a
  LEFT JOIN exp_time t ON t.user_code = a.user_code
  CROSS JOIN exp_start s
  WHERE a.event_date::date <= current_date
  AND a.screen_name LIKE 'ptl%' -- PTL screens only (perf)
  AND a.event_date::date >= coalesce([[current_date - {{last_n_days}},]] CASE
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Day' THEN current_date - interval '14 days'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Week' THEN current_date - interval '14 weeks'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Month' THEN current_date - interval '12 months'
  ELSE current_date - interval '14 days' END)
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
 ),
 seg AS (
  SELECT consigner_user_code,
  MIN(CASE WHEN ptl_trip_rank = 1 THEN demand_time END) AS first_trip_time,
  MIN(CASE WHEN ptl_trip_rank = 3 THEN demand_time END) AS third_trip_time
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED'
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 exp AS (
  SELECT user_code,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 17 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 36 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 37 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 44 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_control,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_test,
  -- per-user, per-arm enrollment timestamps (user+config_id grain)
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=17 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS test1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=18 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS control1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=36 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS control2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=37 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS test2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=44 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS browsing_control_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=45 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') AS browsing_test_enrolled_at
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 reg AS (
  SELECT consigner_user_code, MAX(consigner_region) AS consigner_region
  FROM mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 final AS (
  SELECT ev.interval,
  CASE {{split}}
  WHEN 'Cx Segment PTL' THEN (CASE
  WHEN bb.first_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.first_trip_time THEN 'New'
  WHEN bb.third_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.third_trip_time THEN '1-3'
  ELSE '3+' END)
 when 'Cx Segment FTL' then (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New' when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  WHEN 'Consigner Region' THEN COALESCE(r.consigner_region, 'OTHER')
  WHEN 'Exp Type' THEN COALESCE(el.exp_label, 'Other')::varchar
  WHEN 'Platform' THEN (CASE WHEN ev.event_platform = 'android' THEN 'Android'
  WHEN ev.event_platform = 'ios' THEN 'Ios' ELSE 'Other' END)
  WHEN 'Upgrade Flag' THEN (CASE WHEN ev.upgrade_flag = 1 THEN 'Upgraded' ELSE 'Not Upgraded' END)
  WHEN 'Browsing Live Status' THEN ev.browsing_live_status::varchar
  ELSE 'Overall'
  END AS split_part,
  ev.user_code,
  ev.step_flag AS searched
  FROM ev
  LEFT JOIN seg bb ON bb.consigner_user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN exp c ON c.user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT user_code,
  CASE variant_id
  WHEN 17 THEN 'Test1 - 17' WHEN 18 THEN 'Control1 - 18'
  WHEN 36 THEN 'Control2 - 36' WHEN 37 THEN 'Test2 - 37'
  WHEN 44 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' WHEN 45 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45'
  END AS exp_label
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1,2
  ) el ON el.user_code = ev.user_code
  AND {{split}} = 'Exp Type'
  [[ AND el.exp_label IN ({{exp_type}}) ]]
 [[and (el.exp_label IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})) is not true]]
  LEFT JOIN reg r ON r.consigner_user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN (
 Select consigner_user_code as ftl_cuc,
 min(case when rn = 1 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_first_trip_time,
 min(case when rn = 3 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_third_trip_time
 from (
 Select consigner_user_code, demand_time,
 row_number() over(partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) as rn
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_demands
 where trip_flag = 1 and load_type = 'FTL'
 )
 group by 1
 ) as ftl_seg on ftl_seg.ftl_cuc = ev.user_code
 WHERE ev.landed_flag = 1
  [[ AND (CASE
  WHEN bb.first_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.first_trip_time THEN 'New'
  WHEN bb.third_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.third_trip_time THEN '1-3'
  ELSE '3+' END) IN ({{cx_segment_ptl}}) ]]
 [[and (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New'
 when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3'
 else '3+' end) in ({{cx_segment_ftl}})]]
  [[ AND (
  (CASE WHEN c.test1 = 1 THEN 'Test1 - 17' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control1 = 1 THEN 'Control1 - 18' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control2 = 1 THEN 'Control2 - 36' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.test2 = 1 THEN 'Test2 - 37' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_control = 1 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_test = 1 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.test1,0)+COALESCE(c.control1,0)+COALESCE(c.control2,0)+COALESCE(c.test2,0)
  +COALESCE(c.browsing_control,0)+COALESCE(c.browsing_test,0) = 0
  THEN 'Other' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  ) ]]
 [[and ((
  (CASE WHEN c.test1 = 1 THEN 'Test1 - 17' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control1 = 1 THEN 'Control1 - 18' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control2 = 1 THEN 'Control2 - 36' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.test2 = 1 THEN 'Test2 - 37' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_control = 1 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_test = 1 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.test1,0)+COALESCE(c.control1,0)+COALESCE(c.control2,0)+COALESCE(c.test2,0)
  +COALESCE(c.browsing_control,0)+COALESCE(c.browsing_test,0) = 0
  THEN 'Other' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  )) is not true]]
  [[and (
  -- Experiment Timeline: per-user, per-arm. Each arm pairs with that user's OWN
  -- allocation timestamp for that exact variant_id (user + config_id grain).
  ('Test1 - 17' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test1 = 1
  and c.test1_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.test1_enrolled_at)
  or ('Control1 - 18' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control1 = 1
  and c.control1_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.control1_enrolled_at)
  or ('Test2 - 37' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test2 = 1
  and c.test2_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.test2_enrolled_at
  and ev.upgrade_flag = 1) -- min app version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, Web >= 240
  or ('Control2 - 36' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control2 = 1
  and c.control2_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.control2_enrolled_at
  and ev.upgrade_flag = 1) -- min app version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, Web >= 240
  or ('Browsing Test - 45' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_test = 1
  and c.browsing_test_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.browsing_test_enrolled_at)
  or ('Browsing Control - 44' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_control = 1
  and c.browsing_control_enrolled_at is not null and (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') > c.browsing_control_enrolled_at)
 )]]
  [[ AND r.consigner_region IN ({{consigner_region}}) ]]
  [[ AND (CASE WHEN ev.event_platform = 'android' THEN 'Android'
  WHEN ev.event_platform = 'ios' THEN 'Ios' ELSE 'Other' END) IN ({{platform}}) ]]
  [[ AND ev.app_version_num >= {{Version}} ]]
  [[ AND ev.upgrade_flag = {{Upgrade_flag}} ]]
 )
 SELECT interval,
  split_part,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN searched = 1 THEN user_code END) * 100.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_code), 0) AS "% Home to 04. Rates Shown"
 FROM final
 WHERE split_part <> 'OTHER'
 GROUP BY 1,2
 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2
 LIMIT 280

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL : Overview (2938) > Product Funnel > card 51316
 
 Aliases: home to package details %.
 
 Share of PTL home-page users in the interval who also fired step 05 (Package Details) and every earlier step 02..04 in the same interval; steps are cumulative.
 Formula: count(distinct user_code where landed_flag = 1 and MAX(step 02 flag) x ... x MAX(step 05 flag) = 1) * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(distinct user_code where landed_flag = 1), 0), per interval x split.
 Steps the user must fire (all within the same interval part; order and session are not checked):
 01. Home Page (base, landed_flag): any event with screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%'.
 02. Lane Entered: screen_name = 'ptl_pincode_input', OR event_name IN ('v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate') on screen ptl_select_transporter / ptl_select_transporter_per_kg / ptl_service_type_input.
 03. Price Check Requested: v1_ptl_submit on ptl_select_transporter / ptl_select_transporter_per_kg / ptl_service_type_input with COALESCE(miscellaneous,'') NOT ILIKE '%tpt:%' (payload st: = rate-API request), OR event_name IN ('v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate') on any PTL screen.
 04. Rates Shown: event_name IN ('v1_ptl_estimate_rate','v1_ptl_rates') on any PTL screen.
 05. Package Details: v1_ptl_package_details on ptl_package_details_input (payload carries pcid, so it follows the price check).
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m (pre-filtered to screen_name LIKE 'ptl%'); dated on event_date (UTC); grain user x interval x Browsing Live status x the user's own experiment phase (days on or after that user's first allocation to arms 17/18, 36/37 and 44/45) x per-arm live flags (event day on or after the user's own allocation date for each of arms 17/18/36/37/44/45). Step flags are evaluated within each such part, so steps split across a part boundary do not combine. Arms: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (deleted = 'false', variant_id 17/18/36/37/44/45, created in epoch microseconds). Region: mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners. PTL segment: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (demand_status = 'FULFILLED', ptl_trip_rank). FTL segment: mp_analytics_core.fact_demands (trip_flag = 1, load_type = 'FTL').
 Filters: Interval (Day / Week / Month = date_trunc of event_date; blank = one Total row dated current_date). Lookback: event_date <= current_date and >= current_date - last_n_days if set, else Day 14 days, Week 14 weeks, Month 12 months, blank 14 days. Split: Overall / Cx Segment PTL (New = no fulfilled PTL trip or first event in the row at or before the 1st trip demand_time; 1-3 = at or before the 3rd; else 3+) / Cx Segment FTL (same rule on FTL trips ranked by demand_time) / Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region; consigners without a region are dropped) / Exp Type (Test1 - 17 SHOW_PTL, Control1 - 18 DISABLE_PTL, Control2 - 36 PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW, Test2 - 37 PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW, Browsing Control - 44 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT, Browsing Test - 45 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2; Other = no allocation; a user in several arms is counted under each) / Platform (event_platform of the home-page events, else of any event: Android / Ios / Other) / Upgrade Flag (home-page app_version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, web / mweb >= 240; blank or debug builds = Not Upgraded) / Browsing Live Status (event day on or after the user's own first allocation to arm 44 or 45). Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type (users allocated to any selected arm), exclude_exp_type (drops users allocated to any selected arm), experiment_timeline (per arm: keeps only the user's events on days on or after the user's own allocation date for that arm; Test2 - 37 and Control2 - 36 also require Upgrade Flag = 1), consigner_region, platform, Version (numeric app_version of the home-page events, else of any event, >= value) and Upgrade_flag. Output: interval, split_part and the value, ordered by interval descending, limit 280 rows.
 Caveats: Steps are a set within the interval part, not time-ordered or session-bound, so each step count is a subset of the earlier steps' counts. Numerator and denominator both apply every filter and the split, and both require landed_flag = 1. App and consigner web only; web portal users (blank user_code) are not counted. Booking-flow events start around 22 May 2026, so earlier months read 0.

-- PTL Product Funnel (clickstream fact_cx_events_l12m). Base = users who landed on ptl_home_page in the interval.
 -- Step 5 (CUMULATIVE): user must reach stages 02..05 in the same interval -> funnel can never increase
 -- Browsing Live/Not Live is mapped at DAY level against each user's own allocation date (config 44/45),
 -- then rolled up to the selected Interval, so Day / Week / Month all read correctly.
 WITH exp_time AS (
  -- per-user enrollment dates (user_enrolled_at) for each experiment
  SELECT user_code,
  -- per-user, per-arm enrollment dates (user+config_id grain)
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id = 17 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS test1_live_date,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id = 18 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS control1_live_date,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id = 36 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS control2_live_date,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id = 37 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS test2_live_date,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id = 44 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_control_live_date,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id = 45 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_test_live_date,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (17,18) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS exp1_live_date,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (36,37) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS exp2_live_date,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (44,45) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_live_date
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),

  SELECT a.user_code,
  (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', a.event_date) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', a.event_date) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', a.event_date) else current_date::timestamp end) AS interval,
  CASE WHEN t.browsing_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.browsing_live_date
  THEN 'Browsing Live' ELSE 'Browsing Not Live' END AS browsing_live_status,
  (CASE WHEN t.exp1_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.exp1_live_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN t.exp2_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.exp2_live_date THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN t.browsing_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.browsing_live_date THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) AS exp_phase,
  -- per-user, per-arm live window flags (user+config_id grain)
  (CASE WHEN t.test1_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.test1_live_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test1_live,
  (CASE WHEN t.control1_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.control1_live_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control1_live,
  (CASE WHEN t.control2_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.control2_live_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control2_live,
  (CASE WHEN t.test2_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.test2_live_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test2_live,
  (CASE WHEN t.browsing_control_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.browsing_control_live_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_control_live,
  (CASE WHEN t.browsing_test_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.browsing_test_live_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_test_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS landed_flag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_pincode_input' OR (a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg','ptl_service_type_input') AND a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN ((a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg','ptl_service_type_input') AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit' AND COALESCE(a.miscellaneous,'') NOT ILIKE '%tpt:%') OR a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_estimate_rate','v1_ptl_rates') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_package_details_input' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_package_details') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS step_flag,
  MIN(a.min_timestamp) AS min_timestamp,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN a.event_platform END),
  MAX(a.event_platform)) AS event_platform,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN
  CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN 0
  WHEN a.event_platform = 'android' AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 1770 THEN 1
  WHEN a.event_platform = 'ios' AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 1080 THEN 1
  WHEN a.event_platform IN ('web','mweb') AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 240 THEN 1
  ELSE 0 END END), 0) AS upgrade_flag,

Step flags are evaluated within each such part, so steps split across a part boundary do not combine. Arms: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (deleted = 'false', variant_id 17/18/36/37/44/45, created in epoch microseconds). Region: mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners. Lookback: event_date <= current_date and >= current_date - last_n_days if set, else Day 14 days, Week 14 weeks, Month 12 months, blank 14 days. Split: Overall / Cx Segment PTL (New = no fulfilled PTL trip or first event in the row at or before the 1st trip demand_time; 1-3 = at or before the 3rd; else 3+) / Cx Segment FTL (same rule on FTL trips ranked by demand_time) / Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region; consigners without a region are dropped) / Exp Type (Test1 - 17 SHOW_PTL, Control1 - 18 DISABLE_PTL, Control2 - 36 PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW, Test2 - 37 PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW, Browsing Control - 44 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT, Browsing Test - 45 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2; Other = no allocation; a user in several arms is counted under each) / Platform (event_platform of the home-page events, else of any event: Android / Ios / Other) / Upgrade Flag (home-page app_version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, web / mweb >= 240; blank or debug builds = Not Upgraded) / Browsing Live Status (event day on or after the user's own first allocation to arm 44 or 45). Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL : Overview (2938) > Product Funnel > card 51569
 
 Aliases: home to package submitted %.
 
 Share of PTL home-page users in the interval who also fired step 06 (Package Details Submitted) and every earlier step 02..05 in the same interval; steps are cumulative.
 Formula: count(distinct user_code where landed_flag = 1 and MAX(step 02 flag) x ... x MAX(step 06 flag) = 1) * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(distinct user_code where landed_flag = 1), 0), per interval x split.
 Steps the user must fire (all within the same interval part; order and session are not checked):
 01. Home Page (base, landed_flag): any event with screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%'.
 02. Lane Entered: screen_name = 'ptl_pincode_input', OR event_name IN ('v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate') on screen ptl_select_transporter / ptl_select_transporter_per_kg / ptl_service_type_input.
 03. Price Check Requested: v1_ptl_submit on ptl_select_transporter / ptl_select_transporter_per_kg / ptl_service_type_input with COALESCE(miscellaneous,'') NOT ILIKE '%tpt:%' (payload st: = rate-API request), OR event_name IN ('v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate') on any PTL screen.
 04. Rates Shown: event_name IN ('v1_ptl_estimate_rate','v1_ptl_rates') on any PTL screen.
 05. Package Details: v1_ptl_package_details on ptl_package_details_input (payload carries pcid, so it follows the price check).
 06. Package Details Submitted: v1_ptl_submit on ptl_package_details_input (payload wt / uom / lbhq: weight, LBH, quantity).
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m (pre-filtered to screen_name LIKE 'ptl%'); dated on event_date (UTC); grain user x interval x Browsing Live status x the global experiment phase (days on or after the first-ever allocation to arms 17/18, 36/37 and 44/45 across all users). Step flags are evaluated within each such part, so steps split across a part boundary do not combine. Arms: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (deleted = 'false', variant_id 17/18/36/37/44/45, created in epoch microseconds). Region: mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners. PTL segment: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (demand_status = 'FULFILLED', ptl_trip_rank). FTL segment: mp_analytics_core.fact_demands (trip_flag = 1, load_type = 'FTL').
 Filters: Interval (Day / Week / Month = date_trunc of event_date; blank = one Total row dated current_date). Lookback: event_date <= current_date and >= current_date - last_n_days if set, else Day 14 days, Week 14 weeks, Month 12 months, blank 14 days. Split: Overall / Cx Segment PTL (New = no fulfilled PTL trip or first event in the row at or before the 1st trip demand_time; 1-3 = at or before the 3rd; else 3+) / Cx Segment FTL (same rule on FTL trips ranked by demand_time) / Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region; consigners without a region are dropped) / Exp Type (Test1 - 17 SHOW_PTL, Control1 - 18 DISABLE_PTL, Control2 - 36 PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW, Test2 - 37 PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW, Browsing Control - 44 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT, Browsing Test - 45 PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2; Other = no allocation; a user in several arms is counted under each) / Platform (event_platform of the home-page events, else of any event: Android / Ios / Other) / Upgrade Flag (home-page app_version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, web / mweb >= 240; blank or debug builds = Not Upgraded) / Browsing Live Status (event day on or after the user's own first allocation to arm 44 or 45). Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type (users allocated to any selected arm), exclude_exp_type (drops users allocated to any selected arm), experiment_timeline (per arm: keeps a user's row if the user is in that arm and any event in the row falls on or after the user's own allocation date for that arm; Test2 - 37 and Control2 - 36 also require Upgrade Flag = 1), consigner_region, platform, Version (numeric app_version of the home-page events, else of any event, >= value) and Upgrade_flag. Output: interval, split_part and the value, ordered by interval descending, limit 280 rows.
 Caveats: Steps are a set within the interval part, not time-ordered or session-bound, so each step count is a subset of the earlier steps' counts. Numerator and denominator both apply every filter and the split, and both require landed_flag = 1. App and consigner web only; web portal users (blank user_code) are not counted. Booking-flow events start around 22 May 2026, so earlier months read 0.
SQL:
-- PTL Product Funnel (clickstream fact_cx_events_l12m). Base = users who landed on ptl_home_page in the interval.
 -- Step 6 (CUMULATIVE): user must reach stages 02..06 in the same interval -> funnel can never increase
 -- Browsing Live/Not Live is mapped at DAY level against each user's own allocation date (config 44/45),
 -- then rolled up to the selected Interval, so Day / Week / Month all read correctly.
 WITH exp_start AS (
  -- Live start of each experiment = first allocation timestamp of its arms
  SELECT
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (17,18) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS exp1_start,
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (36,37) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS exp2_start,
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (44,45) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS browsing_start
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 ),
 exp_time AS (
  SELECT user_code,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(created)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_live_date
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 exp_arm AS (
  -- per-user, per-arm enrollment dates (user + config_id grain)
  SELECT user_code,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=17 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS test1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=18 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS control1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=36 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS control2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=37 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS test2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=44 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_control_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=45 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_test_enrolled_at
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 ev AS (
  SELECT a.user_code,
  (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', a.event_date) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', a.event_date) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', a.event_date) else current_date::timestamp end) AS interval,
  CASE WHEN t.browsing_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.browsing_live_date
  THEN 'Browsing Live' ELSE 'Browsing Not Live' END AS browsing_live_status,
  (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.exp1_start::date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.exp2_start::date THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.browsing_start::date THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) AS exp_phase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS landed_flag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_pincode_input' OR (a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg','ptl_service_type_input') AND a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN ((a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg','ptl_service_type_input') AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit' AND COALESCE(a.miscellaneous,'') NOT ILIKE '%tpt:%') OR a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_estimate_rate','v1_ptl_rates') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_package_details_input' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_package_details') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_package_details_input' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS step_flag,
  MIN(a.min_timestamp) AS min_timestamp,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN a.event_platform END),
  MAX(a.event_platform)) AS event_platform,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN
  CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN 0
  WHEN a.event_platform = 'android' AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 1770 THEN 1
  WHEN a.event_platform = 'ios' AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 1080 THEN 1
  WHEN a.event_platform IN ('web','mweb') AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 240 THEN 1
  ELSE 0 END END), 0) AS upgrade_flag,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN
  CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) END END),
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) END)) AS app_version_num,
  -- per-arm live flags: event day is on/after that user's OWN allocation date for that exact arm
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.test1_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.test1_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test1_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.control1_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.control1_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control1_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.control2_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.control2_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control2_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.test2_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.test2_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test2_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.browsing_control_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.browsing_control_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_control_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.browsing_test_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.browsing_test_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_test_live
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m a
  LEFT JOIN exp_time t ON t.user_code = a.user_code
  LEFT JOIN exp_arm ea ON ea.user_code = a.user_code
  CROSS JOIN exp_start s
  WHERE a.event_date::date <= current_date
  AND a.screen_name LIKE 'ptl%' -- PTL screens only (perf)
  AND a.event_date::date >= coalesce([[current_date - {{last_n_days}},]] CASE
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Day' THEN current_date - interval '14 days'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Week' THEN current_date - interval '14 weeks'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Month' THEN current_date - interval '12 months'
  ELSE current_date - interval '14 days' END)
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
 ),
 seg AS (
  SELECT consigner_user_code,
  MIN(CASE WHEN ptl_trip_rank = 1 THEN demand_time END) AS first_trip_time,
  MIN(CASE WHEN ptl_trip_rank = 3 THEN demand_time END) AS third_trip_time
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED'
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 exp AS (
  SELECT user_code,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 17 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 36 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 37 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 44 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_control,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_test
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 reg AS (
  SELECT consigner_user_code, MAX(consigner_region) AS consigner_region
  FROM mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 final AS (
  SELECT ev.interval,
  CASE {{split}}
  WHEN 'Cx Segment PTL' THEN (CASE
  WHEN bb.first_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.first_trip_time THEN 'New'
  WHEN bb.third_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.third_trip_time THEN '1-3'
  ELSE '3+' END)
 when 'Cx Segment FTL' then (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New' when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  WHEN 'Consigner Region' THEN COALESCE(r.consigner_region, 'OTHER')
  WHEN 'Exp Type' THEN COALESCE(el.exp_label, 'Other')::varchar
  WHEN 'Platform' THEN (CASE WHEN ev.event_platform = 'android' THEN 'Android'
  WHEN ev.event_platform = 'ios' THEN 'Ios' ELSE 'Other' END)
  WHEN 'Upgrade Flag' THEN (CASE WHEN ev.upgrade_flag = 1 THEN 'Upgraded' ELSE 'Not Upgraded' END)
  WHEN 'Browsing Live Status' THEN ev.browsing_live_status::varchar
  ELSE 'Overall'
  END AS split_part,
  ev.user_code,
  ev.step_flag AS searched
  FROM ev
  LEFT JOIN seg bb ON bb.consigner_user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN exp c ON c.user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT user_code,
  CASE variant_id
  WHEN 17 THEN 'Test1 - 17' WHEN 18 THEN 'Control1 - 18'
  WHEN 36 THEN 'Control2 - 36' WHEN 37 THEN 'Test2 - 37'
  WHEN 44 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' WHEN 45 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45'
  END AS exp_label
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1,2
  ) el ON el.user_code = ev.user_code
  AND {{split}} = 'Exp Type'
  [[ AND el.exp_label IN ({{exp_type}}) ]]
 [[and (el.exp_label IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})) is not true]]
  LEFT JOIN reg r ON r.consigner_user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN (
 Select consigner_user_code as ftl_cuc,
 min(case when rn = 1 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_first_trip_time,
 min(case when rn = 3 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_third_trip_time
 from (
 Select consigner_user_code, demand_time,
 row_number() over(partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) as rn
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_demands
 where trip_flag = 1 and load_type = 'FTL'
 )
 group by 1
 ) as ftl_seg on ftl_seg.ftl_cuc = ev.user_code
 WHERE ev.landed_flag = 1
  [[ AND (CASE
  WHEN bb.first_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.first_trip_time THEN 'New'
  WHEN bb.third_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.third_trip_time THEN '1-3'
  ELSE '3+' END) IN ({{cx_segment_ptl}}) ]]
 [[and (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New'
 when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3'
 else '3+' end) in ({{cx_segment_ftl}})]]
  [[ AND (
  (CASE WHEN c.test1 = 1 THEN 'Test1 - 17' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control1 = 1 THEN 'Control1 - 18' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control2 = 1 THEN 'Control2 - 36' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.test2 = 1 THEN 'Test2 - 37' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_control = 1 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_test = 1 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.test1,0)+COALESCE(c.control1,0)+COALESCE(c.control2,0)+COALESCE(c.test2,0)
  +COALESCE(c.browsing_control,0)+COALESCE(c.browsing_test,0) = 0
  THEN 'Other' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  ) ]]
 [[and ((
  (CASE WHEN c.test1 = 1 THEN 'Test1 - 17' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control1 = 1 THEN 'Control1 - 18' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control2 = 1 THEN 'Control2 - 36' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.test2 = 1 THEN 'Test2 - 37' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_control = 1 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_test = 1 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.test1,0)+COALESCE(c.control1,0)+COALESCE(c.control2,0)+COALESCE(c.test2,0)
  +COALESCE(c.browsing_control,0)+COALESCE(c.browsing_test,0) = 0
  THEN 'Other' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  )) is not true]]
  [[and (
  -- Experiment Timeline: per-user, per-arm. Each arm pairs with that user's OWN

 -- Browsing Live/Not Live is mapped at DAY level against each user's own allocation date (config 44/45),
 -- then rolled up to the selected Interval, so Day / Week / Month all read correctly.
 WITH exp_start AS (
  -- Live start of each experiment = first allocation timestamp of its arms
  SELECT
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (17,18) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS exp1_start,
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (36,37) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS exp2_start,
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id IN (44,45) THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second' AS browsing_start
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 ),
 exp_time AS (
  SELECT user_code,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(created)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_live_date
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 exp_arm AS (
  -- per-user, per-arm enrollment dates (user + config_id grain)
  SELECT user_code,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=17 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS test1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=18 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS control1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=36 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS control2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=37 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS test2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=44 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_control_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(CASE WHEN variant_id=45 THEN created END)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second')::date AS browsing_test_enrolled_at
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 ev AS (
  SELECT a.user_code,
  (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', a.event_date) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', a.event_date) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', a.event_date) else current_date::timestamp end) AS interval,
  CASE WHEN t.browsing_live_date IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= t.browsing_live_date
  THEN 'Browsing Live' ELSE 'Browsing Not Live' END AS browsing_live_status,
  (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.exp1_start::date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.exp2_start::date THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN a.event_date::date >= s.browsing_start::date THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) AS exp_phase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS landed_flag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_pincode_input' OR (a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg','ptl_service_type_input') AND a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN ((a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg','ptl_service_type_input') AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit' AND COALESCE(a.miscellaneous,'') NOT ILIKE '%tpt:%') OR a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_rates','v1_ptl_estimate_rate')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN a.event_name IN ('v1_ptl_estimate_rate','v1_ptl_rates') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_package_details_input' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_package_details') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name = 'ptl_package_details_input' AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  * MAX(CASE WHEN (a.screen_name IN ('ptl_select_transporter','ptl_select_transporter_per_kg') AND a.event_name = 'v1_ptl_select_transporter') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS step_flag,
  MIN(a.min_timestamp) AS min_timestamp,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN a.event_platform END),
  MAX(a.event_platform)) AS event_platform,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN
  CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN 0
  WHEN a.event_platform = 'android' AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 1770 THEN 1
  WHEN a.event_platform = 'ios' AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 1080 THEN 1
  WHEN a.event_platform IN ('web','mweb') AND CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) >= 240 THEN 1
  ELSE 0 END END), 0) AS upgrade_flag,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN a.screen_name ILIKE '%ptl_home_page%' THEN
  CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) END END),
  MAX(CASE WHEN a.app_version IS NULL OR TRIM(a.app_version) = ''
  OR POSITION('debug' IN LOWER(a.app_version)) > 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.app_version),'.',''),'[^0-9]','') AS BIGINT) END)) AS app_version_num,
  -- per-arm live flags: event day is on/after that user's OWN allocation date for that exact arm
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.test1_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.test1_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test1_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.control1_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.control1_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control1_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.control2_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.control2_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control2_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.test2_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.test2_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test2_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.browsing_control_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.browsing_control_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_control_live,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ea.browsing_test_enrolled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.event_date::date >= ea.browsing_test_enrolled_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_test_live
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m a
  LEFT JOIN exp_time t ON t.user_code = a.user_code
  LEFT JOIN exp_arm ea ON ea.user_code = a.user_code
  CROSS JOIN exp_start s
  WHERE a.event_date::date <= current_date
  AND a.screen_name LIKE 'ptl%' -- PTL screens only (perf)
  AND a.event_date::date >= coalesce([[current_date - {{last_n_days}},]] CASE
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Day' THEN current_date - interval '14 days'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Week' THEN current_date - interval '14 weeks'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Month' THEN current_date - interval '12 months'
  ELSE current_date - interval '14 days' END)
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
 ),
 seg AS (
  SELECT consigner_user_code,
  MIN(CASE WHEN ptl_trip_rank = 1 THEN demand_time END) AS first_trip_time,
  MIN(CASE WHEN ptl_trip_rank = 3 THEN demand_time END) AS third_trip_time
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  WHERE demand_status = 'FULFILLED'
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 exp AS (
  SELECT user_code,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 17 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 36 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS control2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 37 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test2,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 44 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_control,
  MAX(CASE WHEN variant_id = 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS browsing_test
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 reg AS (
  SELECT consigner_user_code, MAX(consigner_region) AS consigner_region
  FROM mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 final AS (
  SELECT ev.interval,
  CASE {{split}}
  WHEN 'Cx Segment PTL' THEN (CASE
  WHEN bb.first_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.first_trip_time THEN 'New'
  WHEN bb.third_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.third_trip_time THEN '1-3'
  ELSE '3+' END)
 when 'Cx Segment FTL' then (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New' when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  WHEN 'Consigner Region' THEN COALESCE(r.consigner_region, 'OTHER')
  WHEN 'Exp Type' THEN COALESCE(el.exp_label, 'Other')::varchar
  WHEN 'Platform' THEN (CASE WHEN ev.event_platform = 'android' THEN 'Android'
  WHEN ev.event_platform = 'ios' THEN 'Ios' ELSE 'Other' END)
  WHEN 'Upgrade Flag' THEN (CASE WHEN ev.upgrade_flag = 1 THEN 'Upgraded' ELSE 'Not Upgraded' END)
  WHEN 'Browsing Live Status' THEN ev.browsing_live_status::varchar
  ELSE 'Overall'
  END AS split_part,
  ev.user_code,
  ev.step_flag AS searched
  FROM ev
  LEFT JOIN seg bb ON bb.consigner_user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN exp c ON c.user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT user_code,
  CASE variant_id
  WHEN 17 THEN 'Test1 - 17' WHEN 18 THEN 'Control1 - 18'
  WHEN 36 THEN 'Control2 - 36' WHEN 37 THEN 'Test2 - 37'
  WHEN 44 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' WHEN 45 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45'
  END AS exp_label
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  WHERE deleted = 'false' and variant_id IN (17,18,36,37,44,45)
  GROUP BY 1,2
  ) el ON el.user_code = ev.user_code
  AND {{split}} = 'Exp Type'
  [[ AND el.exp_label IN ({{exp_type}}) ]]
 [[and (el.exp_label IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})) is not true]]
  LEFT JOIN reg r ON r.consigner_user_code = ev.user_code
  LEFT JOIN (
 Select consigner_user_code as ftl_cuc,
 min(case when rn = 1 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_first_trip_time,
 min(case when rn = 3 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_third_trip_time
 from (
 Select consigner_user_code, demand_time,
 row_number() over(partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) as rn
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_demands
 where trip_flag = 1 and load_type = 'FTL'
 )
 group by 1
 ) as ftl_seg on ftl_seg.ftl_cuc = ev.user_code
 WHERE ev.landed_flag = 1
  [[ AND (CASE
  WHEN bb.first_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.first_trip_time THEN 'New'
  WHEN bb.third_trip_time IS NULL
  OR (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= bb.third_trip_time THEN '1-3'
  ELSE '3+' END) IN ({{cx_segment_ptl}}) ]]
 [[and (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New'
 when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or (TIMESTAMP 'EPOCH' + (ev.min_timestamp / 1000000.0) * INTERVAL '1 second') <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3'
 else '3+' end) in ({{cx_segment_ftl}})]]
  [[ AND (
  (CASE WHEN c.test1 = 1 THEN 'Test1 - 17' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control1 = 1 THEN 'Control1 - 18' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control2 = 1 THEN 'Control2 - 36' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.test2 = 1 THEN 'Test2 - 37' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_control = 1 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_test = 1 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.test1,0)+COALESCE(c.control1,0)+COALESCE(c.control2,0)+COALESCE(c.test2,0)
  +COALESCE(c.browsing_control,0)+COALESCE(c.browsing_test,0) = 0
  THEN 'Other' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exp_type}})
  ) ]]
 [[and ((
  (CASE WHEN c.test1 = 1 THEN 'Test1 - 17' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control1 = 1 THEN 'Control1 - 18' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.control2 = 1 THEN 'Control2 - 36' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.test2 = 1 THEN 'Test2 - 37' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_control = 1 THEN 'Browsing Control - 44' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN c.browsing_test = 1 THEN 'Browsing Test - 45' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  OR (CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.test1,0)+COALESCE(c.control1,0)+COALESCE(c.control2,0)+COALESCE(c.test2,0)
  +COALESCE(c.browsing_control,0)+COALESCE(c.browsing_test,0) = 0
  THEN 'Other' ELSE 'NA' END) IN ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  )) is not true]]
  [[and (
  -- Experiment Timeline: per-user, per-arm. Each arm pairs with that user's OWN
  -- allocation timestamp for that exact variant_id (user + config_id grain).
  ('Test1 - 17' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test1 = 1 and ev.test1_live = 1)
  or ('Control1 - 18' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control1 = 1 and ev.control1_live = 1)
  or ('Test2 - 37' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test2 = 1 and ev.test2_live = 1
  and ev.upgrade_flag = 1) -- min app version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, Web >= 240
  or ('Control2 - 36' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control2 = 1 and ev.control2_live = 1
  and ev.upgrade_flag = 1)
  or ('Browsing Test - 45' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_test = 1 and ev.browsing_test_live = 1)
  or ('Browsing Control - 44' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_control = 1 and ev.browsing_control_live = 1)
 )]]
  [[ AND r.consigner_region IN ({{consigner_region}}) ]]
  [[ AND (CASE WHEN ev.event_platform = 'android' THEN 'Android'
  WHEN ev.event_platform = 'ios' THEN 'Ios' ELSE 'Other' END) IN ({{platform}}) ]]
  [[ AND ev.app_version_num >= {{Version}} ]]
  [[ AND ev.upgrade_flag = {{Upgrade_flag}} ]]
 )
 SELECT interval,
  split_part,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN searched = 1 THEN user_code END) AS "# Users"
 FROM final
 WHERE split_part <> 'OTHER'
 GROUP BY 1,2
 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2
 LIMIT 280
