 Share of delivered PTL trips with a billing GST number supplied that have an INVOICE document.
 Formula: count(distinct demand_id with an INVOICE row in fact_documents) * 100.0 / count(distinct demand_id), both over trips with billing_gst_flag = 1. Columns: trips, invoice_trips, % invoice.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (trip_end_time not null, vib_demand_state = 'COMPLETED', billing_gst_flag = 1) LEFT JOIN (select distinct demand_id from fact_documents where document_type = 'INVOICE'); dated on trip_end_time (IST), up to current_date; grain demand.
 Filters: Interval Day / Week / Month (window last 14 days / 14 weeks / 12 months, or last_n_days; blank = one Total row), bucketed on trip_end_time. Split: Overall, Cx Segment PTL (ptl_trip_rank: <= 1 New, 2-3 '1-3', else 3+), Cx Segment FTL (demand_time vs the consignor's 1st / 3rd FTL trip in fact_demands, load_type = 'FTL'), Consigner Region (dim_consigners.consigner_region: NCR / R1 / R2 / R3, else OTHER), Exp Type (fact_experiment_user_allocation.variant_id, live allocations only (deleted = 'false'): 'Test1 - 17' (SHOW_PTL), 'Control1 - 18' (DISABLE_PTL), 'Control2 - 36' (PTL_DEFAULT_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Test2 - 37' (PTL_DIVIDE_PAYMENT_FLOW), 'Browsing Control - 44' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_DEFAULT), 'Browsing Test - 45' (PTL_BROWSING_FLOW_V2); Other = no allocation), Platform (app_platform: Android / Ios / Other = web portal, ODIN, consigner web), Upgrade Flag (Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, consigner web >= 240), To Pay (fact_ptl_bookings.topay_flag: To Pay / Paid), Browsing Live Status. Also cx_segment_ptl, cx_segment_ftl, exp_type / exclude_exp_type, experiment_timeline (keeps demands whose demand_time is after the consignor's own allocation to that arm; arms 36 / 37 also require an upgraded app), consigner_region, transporter_name (DELHIVERY / DP WORLD / SAFEXPRESS PVT LTD / BUSYBEES / ATC TPT, else OTHER), Source (PTL WEB = web portal, APP WEB = consigner web, APP, ODIN, else source value or NA), platform, version (app_version >=), Upgrade_flag, weight (chargeable_weight < 300 / 300+ kg), advance_flag (advance_eligible), to_pay (fact_ptl_bookings.topay_flag).
 Caveats: billing_gst_flag is captured from about Aug 2026, so the card has data only from then. Invoices are generated after delivery, so the latest periods are immature and read low. A consignor allocated in several experiments appears under each arm in the Exp Type split.
SQL:
-- % Invoice Generated : share of PTL trips with an INVOICE document raised
 -- Base: fact_ptl_bookings, trip_flag = 1, trended on demand_time
 -- Invoice flag from fact_documents where document_type = 'INVOICE'
 -- Window capped at current_date - 2 to avoid invoice-generation lag
 
 with inv as (
  select distinct demand_id, 1 as invoice_flag
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_documents
  where document_type = 'INVOICE'
 )
 
 Select 
  (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', a.trip_end_time) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', a.trip_end_time) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', a.trip_end_time) else current_date::timestamp end)::date as date,
  case {{split}}
  when 'Cx Segment PTL' then (case when a.ptl_trip_rank<=1 then 'New' when a.ptl_trip_rank<=3 then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
 when 'Cx Segment FTL' then (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New' when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3' else '3+' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Consigner Region' then coalesce(r.consigner_region,'OTHER')::varchar(100)
  when 'Exp Type' then coalesce(el.exp_label,'Other')::varchar(100)
  when 'Platform' then (case when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Android' when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Ios' else 'Other' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Upgrade Flag' then (case when (case when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then 'Upgraded' else 'Not Upgraded' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'To Pay' then (case when a.topay_flag = 1 then 'To Pay' else 'Paid' end)::varchar(100)
  when 'Browsing Live Status' then (case when c.browsing_live_ist is not null and a.demand_time > c.browsing_live_ist then 'Browsing Live' else 'Browsing Not Live' end)::varchar(100)
  else 'Overall'::varchar(100)
  end as split_part,
 
  count(distinct a.demand_id) as trips,
  count(distinct case when coalesce(b.invoice_flag,0) = 1 then a.demand_id else null end) as invoice_trips,
  invoice_trips*100.0/nullif(trips,0) as "% invoice"
 
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings as a
 
 LEFT JOIN inv as b on b.demand_id = a.demand_id
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT user_code,
  max(case when variant_id = 17 then 1 else 0 end) as test1,
  max(case when variant_id = 18 then 1 else 0 end) as control1,
  max(case when variant_id = 36 then 1 else 0 end) as control2,
  max(case when variant_id = 37 then 1 else 0 end) as test2,
  max(case when variant_id = 44 then 1 else 0 end) as browsing_control,
  max(case when variant_id = 45 then 1 else 0 end) as browsing_test,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id in (44,45) then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as browsing_live_ist,
  -- per-user, per-arm enrollment timestamps (user+config_id grain)
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id=17 then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as test1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id=18 then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as control1_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id=36 then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as control2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id=37 then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as test2_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id=44 then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as browsing_control_enrolled_at,
  (TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + MIN(case when variant_id=45 then created end)/1000000 * INTERVAL '1 second') as browsing_test_enrolled_at
 FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
 where deleted = 'false' and variant_id in (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 GROUP BY 1
 ) as c on c.user_code = a.consigner_user_code
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT user_code,
  case variant_id
  when 17 then 'Test1 - 17' when 18 then 'Control1 - 18'
  when 36 then 'Control2 - 36' when 37 then 'Test2 - 37'
  when 44 then 'Browsing Control - 44' when 45 then 'Browsing Test - 45'
  end as exp_label
 FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
 where deleted = 'false' and variant_id in (17,18,36,37,44,45)
 GROUP BY 1,2
 ) as el
  on el.user_code = a.consigner_user_code
  and {{split}} = 'Exp Type'
  [[and el.exp_label in ({{exp_type}})]]
 [[and (el.exp_label in ({{exclude_exp_type}})) is not true]]
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT consigner_user_code, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region
 FROM mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners
 GROUP BY 1
 ) as r on r.consigner_user_code = a.consigner_user_code
 
 LEFT JOIN (
 Select consigner_user_code as ftl_cuc,
 min(case when rn = 1 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_first_trip_time,
 min(case when rn = 3 then demand_time else null end) as ftl_third_trip_time
 from (
 Select consigner_user_code, demand_time,
 row_number() over(partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) as rn
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_demands
 where trip_flag = 1 and load_type = 'FTL'
 )
 group by 1
 ) as ftl_seg on ftl_seg.ftl_cuc = a.consigner_user_code
 where a.trip_end_time is not null and billing_gst_flag = 1
 and vib_demand_state = 'COMPLETED'
 and a.trip_end_time::date >= coalesce([[current_date - {{last_n_days}},]] case 
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Day' then current_date - interval '14 days'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Week' then current_date - interval '14 weeks'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Month' then current_date - interval '12 months'
  else current_date - interval '14 days' 
 end)
 and a.trip_end_time::date <= current_date
 [[and (case when a.ptl_trip_rank<=1 then 'New' when a.ptl_trip_rank<=3 then '1-3' else '3+' end) in ({{cx_segment_ptl}})]]
 [[and (case when ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_first_trip_time then 'New'
 when ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time is null or a.demand_time <= ftl_seg.ftl_third_trip_time then '1-3'
 else '3+' end) in ({{cx_segment_ftl}})]]
 [[and (
  (case when c.test1 = 1 then 'Test1 - 17' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.control1 = 1 then 'Control1 - 18' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.control2 = 1 then 'Control2 - 36' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.test2 = 1 then 'Test2 - 37' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.browsing_control = 1 then 'Browsing Control - 44' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when c.browsing_test = 1 then 'Browsing Test - 45' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
  or (case when coalesce(c.test1,0)+coalesce(c.control1,0)+coalesce(c.control2,0)+coalesce(c.test2,0)+coalesce(c.browsing_control,0)+coalesce(c.browsing_test,0) = 0 then 'Other' else 'NA' end) in ({{exp_type}})
 )]]
 [[and ((
  (case when c.test1 = 1 then 'Test1 - 17' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.control1 = 1 then 'Control1 - 18' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.control2 = 1 then 'Control2 - 36' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.test2 = 1 then 'Test2 - 37' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.browsing_control = 1 then 'Browsing Control - 44' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when c.browsing_test = 1 then 'Browsing Test - 45' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
  or (case when coalesce(c.test1,0)+coalesce(c.control1,0)+coalesce(c.control2,0)+coalesce(c.test2,0)+coalesce(c.browsing_control,0)+coalesce(c.browsing_test,0) = 0 then 'Other' else 'NA' end) in ({{exclude_exp_type}})
 )) is not true]]
 [[and (
  -- Experiment Timeline: per-user, per-arm. Each arm pairs with that user's OWN
  -- allocation timestamp for that exact variant_id (user + config_id grain).
  ('Test1 - 17' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test1 = 1
  and c.test1_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.test1_enrolled_at)
  or ('Control1 - 18' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control1 = 1
  and c.control1_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.control1_enrolled_at)
  or ('Test2 - 37' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.test2 = 1
  and c.test2_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.test2_enrolled_at
  and (case 
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1
 else 0 end) = 1) -- min app version: Android >= 1770, iOS >= 1080, Web >= 240
  or ('Control2 - 36' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.control2 = 1
  and c.control2_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.control2_enrolled_at
  and (case 
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1
 else 0 end) = 1)
  or ('Browsing Test - 45' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_test = 1
  and c.browsing_test_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.browsing_test_enrolled_at)
  or ('Browsing Control - 44' in ({{experiment_timeline}}) and c.browsing_control = 1
  and c.browsing_control_enrolled_at is not null and a.demand_time > c.browsing_control_enrolled_at)
 )]]
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 [[and (case when a.transporter_name in ('DELHIVERY','DP WORLD','SAFEXPRESS PVT LTD','BUSYBEES','ATC TPT') then a.transporter_name else 'OTHER' END) in ({{transporter_name}})]]
 [[and (case when a.source = 'WEB PORTAL' then 'PTL WEB'
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' then 'APP WEB'
 when a.source ilike 'APP%' then 'APP' 
 when a.source IS NULL AND a.app_platform in ('CONSIGNER_APP','IOS_CONSIGNER_APP') then 'APP' 
 when a.source is not null then a.source
 else 'NA' end) in ({{Source}})]]
 [[and (case when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Android'
 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' then 'Ios' else 'Other' end) in ({{platform}})]]
 [[and a.app_version >= {{version}}]]
 [[and (case 
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' and a.app_version>=240 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1770 then 1
 when a.app_platform = 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP' and a.app_version>=1080 then 1
 else 0 end) = {{Upgrade_flag}}]]
 [[and (case when coalesce(a.chargeable_weight::float, 0) < 300 then '0-300' else '300+' end) in ({{weight}})]]
 [[and a.advance_eligible = {{advance_flag}}]]
 [[and a.topay_flag::varchar in ({{to_pay}})]]
 
 group by 1,2
 order by 1 desc, 2

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL : Overview (2938) > Consigner Payment > card 51744
 
 Aliases: A1 Payment Funnel; A1 payment-mode recovery.
 
 Funnel and recovery for app PTL demands on payment_submode 'A1'.
 Formula: plc = placed demands; advance_plc = advance_eligible = 1; a1_plc = payment_submode 'A1'; a1_pickup_done = A1 with in_transit_time; a1_trip = A1 with trip_flag = 1; due / due+3 / due+7 received % = sum(abs(recovered_within_X)) / sum(fact_ptl_bookings.receivable_amount) over A1 trips with days_since_due >= 0 / 3 / 7; till-date received % = abs(overall_received_amount) / receivable at days_since_due >= 0; % Trip with payment = A1 trips with recovered_within_due_date < 0 / a1_trip (integer division, whole-number %).
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (placement_flag = 1; source APP or APP WEB only, so the PTL web portal is excluded) LEFT JOIN fact_demands (payment_submode) and as_trip_payments (one row per demand); dated on placement_time (IST); window last 14 days / 14 weeks / 12 months.
 Filters: Interval only.
 Caveats: payment submode A1 exists from 9 Oct 2026; earlier rows are 0. A1 demands are not a subset of advance-eligible demands, so a1_plc can exceed advance_plc.
SQL:
select
 (case coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Total') when 'Day' then date_trunc('day', placement_time) when 'Week' then date_trunc('week', placement_time) when 'Month' then date_trunc('month', placement_time) else current_date::timestamp end) as interval,
 
 count(distinct demand_id) as plc,
 count(distinct case when advance_eligible =1 then demand_id else null end) as advance_plc,
 count(distinct case when payment_submode = 'A1' then demand_id else null end) as a1_plc,
 count(distinct case when payment_submode = 'A1' and in_transit_time is not null then demand_id else null end) as a1_pickup_done,
 count(distinct case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 then demand_id else null end) as a1_trip,
 100.0 * sum(abs(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 0 then recovered_within_due_date else null end))
  / nullif(sum(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 0 then receivable_amount else null end), 0) as "due received%",
 100.0 * sum(abs(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 3 then recovered_within_3_days else null end))
  / nullif(sum(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 3 then receivable_amount else null end), 0) as "due+3 received%",
 100.0 * sum(abs(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 7 then recovered_within_7_days else null end))
  / nullif(sum(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 7 then receivable_amount else null end), 0) as "due+7 received%",
 100.0 * sum(abs(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 0 then overall_received_amount else null end))
  / nullif(sum(case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and days_since_due >= 0 then receivable_amount else null end), 0) as "tilldate received%",
 count(distinct case when payment_submode = 'A1' and trip_flag = 1 and recovered_within_due_date<0 then demand_id else null end)*100/nullif(a1_trip,0) as "% Trip with payment"
 
 from
 (Select a.*,b.payment_submode,recovered_within_due_date,recovered_within_3_days,recovered_within_7_days,overall_received_amount,
 days_since_due
 from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings as a
 left join mp_analytics_core.fact_demands as b on b.demand_id = a.demand_id
 left join mp_analytics_core.as_trip_payments as c on c.demand_id = a.demand_id
 where placement_flag = 1
 AND (case when source = 'WEB PORTAL' then 'PTL WEB'
 when a.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' then 'APP WEB'
 when source ilike 'APP%' then 'APP' 
 when source IS NULL AND a.app_platform in ('CONSIGNER_APP','IOS_CONSIGNER_APP') then 'APP' 
 when source is not null then source
 else 'NA' end) IN ('APP WEB','APP')
 
 
 -- and cx_segments_ptl = '1-3'
 -- cx_segments_ptl_prospective
 )
 
 Where 1=1
 and 
  placement_time::date >= coalesce(case 
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Day' then current_date - interval '14 days'
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Week' then current_date - interval '14 weeks' 
  when coalesce([[{{Interval}},]] 'Day') = 'Month' then current_date - interval '12 months'
  else current_date - interval '14 days' 
  end)
 group by 1
 order by 1 desc

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: PTL-live consignors; SHOW_PTL base; PTL exposed Cx.
 
 Number of consignors for whom PTL is live in the app (cross-sell test arm), by the month PTL went live for them.
 Formula: count(distinct user_code) from fact_experiment_user_allocation where variant_id = 17 (SHOW_PTL) and deleted = false; dated on the first live allocation time (min(created), epoch microseconds).
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation; grain consignor; cohort = live month.
 Filters: consigner_region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads: NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI)).
 Caveats: deleted = false means the allocation is live; deleted = true means PTL is not shown, so those rows are excluded. This is the denominator for every 'per PTL-live Cx' metric. Web portal and ODIN PTL customers are not gated by this flag, so many PTL customers are never in this base.
SQL:
with live as (
  -- PTL-live = SHOW_PTL (variant_id 17), live allocations only
  select user_code, min(timestamp 'epoch' + created/1000000 * interval '1 second') as live_time
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  where variant_id = 17 and deleted = false
  group by 1
 ),
 reg as (
  -- NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI); fact_leads fallback
  select consigner_user_code, coalesce(max(src_region), max(lead_region)) as consigner_region
  from (
  select consigner_user_code, consigner_region as src_region, null::varchar as lead_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
  union all
  select consigner_user_code, null::varchar, consigner_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads
  ) x
  group by 1
 )
 select date_trunc('month', l.live_time)::date as live_month,
  count(*) as "# PTL-live Cx"
 from live l
 left join reg r on r.consigner_user_code = l.user_code
 where 1=1
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 group by 1
 order by 1 desc

Metric: % PTL-live Cx with Requirement (D1 / D7 / D30)
Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: PTL reach; PTL activation; Live -> Requirement %.
 
 Of consignors whose PTL went live in the month, the % who created at least one PTL requirement within 1, 7 and 30 days of going live. Also returns the % with a real PTL demand and the % acquired (first-ever PTL pickup) within 30 days.
 Formula: count(Cx with a first requirement_flag = 1 row in [live_time, live_time + N days)) / count(PTL-live Cx). The acquisition denominator excludes consignors who were already PTL customers before going live.
 Source: fact_experiment_user_allocation (variant_id 17, deleted = false = live), fact_ptl_requirements (requirement_flag = 1, price_check_time IST), fact_ptl_bookings (real demand_id; first pickup_done_time = PTL acquisition); cohort = live month; grain consignor.
 Filters: consigner_region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads: NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI)).
 Caveats: only cohorts live at least 30 days ago are shown (fixed 30-day window, so months are comparable). This is a reach metric for the SHOW_PTL arm, not a test-vs-control lift.
SQL:
with live as (
  -- PTL-live = SHOW_PTL (variant_id 17), live allocations only
  select user_code, min(timestamp 'epoch' + created/1000000 * interval '1 second') as live_time
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  where variant_id = 17 and deleted = false
  group by 1
 ),
 reg as (
  -- NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI); fact_leads fallback
  select consigner_user_code, coalesce(max(src_region), max(lead_region)) as consigner_region
  from (
  select consigner_user_code, consigner_region as src_region, null::varchar as lead_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
  union all
  select consigner_user_code, null::varchar, consigner_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads
  ) x
  group by 1
 ),
 req as (
  select l.user_code, min(q.price_check_time) as first_req
  from live l
  join mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements q
  on q.consigner_user_code = l.user_code and q.requirement_flag = 1
  and q.price_check_time >= l.live_time and q.price_check_time < l.live_time + interval '30 days'
  group by 1
 ),
 dem as (
  select l.user_code, min(b.demand_time) as first_demand
  from live l
  join mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings b
  on b.consigner_user_code = l.user_code
  and b.demand_time >= l.live_time and b.demand_time < l.live_time + interval '30 days'
  group by 1
 ),
 acq as (
  select consigner_user_code, min(pickup_done_time) as first_pickup
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  where pickup_done_time is not null
  group by 1
 )
 select date_trunc('month', l.live_time)::date as live_month,
  count(*) as ptl_live_cx,
  sum(case when req.first_req < l.live_time + interval '1 day' then 1 else 0 end)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as pct_req_d1,
  sum(case when req.first_req < l.live_time + interval '7 days' then 1 else 0 end)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as pct_req_d7,
  count(req.user_code)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as pct_req_d30,
  count(dem.user_code)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as pct_demand_d30,
  sum(case when a.first_pickup >= l.live_time and a.first_pickup < l.live_time + interval '30 days' then 1 else 0 end)*100.0
  / nullif(sum(case when a.first_pickup is null or a.first_pickup >= l.live_time then 1 else 0 end),0) as pct_acquired_d30
 from live l
 left join reg r on r.consigner_user_code = l.user_code
 left join req on req.user_code = l.user_code
 left join dem on dem.user_code = l.user_code
 left join acq a on a.consigner_user_code = l.user_code
 where l.live_time::date <= current_date - 30
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 group by 1
 order by 1 desc

Metric: # PTL Acquisitions by Channel (+ % from FTL base)
Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: PTL acquisitions; New PTL customers; FTL -> PTL conversions.
 
 Number of consignors whose first-ever PTL pickup happened in the month, split by the channel of that first shipment, and the % of them who were already FTL customers (first FTL trip before the first PTL pickup). Business acquisition number across all channels, not an experiment number.
 Formula: min(pickup_done_time) per consigner_user_code on fact_ptl_bookings; FTL base = dim_consigners.acquisition_date_ftl before the first PTL pickup date.
 Source: fact_ptl_bookings; dim_consigners.acquisition_date_ftl (first FTL trip, history from 2019, never filled for PTL-only consignors); dated on first pickup_done_time (IST); grain consignor.
 Rule: use acquisition_date_ftl for the first FTL trip. dim_consigners.first_trip_date covers any load type (for PTL-only consignors it holds their first PTL trip). dim_consigners.acquisition_date_ptl = demand date of the first PTL trip, not the pickup date.
 Channel: PTL WEB = source 'WEB PORTAL'; APP WEB = app_platform 'CONSIGNER_WEB'; APP = app source; ODIN = manual.
 Filters: consigner_region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads: NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI)).
 Caveats: new and existing PTL customers come through different channels; read split by channel. The latest month is partial.
SQL:
with reg as (
  -- NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI); fact_leads fallback
  select consigner_user_code, coalesce(max(src_region), max(lead_region)) as consigner_region
  from (
  select consigner_user_code, consigner_region as src_region, null::varchar as lead_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
  union all
  select consigner_user_code, null::varchar, consigner_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads
  ) x
  group by 1
 ),
 first_pickup as (
  select consigner_user_code, pickup_done_time as first_pickup, source, app_platform
  from (
  select consigner_user_code, pickup_done_time, source, app_platform,
  row_number() over (partition by consigner_user_code order by pickup_done_time, demand_id) as rn
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  where pickup_done_time is not null
  ) x
  where rn = 1
 )
 select date_trunc('month', f.first_pickup)::date as acq_month,
  case when f.source = 'WEB PORTAL' then 'PTL WEB'
  when f.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' then 'APP WEB'
  when f.source ilike 'APP%' or (f.source is null and f.app_platform in ('CONSIGNER_APP','IOS_CONSIGNER_APP')) then 'APP'
  else coalesce(f.source, 'NA') end as channel,
  count(*) as "# PTL Acquisitions",
  sum(case when dc.first_trip_date < f.first_pickup::date then 1 else 0 end)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "% from FTL base"
 from first_pickup f
 left join (
  -- FTL acquisition date (first FTL trip), history from 2019; FTL-only, no PTL leakage
  select consigner_user_code, min(acquisition_date_ftl) as first_trip_date
  from mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners
  group by 1
 ) dc
  on dc.consigner_user_code = f.consigner_user_code
 left join reg r on r.consigner_user_code = f.consigner_user_code
 where f.first_pickup >= current_date - interval '12 months'
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 group by 1,2
 order by 1 desc, 2

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: Cross-sell penetration; FTL -> PTL wallet share; Dual-use rate.
 
 Of consignors with at least one FTL trip in the month, the % who also had a PTL requirement in the same month, and the % who also shipped PTL (PTL pickup) in the same month.
 Formula: count(FTL-active Cx with requirement_flag = 1 in the month) / count(FTL-active Cx); same with pickup_done_time in the month.
 Source: fact_demands (load_type = 'FTL', trip_flag = 1, demand_time), fact_ptl_requirements (price_check_time IST), fact_ptl_bookings (pickup_done_time IST); grain consignor x month.
 Filters: consigner_region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads: NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI)).
 Caveats: same-month co-occurrence, not sequence. The latest month is partial. fact_demands starts Oct 2025.
SQL:
with reg as (
  -- NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI); fact_leads fallback
  select consigner_user_code, coalesce(max(src_region), max(lead_region)) as consigner_region
  from (
  select consigner_user_code, consigner_region as src_region, null::varchar as lead_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
  union all
  select consigner_user_code, null::varchar, consigner_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads
  ) x
  group by 1
 ),
 ftl as (
  select date_trunc('month', demand_time)::date as m, consigner_user_code
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_demands
  where load_type = 'FTL' and trip_flag = 1 and demand_time >= date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '12 months'
  group by 1,2
 ),
 req as (
  select date_trunc('month', price_check_time)::date as m, consigner_user_code
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements
  where requirement_flag = 1
  group by 1,2
 ),
 pick as (
  select date_trunc('month', pickup_done_time)::date as m, consigner_user_code
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  where pickup_done_time is not null
  group by 1,2
 )
 select f.m as month,
  count(*) as ftl_active_cx,
  count(q.consigner_user_code)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "% with PTL Requirement",
  count(p.consigner_user_code)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "% shipped PTL"
 from ftl f
 left join req q on q.m = f.m and q.consigner_user_code = f.consigner_user_code
 left join pick p on p.m = f.m and p.consigner_user_code = f.consigner_user_code
 left join reg r on r.consigner_user_code = f.consigner_user_code
 where 1=1
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 group by 1
 order by 1 desc

Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: PTL repeat rate; 2nd PTL shipment rate; PTL retention.
 
 Of consignors acquired on PTL in the month (first-ever PTL pickup), the % who had a second PTL pickup within 30 and 60 days of the first.
 Formula: count(Cx with 2nd pickup_done_time - 1st pickup_done_time <= N days) / count(acquired Cx), N = 30, 60.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (pickup_done_time IST); cohort = month of first pickup; grain consignor.
 Filters: consigner_region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads: NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI)).
 Caveats: only cohorts whose first pickup is at least 60 days old are shown (fixed window). Repeat behaviour differs strongly by the channel of the first shipment (web portal vs app).
SQL:
with reg as (
  -- NCR / R1 (TOP 5 CLUSTERS) / R2 (NEXT 24 CLUSTERS) / R3 (ROI); fact_leads fallback
  select consigner_user_code, coalesce(max(src_region), max(lead_region)) as consigner_region
  from (
  select consigner_user_code, consigner_region as src_region, null::varchar as lead_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
  union all
  select consigner_user_code, null::varchar, consigner_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads
  ) x
  group by 1
 ),
 p as (
  select consigner_user_code, pickup_done_time,
  row_number() over (partition by consigner_user_code order by pickup_done_time, demand_id) as rn
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  where pickup_done_time is not null
 ),
 f as (
  select a.consigner_user_code, a.pickup_done_time as first_pickup, b.pickup_done_time as second_pickup
  from p a
  left join p b on b.consigner_user_code = a.consigner_user_code and b.rn = 2
  where a.rn = 1
 )
 select date_trunc('month', f.first_pickup)::date as acq_month,
  count(*) as acquired_cx,
  sum(case when datediff(day, f.first_pickup, f.second_pickup) <= 30 then 1 else 0 end)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "% Repeat D30",
  sum(case when datediff(day, f.first_pickup, f.second_pickup) <= 60 then 1 else 0 end)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "% Repeat D60"
 from f
 left join reg r on r.consigner_user_code = f.consigner_user_code
 where f.first_pickup::date <= current_date - 60
  and f.first_pickup >= current_date - interval '12 months'
 [[and r.consigner_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 group by 1
 order by 1 desc

Metric: FTL Guardrail — FTL Trips per 1,000 Cx (SHOW vs DISABLE)
Meaning / Logic:
Aliases: FTL guardrail; FTL cannibalisation check; Test vs Control FTL trips.
 
 For new signups randomised into SHOW_PTL (17) or DISABLE_PTL (18) at signup, FTL trips per 1,000 consignors and % FTL-acquired in the 30 days after allocation, by signup month and arm. Guardrail: SHOW_PTL must not be lower than DISABLE_PTL.
 Formula: count(distinct FTL trip demand_id in [alloc_time, alloc_time + 30 days]) * 1000 / count(Cx in arm).
 Source: fact_experiment_user_allocation (variant_id 17 / 18, deleted = false = live), fact_leads (signup_date), fact_demands (load_type = 'FTL', trip_flag = 1); grain consignor.
 Cohort rule: only consignors allocated within 1 day of signup, because that split is randomised. Do not compare all SHOW vs all DISABLE consignors: SHOW also includes the hand-picked FTL retention base, which makes SHOW look better on FTL purely by selection.
 Filters: consigner_region of the signup lead (fact_leads: NCR / R1 / R2 / R3).
 Caveats: only cohorts allocated at least 30 days ago are shown.
SQL:
with arm as (
  select user_code,
  max(case when variant_id = 17 then 1 else 0 end) as is_show,
  min(timestamp 'epoch' + created/1000000 * interval '1 second') as alloc_time
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  where variant_id in (17,18) and deleted = false
  group by 1
 ),
 su as (
  select consigner_user_code, min(signup_date) as signup_date, max(consigner_region) as lead_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads
  group by 1
 ),
 cohort as (
  select a.user_code, case when a.is_show = 1 then 'SHOW_PTL' else 'DISABLE_PTL' end as arm, a.alloc_time, s.signup_date
  from arm a
  join su s on s.consigner_user_code = a.user_code
  where datediff(day, s.signup_date, a.alloc_time::date) between 0 and 1 -- allocated at signup = randomised split
  [[and s.lead_region in ({{consigner_region}})]]
 ),
 ftl as (
  select c.user_code, count(distinct d.demand_id) as ftl_trips_30d
  from cohort c
  join mp_analytics_core.fact_demands d
  on d.consigner_user_code = c.user_code and d.load_type = 'FTL' and d.trip_flag = 1
  and d.demand_time >= c.alloc_time and d.demand_time < c.alloc_time + interval '30 days'
  group by 1
 )
 select date_trunc('month', c.signup_date)::date as signup_month, c.arm,
  count(*) as cx,
  sum(coalesce(f.ftl_trips_30d,0))*1000.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "FTL Trips per 1,000 Cx (D30)",
  count(f.user_code)*100.0/nullif(count(*),0) as "% FTL Acquired (D30)"
 from cohort c
 left join ftl f on f.user_code = c.user_code
 where c.alloc_time::date <= current_date - 30
  and c.signup_date >= current_date - interval '12 months'
 group by 1,2
 order by 1 desc, 2

Metric: 4 · Which segments convert best? (offer timing × app activity)
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > Motion 1 — conversion > card 51029
 
 Aliases: PTL conversion by segment; Motion 1 segment table; offer timing x app activity conversion.
 
 Share of PTL-live, FTL-acquired consignors who reached each PTL stage till date, split by how long before PTL went live they were FTL-acquired (freshness bucket) and by current app activity.
 Formula: per freshness_bucket x app_active: count(consignors with stage date not null) / count(consignors) for opened, requirement, demand, placement and trip; plus consignors, trip_consignors, avg_exposure_days = avg(current_date - sellable date) and avg_days_to_first_trip = avg(greatest(first PTL trip date - sellable date, 0)) among trip takers.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (experiment_name 'SHOW_PTL', deleted = false; allocation date = UTC date of created), fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (first FTL trip = min demand_date with trip_flag = 1, lifetime FTL trips, last login_date, region), fact_leads (signup_date, region fallback, cx_business_category, app_potential), fact_cx_events_l24m (PTL screen views), fact_ptl_requirements, fact_ptl_bookings, mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage; stage dates on coalesce(demand_time, price_check_time) (IST); grain consignor.
 Cohort: consignors with a live SHOW_PTL allocation and a first FTL trip; three internal test codes excluded. PTL live date = earliest of allocation date, first PTL screen view (ptl_home_page, ptl_pincode_input, ptl_package_details_input, ptl_service_type_input, ptl_select_transporter), first fact_ptl_requirements row and first fact_ptl_bookings demand. Sellable date = greatest(first FTL trip, PTL live date); only sellable date >= 2026-04-01. Stages (first date per consignor): opened = PTL screen view; requirement = requirement_flag = 1; demand = demand_flag = 1 (real + would-be) or any pre-2026 booking; placement = placement_flag = 1 or a pre-2026 picked-up booking; trip = trip_flag = 1 or a pre-2026 booking with pickup_done_time not null and status not EXPIRED/CANCELLED.
 Buckets: freshness = PTL live date - first FTL trip: A <= 0 days (PTL live at FTL acquisition), B up to 90 days, C 91-365 days, D over 365 days. app_active: 'Active (30d)' = last login within 30 days, else 'Inactive'.
 Filters (all optional): region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads); freshness ('PTL live at FTL acquisition', 'FTL acquired before PTL live', 'ALL (fresh + retro-fit)'); app_active; ftl_trips band (1 / 2-3 / 4+ lifetime FTL trips); clock_from / clock_to on sellable date; signup_from / signup_to on fact_leads signup_date; min_potential (app_potential >=, null as 0); ptl_cat (as_cx_ptl_stage.ptl_category group: 'PTL-NCR' = PTL-NCR, PTL-NCR-Not Intrested, PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS; 'Other tag'; 'Not tagged'); business_category (fact_leads.cx_business_category: 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)', 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER', or a single category).
 Caveats: Stages are till date with no fixed window, so older sellable cohorts have more exposure. PTL activity before the sellable date counts (day 0). fact_cx_events_l24m covers a rolling 24 months.
SQL:
-- REGION (15 Oct 2026): consigner_region from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (fallback fact_leads); consignors missing from fact_leads are no longer dropped.
 -- PTL category (15 Oct 2026): mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage.ptl_category; PTL-NCR = PTL-NCR + PTL-NCR-Not Intrested + PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS (tag set by calling team, mostly after a PTL price check).
 -- TILL DATE v2 (8 Oct 2026): PTL live date = EARLIEST of SHOW_PTL allocation OR first PTL activity (PTL screen open, price check, demand/booking).
 -- Cohort still requires a SHOW_PTL allocation. Sellable = later of first FTL trip and that live date. Day 0 = done on/before sellable.
 -- Because the live date is never later than any PTL activity, every PTL event of the consignor counts (incl. pre-2026 bookings for demand / placement / trip).
 with ftl as (
  select consigner_user_code, min(case when trip_flag=1 then demand_date end)::date as t1,
  count(case when trip_flag=1 then 1 end) as ftl_trips, max(login_date)::date as last_login, max(consigner_region) as d_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1),
 alloc as (select user_code, min((timestamp 'epoch'+created/1000000*interval '1 second')::date) as alloc_date
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' and deleted=false group by 1),
 lds as (select consigner_user_code, min(signup_date) as signup_date, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region,
  max(cx_business_category) as cx_business_category, max(app_potential) as app_potential
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 evo as (select user_code as cc, min(event_date)::date as po1 from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m
  where screen_name in ('ptl_home_page','ptl_pincode_input','ptl_package_details_input','ptl_service_type_input','ptl_select_transporter') group by 1),
 rq as (select consigner_user_code as cc,
  min(coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time))::date as first_rq,
  min(case when browsing_id not like 'D/%' then price_check_time end)::date as pc1,
  min(case when requirement_flag=1 then coalesce(price_check_time,demand_time) end)::date as rq1,
  min(case when demand_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as dm1,
  min(case when placement_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as pl1,
  min(case when trip_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as tr1
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements group by 1),
 bk as (select consigner_user_code as cc, min(demand_time)::date as first_bk,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' then demand_time end)::date as dm0,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' and pickup_done_time is not null and coalesce(demand_status,'') not in ('EXPIRED','CANCELLED') then demand_time end)::date as tr0
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings group by 1),
 pcat as (select consigner_user_code as cc, max(ptl_category) as cat
  from mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 b0 as (
  select a.user_code, pc.cat as ptl_category,
  least(a.alloc_date, coalesce(o.po1, a.alloc_date), coalesce(r.first_rq, a.alloc_date), coalesce(k.first_bk, a.alloc_date)) as live_date,
  f.t1, f.ftl_trips, f.last_login,
  coalesce(f.d_region, l.consigner_region) as consigner_region, l.signup_date, l.cx_business_category, coalesce(l.app_potential,0) as app_potential,
  o.po1, r.pc1, r.rq1, least(r.dm1, k.dm0) as dm1, least(r.pl1, k.tr0) as pl1, least(r.tr1, k.tr0) as tr1
  from alloc a join ftl f on f.consigner_user_code=a.user_code left join lds l on l.consigner_user_code=a.user_code
  left join evo o on o.cc = a.user_code left join rq r on r.cc = a.user_code left join bk k on k.cc = a.user_code
  left join pcat pc on pc.cc = a.user_code
  where f.t1 is not null and a.user_code not in ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979')),
 b1 as (
  select b0.*, greatest(t1, live_date) as clock,
  case when ptl_category in ('PTL-NCR','PTL-NCR-Not Intrested','PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS') then 'PTL-NCR'
  when ptl_category is not null then 'Other tag' else 'Not tagged' end as ptl_cat_group,
  case when live_date - t1 <= 0 then 'PTL live at FTL acquisition' else 'FTL acquired before PTL live' end as freshness,
  case when live_date - t1 <= 0 then 'A. PTL live at FTL acquisition (fresh)'
  when live_date - t1 <= 90 then 'B. FTL acquired 0-90d before PTL live'
  when live_date - t1 <= 365 then 'C. FTL acquired 91-365d before PTL live'
  else 'D. FTL acquired 365d+ before PTL live' end as freshness_bucket,
  case when current_date - last_login <= 30 then 'Active (30d)' else 'Inactive' end as app_active,
  case when ftl_trips = 1 then '1' when ftl_trips <= 3 then '2-3' else '4+' end as ftl_trip_band
  from b0 where greatest(t1, live_date) >= '2026-04-01'),
 x as (
  select b1.*, current_date - clock as age from b1
  where 1=1
  [[and consigner_region = {{region}}]]
  [[and (case when {{freshness}} = 'ALL (fresh + retro-fit)' then 1 when freshness = {{freshness}} then 1 else 0 end) = 1]]
  [[and app_active = {{app_active}}]]
  [[and ftl_trip_band = {{ftl_trips}}]]
  [[and clock >= {{clock_from}}]]
  [[and clock <= {{clock_to}}]]
  [[and signup_date >= {{signup_from}}]]
  [[and signup_date <= {{signup_to}}]]
  [[and app_potential >= {{min_potential}}]]
  [[and ptl_cat_group = {{ptl_cat}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else cx_business_category = {{business_category}} end)]])
 select freshness_bucket, app_active,
  count(*) as consignors,
  round(avg(age)) as avg_exposure_days,
  round(100.0*count(po1)/count(*),2) as opened_pct,
  round(100.0*count(rq1)/count(*),2) as requirement_pct,
  round(100.0*count(dm1)/count(*),2) as demand_pct,
  round(100.0*count(pl1)/count(*),2) as placement_pct,
  count(tr1) as trip_consignors,
  round(100.0*count(tr1)/count(*),2) as trip_pct,
  round(avg(greatest(tr1 - clock, 0))) as avg_days_to_first_trip
 from x group by 1,2 order by 1,2

Metric: 3 · Conversion curve — fixed cohort (only consignors with ≥ Window days since sellable)
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > Motion 1 — conversion > card 51080
 
 Aliases: PTL conversion curve fixed cohort; matured-cohort day-N curve; Motion 1 fixed curve.
 
 Cumulative % of a fixed cohort of PTL-live, FTL-acquired consignors (all with at least Window days since becoming sellable) who reached each PTL stage within N days of the sellable date, for N from 0 up to Window.
 Formula: for each N in (0, 7, 15, 30, 60, 90, then every 30 days to 720) with N <= win_days: count(consignors with stage date <= sellable date + N) / count(consignors with current_date - sellable date >= win_days), for PTL opened, price check, demand, placement and trip. day_label shows 'Day N' and the cohort size.

-- DAY SCALE (21 Oct 2026, SuperPM): points every 30 days after day 90, up to day 720 (no fixed end; point shows while enough consignors are that old).
 -- REGION (15 Oct 2026): consigner_region from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (fallback fact_leads); consignors missing from fact_leads are no longer dropped.
 -- PTL category (15 Oct 2026): mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage.ptl_category; PTL-NCR = PTL-NCR + PTL-NCR-Not Intrested + PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS (tag set by calling team, mostly after a PTL price check).
 -- TILL DATE v2 (8 Oct 2026): PTL live date = EARLIEST of SHOW_PTL allocation OR first PTL activity (PTL screen open, price check, demand/booking).
 -- Cohort still requires a SHOW_PTL allocation. Sellable = later of first FTL trip and that live date. Day 0 = done on/before sellable.
 -- Because the live date is never later than any PTL activity, every PTL event of the consignor counts (incl. pre-2026 bookings for demand / placement / trip).
 with ftl as (
  select consigner_user_code, min(case when trip_flag=1 then demand_date end)::date as t1,
  count(case when trip_flag=1 then 1 end) as ftl_trips, max(login_date)::date as last_login, max(consigner_region) as d_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1),
 alloc as (select user_code, min((timestamp 'epoch'+created/1000000*interval '1 second')::date) as alloc_date
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' and deleted=false group by 1),
 lds as (select consigner_user_code, min(signup_date) as signup_date, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region,
  max(cx_business_category) as cx_business_category, max(app_potential) as app_potential
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 evo as (select user_code as cc, min(event_date)::date as po1 from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m
  where screen_name in ('ptl_home_page','ptl_pincode_input','ptl_package_details_input','ptl_service_type_input','ptl_select_transporter') group by 1),
 rq as (select consigner_user_code as cc,
  min(coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time))::date as first_rq,
  min(case when browsing_id not like 'D/%' then price_check_time end)::date as pc1,
  min(case when requirement_flag=1 then coalesce(price_check_time,demand_time) end)::date as rq1,
  min(case when demand_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as dm1,
  min(case when placement_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as pl1,
  min(case when trip_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as tr1
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements group by 1),

  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' then demand_time end)::date as dm0,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' and pickup_done_time is not null and coalesce(demand_status,'') not in ('EXPIRED','CANCELLED') then demand_time end)::date as tr0
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings group by 1),
 pcat as (select consigner_user_code as cc, max(ptl_category) as cat
  from mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 b0 as (
  select a.user_code, pc.cat as ptl_category,
  least(a.alloc_date, coalesce(o.po1, a.alloc_date), coalesce(r.first_rq, a.alloc_date), coalesce(k.first_bk, a.alloc_date)) as live_date,
  f.t1, f.ftl_trips, f.last_login,
  coalesce(f.d_region, l.consigner_region) as consigner_region, l.signup_date, l.cx_business_category, coalesce(l.app_potential,0) as app_potential,
  o.po1, r.pc1, r.rq1, least(r.dm1, k.dm0) as dm1, least(r.pl1, k.tr0) as pl1, least(r.tr1, k.tr0) as tr1
  from alloc a join ftl f on f.consigner_user_code=a.user_code left join lds l on l.consigner_user_code=a.user_code
  left join evo o on o.cc = a.user_code left join rq r on r.cc = a.user_code left join bk k on k.cc = a.user_code
  left join pcat pc on pc.cc = a.user_code
  where f.t1 is not null and a.user_code not in ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979')),
 b1 as (
  select b0.*, greatest(t1, live_date) as clock,
  case when ptl_category in ('PTL-NCR','PTL-NCR-Not Intrested','PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS') then 'PTL-NCR'
  when ptl_category is not null then 'Other tag' else 'Not tagged' end as ptl_cat_group,
  case when live_date - t1 <= 0 then 'PTL live at FTL acquisition' else 'FTL acquired before PTL live' end as freshness,
  case when live_date - t1 <= 0 then 'A. PTL live at FTL acquisition (fresh)'
  when live_date - t1 <= 90 then 'B. FTL acquired 0-90d before PTL live'
  when live_date - t1 <= 365 then 'C. FTL acquired 91-365d before PTL live'
  else 'D. FTL acquired 365d+ before PTL live' end as freshness_bucket,
  case when current_date - last_login <= 30 then 'Active (30d)' else 'Inactive' end as app_active,
  case when ftl_trips = 1 then '1' when ftl_trips <= 3 then '2-3' else '4+' end as ftl_trip_band
  from b0 where greatest(t1, live_date) >= '2026-04-01'),
 x as (
  select b1.*, current_date - clock as age from b1
  where 1=1
  [[and consigner_region = {{region}}]]
  [[and (case when {{freshness}} = 'ALL (fresh + retro-fit)' then 1 when freshness = {{freshness}} then 1 else 0 end) = 1]]
  [[and app_active = {{app_active}}]]
  [[and ftl_trip_band = {{ftl_trips}}]]
  [[and clock >= {{clock_from}}]]
  [[and clock <= {{clock_to}}]]
  [[and signup_date >= {{signup_from}}]]
  [[and signup_date <= {{signup_to}}]]
  [[and app_potential >= {{min_potential}}]]
  [[and ptl_cat_group = {{ptl_cat}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else cx_business_category = {{business_category}} end)]]),
 d as (select 0 as d union all select 7 union all select 15 union all select 30 union all select 60 union all select 90 union all select 120 union all select 150 union all select 180 union all select 210 union all select 240 union all select 270 union all select 300 union all select 330 union all select 360 union all select 390 union all select 420 union all select 450 union all select 480 union all select 510 union all select 540 union all select 570 union all select 600 union all select 630 union all select 660 union all select 690 union all select 720)
 select 'Day ' || d.d || ' · n = ' || to_char(count(*), 'FM999,999') as day_label,
  d.d as days_since_sellable,
  count(*) as cohort_consignors,
  round(100.0*count(case when po1 <= clock + d.d then 1 end)/nullif(count(*),0),2) as ptl_opened_pct,
  round(100.0*count(case when pc1 <= clock + d.d then 1 end)/nullif(count(*),0),2) as price_check_pct,
  round(100.0*count(case when dm1 <= clock + d.d then 1 end)/nullif(count(*),0),2) as demand_pct,
  round(100.0*count(case when pl1 <= clock + d.d then 1 end)/nullif(count(*),0),2) as placement_pct,
  round(100.0*count(case when tr1 <= clock + d.d then 1 end)/nullif(count(*),0),2) as trip_pct
 from x cross join d
 where x.age >= {{win_days}} and d.d <= {{win_days}}
 group by d.d order by d.d

Stages (first date per consignor): opened = PTL screen view; price check = fact_ptl_requirements row with browsing_id not like 'D/%' (price_check_time); demand = demand_flag = 1 (real + would-be) or any pre-2026 booking; placement = placement_flag = 1 or a pre-2026 picked-up booking; trip = trip_flag = 1 or a pre-2026 booking with pickup_done_time not null and status not EXPIRED/CANCELLED.
 Filters (all optional): region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads); freshness ('PTL live at FTL acquisition' = live date <= first FTL trip, 'FTL acquired before PTL live', 'ALL (fresh + retro-fit)'); app_active ('Active (30d)' = last login within 30 days, else 'Inactive'); ftl_trips band (1 / 2-3 / 4+ lifetime FTL trips); clock_from / clock_to on sellable date; signup_from / signup_to on fact_leads signup_date; min_potential (app_potential >=, null as 0); ptl_cat (as_cx_ptl_stage.ptl_category group: 'PTL-NCR' = PTL-NCR, PTL-NCR-Not Intrested, PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS; 'Other tag'; 'Not tagged'); business_category (fact_leads.cx_business_category: 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)', 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER', or a single category). The Window filter does not apply.

  select consigner_user_code, min(case when trip_flag=1 then demand_date end)::date as t1,
  count(case when trip_flag=1 then 1 end) as ftl_trips, max(login_date)::date as last_login, max(consigner_region) as d_region

 lds as (select consigner_user_code, min(signup_date) as signup_date, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region,

  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 evo as (select user_code as cc, min(event_date)::date as po1 from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m
  where screen_name in ('ptl_home_page','ptl_pincode_input','ptl_package_details_input','ptl_service_type_input','ptl_select_transporter') group by 1),

  min(coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time))::date as first_rq,
  min(case when browsing_id not like 'D/%' then price_check_time end)::date as pc1,
  min(case when requirement_flag=1 then coalesce(price_check_time,demand_time) end)::date as rq1,
  min(case when demand_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as dm1,
  min(case when placement_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as pl1,
  min(case when trip_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as tr1
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements group by 1),

  select a.user_code, pc.cat as ptl_category,
  least(a.alloc_date, coalesce(o.po1, a.alloc_date), coalesce(r.first_rq, a.alloc_date), coalesce(k.first_bk, a.alloc_date)) as live_date,

  left join evo o on o.cc = a.user_code left join rq r on r.cc = a.user_code left join bk k on k.cc = a.user_code

  [[and (case when {{freshness}} = 'ALL (fresh + retro-fit)' then 1 when freshness = {{freshness}} then 1 else 0 end) = 1]]
  [[and app_active = {{app_active}}]]
  [[and ftl_trip_band = {{ftl_trips}}]]
  [[and clock >= {{clock_from}}]]
  [[and clock <= {{clock_to}}]]
  [[and signup_date >= {{signup_from}}]]
  [[and signup_date <= {{signup_to}}]]
  [[and app_potential >= {{min_potential}}]]
  [[and ptl_cat_group = {{ptl_cat}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else cx_business_category = {{business_category}} end)]]),
 d as (select 0 as d union all select 7 union all select 15 union all select 30 union all select 60 union all select 90 union all select 120 union all select 150 union all select 180 union all select 210 union all select 240 union all select 270 union all select 300 union all select 330 union all select 360 union all select 390 union all select 420 union all select 450 union all select 480 union all select 510 union all select 540 union all select 570 union all select 600 union all select 630 union all select 660 union all select 690 union all select 720)
 select 'Day ' || d.d || ' · n = ' || to_char(count(case when x.age >= d.d then 1 end), 'FM999,999') as day_label,
  d.d as days_since_sellable,
  count(case when x.age >= d.d then 1 end) as eligible_consignors,
  round(100.0*count(case when x.age >= d.d and po1 <= clock + d.d then 1 end)/nullif(count(case when x.age >= d.d then 1 end),0),2) as ptl_opened_pct,
  round(100.0*count(case when x.age >= d.d and pc1 <= clock + d.d then 1 end)/nullif(count(case when x.age >= d.d then 1 end),0),2) as price_check_pct,
  round(100.0*count(case when x.age >= d.d and dm1 <= clock + d.d then 1 end)/nullif(count(case when x.age >= d.d then 1 end),0),2) as demand_pct,
  round(100.0*count(case when x.age >= d.d and pl1 <= clock + d.d then 1 end)/nullif(count(case when x.age >= d.d then 1 end),0),2) as placement_pct,
  round(100.0*count(case when x.age >= d.d and tr1 <= clock + d.d then 1 end)/nullif(count(case when x.age >= d.d then 1 end),0),2) as trip_pct
 from x cross join d

Metric: 6a · Where they drop on the transporter listing — page funnel (requirements)
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > Motion 1 — conversion > card 51068
 
 Aliases: transporter listing page funnel; PTL rate-screen drop-off funnel; add-dimensions to slot-confirmed funnel.
 
 Requirement-level funnel of where APP PTL requirements drop on the transporter listing screen, from landing on the listing to slot confirmed (demand created), all months pooled.
 Formula: count of requirements reaching each cumulative step (each step requires all earlier ones): 1 landed (v1_ptl_estimate_rate); 2 tapped Add material dimensions (v1_ptl_add_material_dimensions); 3 dimensions submitted (v1_dimensions_submit and v1_ptl_submit on screen ptl_package_details_input); 4 Confirm tapped (v1_ptl_pickup_slot); 5 slot confirmed = demand created (v1_ptl_submit on screen ptl_select_transporter with miscellaneous containing 'tpt').
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements (requirement_flag = 1, channel 'APP', browsing_id not like 'D/%', price_check_time on/after the consignor's sellable date and on/after 2026-07-24; IST), fact_cx_events_l24m (event_date >= 2026-07-24, event_platform android / ios / web / mweb; min/max_timestamp UTC epoch microseconds shifted +5:30 to IST), fact_experiment_user_allocation (experiment_name 'SHOW_PTL', deleted = false; allocation date = UTC date of created), fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (first FTL trip = min demand_date with trip_flag = 1, FTL trips, last login_date), fact_leads (region, signup_date, cx_business_category, app_potential); grain requirement.
 Cohort: consignors with a live SHOW_PTL allocation, a first FTL trip and a fact_leads record; three internal test codes excluded. Sellable date = greatest(first FTL trip, allocation date), only >= 2026-04-01. Event-to-requirement matching: events of the same consignor whose time span overlaps the window from 10 minutes before the price check to the next requirement's price check, capped at 24 hours.
 Filters (all optional): region (fact_leads.consigner_region); freshness ('PTL live at FTL acquisition' = allocation date <= first FTL trip, 'FTL acquired before PTL live', 'ALL (fresh + retro-fit)'); app_active ('Active (30d)' = last login within 30 days, else 'Inactive'); ftl_trips band (1 / 2-3 / 4+); clock_from / clock_to on sellable date; signup_from / signup_to; min_potential (app_potential >=, null as 0); business_category ('SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)', 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER', or a single category). PTL-category and Window filters do not apply.
 Caveats: The event table is a daily aggregate with no session id, so matching events to a requirement by time window is directional, not exact. Covers APP requirements only, from 2026-07-24 (add-dimensions flow launch).
SQL:
with ftl as (
  select consigner_user_code, min(case when trip_flag=1 then demand_date end)::date as t1,
  count(case when trip_flag=1 then 1 end) as ftl_trips, max(login_date)::date as last_login
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1),
 alloc as (select user_code, min((timestamp 'epoch'+created/1000000*interval '1 second')::date) as alloc_date
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' and deleted=false group by 1),
 lds as (select consigner_user_code, min(signup_date) as signup_date, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region,
  max(cx_business_category) as cx_business_category, max(app_potential) as app_potential
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 b0 as (
  select a.user_code, greatest(f.t1,a.alloc_date) as clock,
  l.consigner_region, l.signup_date, l.cx_business_category, coalesce(l.app_potential,0) as app_potential,
  case when a.alloc_date - f.t1 <= 0 then 'PTL live at FTL acquisition' else 'FTL acquired before PTL live' end as freshness,
  case when current_date - f.last_login <= 30 then 'Active (30d)' else 'Inactive' end as app_active,
  case when f.ftl_trips = 1 then '1' when f.ftl_trips <= 3 then '2-3' else '4+' end as ftl_trip_band
  from alloc a join lds l on l.consigner_user_code=a.user_code join ftl f on f.consigner_user_code=a.user_code
  where f.t1 is not null and a.user_code not in ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979')
  and greatest(f.t1,a.alloc_date) >= '2026-04-01'),
 base as (
  select b0.*, current_date - clock as age from b0
  where 1=1
  [[and consigner_region = {{region}}]]
  [[and (case when {{freshness}} = 'ALL (fresh + retro-fit)' then 1 when freshness = {{freshness}} then 1 else 0 end) = 1]]
  [[and app_active = {{app_active}}]]
  [[and ftl_trip_band = {{ftl_trips}}]]
  [[and clock >= {{clock_from}}]]
  [[and clock <= {{clock_to}}]]
  [[and signup_date >= {{signup_from}}]]
  [[and signup_date <= {{signup_to}}]]
  [[and app_potential >= {{min_potential}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else cx_business_category = {{business_category}} end)]]),
 rq as (select r.browsing_id, b.clock, r.consigner_user_code as uc, r.price_check_time as t0,
  lead(r.price_check_time) over (partition by r.consigner_user_code order by r.price_check_time) as t_next
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements r join base b on b.user_code = r.consigner_user_code
  where r.requirement_flag = 1 and r.channel = 'APP' and r.browsing_id not like 'D/%'
  and r.price_check_time::date >= b.clock and r.price_check_time >= '2026-07-24'),
 w as (select browsing_id, clock, uc, t0 - interval '10 minute' as ws,
  least(coalesce(t_next, t0 + interval '24 hour'), t0 + interval '24 hour') as we from rq),
 ev as (select e.user_code as uc, e.event_name, e.screen_name, e.miscellaneous,
  timestamp 'epoch' + (e.min_timestamp/1000000)*interval '1 second' + interval '5:30' as ts_min,
  timestamp 'epoch' + (e.max_timestamp/1000000)*interval '1 second' + interval '5:30' as ts_max
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m e
  where e.event_date >= '2026-07-24' and e.event_platform in ('android','ios','web','mweb')
  and e.user_code in (select user_code from base)
  and e.event_name in ('v1_ptl_estimate_rate','v1_ptl_add_material_dimensions','v1_dimensions_submit','v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_pickup_slot')),
 f as (select w.browsing_id, max(w.clock) as clock,
  max(case when ev.event_name = 'v1_ptl_estimate_rate' then 1 else 0 end) as land,
  max(case when ev.event_name = 'v1_ptl_add_material_dimensions' then 1 else 0 end) as dcta,
  max(case when ev.event_name = 'v1_dimensions_submit' then 1 else 0 end) as dsingle,
  max(case when ev.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit' and ev.screen_name = 'ptl_package_details_input' then 1 else 0 end) as dpage,
  max(case when ev.event_name = 'v1_ptl_pickup_slot' then 1 else 0 end) as confirm,
  max(case when ev.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit' and ev.screen_name = 'ptl_select_transporter' and ev.miscellaneous ilike '%tpt%' then 1 else 0 end) as slotok
  from w left join ev on ev.uc = w.uc and ev.ts_max >= w.ws and ev.ts_min < w.we
  group by 1),
 s as (select clock, land as s1, land*dcta as s2, land*dcta*dsingle*dpage as s3, land*dcta*dsingle*dpage*confirm as s4, land*dcta*dsingle*dpage*confirm*slotok as s5 from f)
 select step, requirements from (
  select 1 as o, '1. Landed on transporter listing' as step, sum(s1) as requirements from s
  union all select 2, '2. Tapped Add material dimensions', sum(s2) from s
  union all select 3, '3. Dimensions submitted', sum(s3) from s
  union all select 4, '4. Confirm tapped', sum(s4) from s
  union all select 5, '5. Slot confirmed = demand created', sum(s5) from s) t
 order by o

 ev as (select e.user_code as uc, e.event_name, e.screen_name, e.miscellaneous,
  timestamp 'epoch' + (e.min_timestamp/1000000)*interval '1 second' + interval '5:30' as ts_min,
  timestamp 'epoch' + (e.max_timestamp/1000000)*interval '1 second' + interval '5:30' as ts_max
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m e
  where e.event_date >= '2026-07-24' and e.event_platform in ('android','ios','web','mweb')
  and e.user_code in (select user_code from base)
  and e.event_name in ('v1_ptl_estimate_rate','v1_ptl_add_material_dimensions','v1_dimensions_submit','v1_ptl_submit','v1_ptl_pickup_slot')),
 f as (select w.browsing_id, max(w.clock) as clock,
  max(case when ev.event_name = 'v1_ptl_estimate_rate' then 1 else 0 end) as land,
  max(case when ev.event_name = 'v1_ptl_add_material_dimensions' then 1 else 0 end) as dcta,
  max(case when ev.event_name = 'v1_dimensions_submit' then 1 else 0 end) as dsingle,
  max(case when ev.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit' and ev.screen_name = 'ptl_package_details_input' then 1 else 0 end) as dpage,
  max(case when ev.event_name = 'v1_ptl_pickup_slot' then 1 else 0 end) as confirm,
  max(case when ev.event_name = 'v1_ptl_submit' and ev.screen_name = 'ptl_select_transporter' and ev.miscellaneous ilike '%tpt%' then 1 else 0 end) as slotok
  from w left join ev on ev.uc = w.uc and ev.ts_max >= w.ws and ev.ts_min < w.we
  group by 1),
 s as (select clock, land as s1, land*dcta as s2, land*dcta*dsingle*dpage as s3, land*dcta*dsingle*dpage*confirm as s4, land*dcta*dsingle*dpage*confirm*slotok as s5 from f)
 select to_char(clock,'YYYY-MM') as month_became_sellable,
  sum(s1) as landed,
  round(100.0*sum(s2)/nullif(sum(s1),0),1) as add_dims_pct,
  round(100.0*sum(s3)/nullif(sum(s1),0),1) as dims_submitted_pct,
  round(100.0*sum(s4)/nullif(sum(s1),0),1) as confirm_pct,
  round(100.0*sum(s5)/nullif(sum(s1),0),1) as slot_confirmed_pct,
  sum(s2) as add_dims, sum(s3) as dims_submitted, sum(s4) as confirm, sum(s5) as slot_confirmed
 from s group by 1 having sum(s1) > 0 order by 1

Metric: 1b · Is it improving? Month-on-month — % who did each step within N days of becoming sellable (N = Window filter)
Meaning / Logic:

 Month-on-month % of PTL-live, FTL-acquired consignors who reached each PTL stage within N days of becoming sellable (N = Window), by the month they became sellable, base limited to consignors who have lived at least N days.
 Formula: per sellable month: n = count(consignors with current_date - sellable date >= win_days); stage % = count(of those with stage date <= sellable date + win_days) / n, for PTL opened, price check, demand, placement and trip. Output is long format: metric row ('1. Total users (lived N days)' = n, then '2. PTL opened %' to '6. Trip %') x month_became_sellable x value.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (experiment_name 'SHOW_PTL', deleted = false; allocation date = UTC date of created), fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (first FTL trip = min demand_date with trip_flag = 1, lifetime FTL trips, last login_date, region), fact_leads (signup_date, region fallback, cx_business_category, app_potential), fact_cx_events_l24m (PTL screen views), fact_ptl_requirements, fact_ptl_bookings, mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage; stage dates on coalesce(demand_time, price_check_time) (IST); grain consignor x sellable month.

PTL live date = earliest of allocation date, first PTL screen view (ptl_home_page, ptl_pincode_input, ptl_package_details_input, ptl_service_type_input, ptl_select_transporter), first fact_ptl_requirements row and first fact_ptl_bookings demand. Sellable date = greatest(first FTL trip, PTL live date); only sellable date >= 2026-04-01. Stages (first date per consignor): opened = PTL screen view; price check = fact_ptl_requirements row with browsing_id not like 'D/%' (price_check_time); demand = demand_flag = 1 (real + would-be) or any pre-2026 booking; placement = placement_flag = 1 or a pre-2026 picked-up booking; trip = trip_flag = 1 or a pre-2026 booking with pickup_done_time not null and status not EXPIRED/CANCELLED.

Optional: region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads); freshness ('PTL live at FTL acquisition' = live date <= first FTL trip, 'FTL acquired before PTL live', 'ALL (fresh + retro-fit)'); app_active ('Active (30d)' = last login within 30 days, else 'Inactive'); ftl_trips band (1 / 2-3 / 4+ lifetime FTL trips); clock_from / clock_to on sellable date; signup_from / signup_to on fact_leads signup_date; min_potential (app_potential >=, null as 0); ptl_cat (as_cx_ptl_stage.ptl_category group: 'PTL-NCR' = PTL-NCR, PTL-NCR-Not Intrested, PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS; 'Other tag'; 'Not tagged'); business_category (fact_leads.cx_business_category: 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)', 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER', or a single category).

SQL:
-- 1b v2 (19 Oct 2026, SuperPM): Is it improving? Month-on-month table — % of consignors who did each step within N days of becoming sellable.
 -- N = dashboard 'Window (days)' filter (win_days). Columns = month became sellable; rows = base + stage %.
 -- Base = consignors of that month who have lived >= N days since sellable (so young months are not understated).
 -- No maturity threshold (removed 19 Oct, SuperPM): every month shows; read the 'Total users (lived N days)' row as the sample size. Blank only if 0 consignors have lived N days.
 -- Day 0 includes PTL done before sellable (till-date v2 logic, same cohort as card 1 / 51026).
 -- REGION (15 Oct 2026): consigner_region from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (fallback fact_leads).
 -- PTL category: mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage; PTL-NCR = PTL-NCR + PTL-NCR-Not Intrested + PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS.
 -- PTL live date = EARLIEST of SHOW_PTL allocation OR first PTL activity; cohort requires SHOW_PTL; sellable = later of first FTL trip and live date.
 with ftl as (
  select consigner_user_code, min(case when trip_flag=1 then demand_date end)::date as t1,
  count(case when trip_flag=1 then 1 end) as ftl_trips, max(login_date)::date as last_login, max(consigner_region) as d_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1),
 alloc as (select user_code, min((timestamp 'epoch'+created/1000000*interval '1 second')::date) as alloc_date
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' and deleted=false group by 1),
 lds as (select consigner_user_code, min(signup_date) as signup_date, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region,
  max(cx_business_category) as cx_business_category, max(app_potential) as app_potential
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 evo as (select user_code as cc, min(event_date)::date as po1 from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m
  where screen_name in ('ptl_home_page','ptl_pincode_input','ptl_package_details_input','ptl_service_type_input','ptl_select_transporter') group by 1),
 rq as (select consigner_user_code as cc,
  min(coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time))::date as first_rq,
  min(case when browsing_id not like 'D/%' then price_check_time end)::date as pc1,
  min(case when demand_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as dm1,
  min(case when placement_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as pl1,
  min(case when trip_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as tr1
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements group by 1),
 bk as (select consigner_user_code as cc, min(demand_time)::date as first_bk,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' then demand_time end)::date as dm0,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' and pickup_done_time is not null and coalesce(demand_status,'') not in ('EXPIRED','CANCELLED') then demand_time end)::date as tr0
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings group by 1),
 pcat as (select consigner_user_code as cc, max(ptl_category) as cat
  from mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 b0 as (
  select a.user_code, pc.cat as ptl_category,
  least(a.alloc_date, coalesce(o.po1, a.alloc_date), coalesce(r.first_rq, a.alloc_date), coalesce(k.first_bk, a.alloc_date)) as live_date,
  f.t1, f.ftl_trips, f.last_login,
  coalesce(f.d_region, l.consigner_region) as consigner_region, l.signup_date, l.cx_business_category, coalesce(l.app_potential,0) as app_potential,
  o.po1, r.pc1, least(r.dm1, k.dm0) as dm1, least(r.pl1, k.tr0) as pl1, least(r.tr1, k.tr0) as tr1
  from alloc a join ftl f on f.consigner_user_code=a.user_code left join lds l on l.consigner_user_code=a.user_code
  left join evo o on o.cc = a.user_code left join rq r on r.cc = a.user_code left join bk k on k.cc = a.user_code
  left join pcat pc on pc.cc = a.user_code
  where f.t1 is not null and a.user_code not in ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979')),
 b1 as (
  select b0.*, greatest(t1, live_date) as clock,
  case when ptl_category in ('PTL-NCR','PTL-NCR-Not Intrested','PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS') then 'PTL-NCR'
  when ptl_category is not null then 'Other tag' else 'Not tagged' end as ptl_cat_group,
  case when live_date - t1 <= 0 then 'PTL live at FTL acquisition' else 'FTL acquired before PTL live' end as freshness,
  case when current_date - last_login <= 30 then 'Active (30d)' else 'Inactive' end as app_active,
  case when ftl_trips = 1 then '1' when ftl_trips <= 3 then '2-3' else '4+' end as ftl_trip_band
  from b0 where greatest(t1, live_date) >= '2026-04-01'),
 x as (
  select b1.*, current_date - clock as age from b1
  where 1=1
  [[and consigner_region = {{region}}]]
  [[and (case when {{freshness}} = 'ALL (fresh + retro-fit)' then 1 when freshness = {{freshness}} then 1 else 0 end) = 1]]
  [[and app_active = {{app_active}}]]
  [[and ftl_trip_band = {{ftl_trips}}]]
  [[and clock >= {{clock_from}}]]
  [[and clock <= {{clock_to}}]]
  [[and signup_date >= {{signup_from}}]]
  [[and signup_date <= {{signup_to}}]]
  [[and app_potential >= {{min_potential}}]]
  [[and ptl_cat_group = {{ptl_cat}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else cx_business_category = {{business_category}} end)]]),
 m as (
  select to_char(clock,'YYYY-MM') as mon,
  count(*) as n_all,
  count(case when age >= {{win_days}} then 1 end) as n,
  count(case when age >= {{win_days}} and po1 <= clock + {{win_days}} then 1 end) as c_open,
  count(case when age >= {{win_days}} and pc1 <= clock + {{win_days}} then 1 end) as c_pc,
  count(case when age >= {{win_days}} and dm1 <= clock + {{win_days}} then 1 end) as c_dm,
  count(case when age >= {{win_days}} and pl1 <= clock + {{win_days}} then 1 end) as c_pl,
  count(case when age >= {{win_days}} and tr1 <= clock + {{win_days}} then 1 end) as c_tr
  from x group by 1),
 mm as (select m.* from m),
 k as (select 1 as k union all select 2 union all select 3 union all select 4 union all select 5 union all select 6)
 select
  case k when 1 then '1. Total users (lived N days)'
  when 2 then '2. PTL opened %'
  when 3 then '3. Price check %'
  when 4 then '4. Demand %'
  when 5 then '5. Placement %'
  else '6. Trip %' end as metric,
  mon as month_became_sellable,
  case when k = 1 then n::numeric
  else round(100.0 * case k when 2 then c_open when 3 then c_pc when 4 then c_dm when 5 then c_pl else c_tr end / nullif(n,0), 1) end as value
 from mm cross join k
 order by 1, 2

 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (experiment_name 'SHOW_PTL', deleted = false; allocation date = UTC date of created), fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (first FTL trip = min demand_date with trip_flag = 1, lifetime FTL trips, last login_date, region), fact_leads (signup_date, region fallback, cx_business_category, app_potential), fact_cx_events_l24m (PTL screen views), fact_ptl_requirements, fact_ptl_bookings, mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage (ptl_category); stage dates on coalesce(demand_time, price_check_time) (IST); grain consignor.

PTL live date = earliest of allocation date, first PTL screen view (ptl_home_page, ptl_pincode_input, ptl_package_details_input, ptl_service_type_input, ptl_select_transporter), first fact_ptl_requirements row and first fact_ptl_bookings demand. PTL-relevant = ptl_category in PTL-NCR, PTL-NCR-Not Intrested, PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS.
