SQL:
-- REGION (15 Oct 2026): consigner_region from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (fallback fact_leads); consignors missing from fact_leads are no longer dropped.
 -- 0 · Headline funnel (15 Oct 2026): All sellable consignors vs PTL-relevant (calling tag PTL-NCR), till date.
 -- Same cohort + v2 logic as card 1 (51026): PTL live date = earliest of PTL-live flag / first PTL open / price check / booking; sellable = later of first FTL trip and that date.
 -- Stages are till date (any time from the PTL live date), so they include PTL used before the first FTL trip.
 -- PTL relevant = mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage.ptl_category in (PTL-NCR, PTL-NCR-Not Intrested, PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS). Tags mostly follow a PTL price check.
 -- Time window: use the Sellable from / to filters (with 'PTL live at FTL acquisition', sellable date = first FTL trip date).
 with ftl as (
  select consigner_user_code, min(case when trip_flag=1 then demand_date end)::date as t1,
  count(case when trip_flag=1 then 1 end) as ftl_trips, max(login_date)::date as last_login, max(consigner_region) as d_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1),
 alloc as (select user_code, min((timestamp 'epoch'+created/1000000*interval '1 second')::date) as alloc_date
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' and deleted=false group by 1),
 lds as (select consigner_user_code, min(signup_date) as signup_date, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region,
  max(cx_business_category) as cx_business_category, max(app_potential) as app_potential
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 evo as (select user_code as cc, min(event_date)::date as po1 from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m
  where screen_name in ('ptl_home_page','ptl_pincode_input','ptl_package_details_input','ptl_service_type_input','ptl_select_transporter') group by 1),
 rq as (select consigner_user_code as cc,
  min(coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time))::date as first_rq,
  min(case when browsing_id not like 'D/%' then price_check_time end)::date as pc1,
  min(case when requirement_flag=1 then coalesce(price_check_time,demand_time) end)::date as rq1,
  min(case when demand_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as dm1,
  min(case when placement_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as pl1,
  min(case when trip_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as tr1
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements group by 1),
 bk as (select consigner_user_code as cc, min(demand_time)::date as first_bk,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' then demand_time end)::date as dm0,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' and pickup_done_time is not null and coalesce(demand_status,'') not in ('EXPIRED','CANCELLED') then demand_time end)::date as tr0
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings group by 1),
 pcat as (select consigner_user_code as cc, max(ptl_category) as cat
  from mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 b0 as (
  select a.user_code, pc.cat as ptl_category,
  least(a.alloc_date, coalesce(o.po1, a.alloc_date), coalesce(r.first_rq, a.alloc_date), coalesce(k.first_bk, a.alloc_date)) as live_date,
  f.t1, f.ftl_trips, f.last_login,
  coalesce(f.d_region, l.consigner_region) as consigner_region, l.signup_date, l.cx_business_category, coalesce(l.app_potential,0) as app_potential,
  o.po1, r.pc1, r.rq1, least(r.dm1, k.dm0) as dm1, least(r.pl1, k.tr0) as pl1, least(r.tr1, k.tr0) as tr1
  from alloc a join ftl f on f.consigner_user_code=a.user_code left join lds l on l.consigner_user_code=a.user_code
  left join evo o on o.cc = a.user_code left join rq r on r.cc = a.user_code left join bk k on k.cc = a.user_code
  left join pcat pc on pc.cc = a.user_code
  where f.t1 is not null and a.user_code not in ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979')),
 b1 as (
  select b0.*, greatest(t1, live_date) as clock,
  case when ptl_category in ('PTL-NCR','PTL-NCR-Not Intrested','PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS') then 'PTL-NCR'
  when ptl_category is not null then 'Other tag' else 'Not tagged' end as ptl_cat_group,
  case when live_date - t1 <= 0 then 'PTL live at FTL acquisition' else 'FTL acquired before PTL live' end as freshness,
  case when live_date - t1 <= 0 then 'A. PTL live at FTL acquisition (fresh)'
  when live_date - t1 <= 90 then 'B. FTL acquired 0-90d before PTL live'
  when live_date - t1 <= 365 then 'C. FTL acquired 91-365d before PTL live'
  else 'D. FTL acquired 365d+ before PTL live' end as freshness_bucket,
  case when current_date - last_login <= 30 then 'Active (30d)' else 'Inactive' end as app_active,
  case when ftl_trips = 1 then '1' when ftl_trips <= 3 then '2-3' else '4+' end as ftl_trip_band
  from b0 where greatest(t1, live_date) >= '2026-04-01'),
 x as (
  select b1.*, current_date - clock as age from b1
  where 1=1
  [[and consigner_region = {{region}}]]
  [[and (case when {{freshness}} = 'ALL (fresh + retro-fit)' then 1 when freshness = {{freshness}} then 1 else 0 end) = 1]]
  [[and app_active = {{app_active}}]]
  [[and ftl_trip_band = {{ftl_trips}}]]
  [[and clock >= {{clock_from}}]]
  [[and clock <= {{clock_to}}]]
  [[and signup_date >= {{signup_from}}]]
  [[and signup_date <= {{signup_to}}]]
  [[and app_potential >= {{min_potential}}]]
  [[and ptl_cat_group = {{ptl_cat}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else cx_business_category = {{business_category}} end)]]),
 agg as (
  select count(*) as b_all, count(po1) as o_all, count(pc1) as pc_all, count(dm1) as dm_all, count(pl1) as pl_all, count(tr1) as tr_all,
  count(case when ptl_cat_group='PTL-NCR' then 1 end) as b_r,
  count(case when ptl_cat_group='PTL-NCR' and po1 is not null then 1 end) as o_r,
  count(case when ptl_cat_group='PTL-NCR' and pc1 is not null then 1 end) as pc_r,
  count(case when ptl_cat_group='PTL-NCR' and dm1 is not null then 1 end) as dm_r,
  count(case when ptl_cat_group='PTL-NCR' and pl1 is not null then 1 end) as pl_r,
  count(case when ptl_cat_group='PTL-NCR' and tr1 is not null then 1 end) as tr_r
  from x),
 st as (select 1 as o union all select 2 union all select 3 union all select 4 union all select 5 union all select 6)
 select case st.o when 1 then '1. Sellable (PTL live + FTL acquired) - base'
  when 2 then '2. Ever opened PTL'
  when 3 then '3. Ever price-checked'
  when 4 then '4. Ever raised a demand (incl. would-be)'
  when 5 then '5. Ever placed'
  else '6. Ever took a PTL trip (ACQUIRED)' end as stage,
  case st.o when 1 then b_all when 2 then o_all when 3 then pc_all when 4 then dm_all when 5 then pl_all else tr_all end as all_users,
  case when st.o = 1 then null else round(100.0 * case st.o when 2 then o_all when 3 then pc_all when 4 then dm_all when 5 then pl_all else tr_all end / nullif(b_all,0), 1) end as pct_of_all_users,
  case st.o when 1 then b_r when 2 then o_r when 3 then pc_r when 4 then dm_r when 5 then pl_r else tr_r end as ptl_relevant,
  round(100.0 * case st.o when 1 then b_r when 2 then o_r when 3 then pc_r when 4 then dm_r when 5 then pl_r else tr_r end
  / nullif(case when st.o = 1 then b_all else b_r end, 0), 1) as pct_of_ptl_relevant
 from agg cross join st
 order by st.o

Metric: R1 · Retention cohort (NCR A/B) — lifetime PTL funnel: Requirement → Demand → Placement → Trip, Test vs Control
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > Retention cohort (A/B) > card 51031
 
 Aliases: NCR retention A/B PTL funnel; retention cohort Test vs Control funnel; lifetime PTL funnel for retention cohort.
 
 Lifetime PTL funnel (opened, requirement, demand, placement, trip) for one arm of the NCR FTL-retention A/B cohort, shown for three activity bases: active till date, active in last 60 days, active in last 30 days.
 Formula: for each base (till date / 60d / 30d): base = count(active consignors); stage count = count(active consignors who ever reached the stage); pct = stage / base; step = stage / previous stage (opened step = opened / base). '2. Ever opened PTL' carries target_step_pct = 65 and step_gap_30d = 30-day step - 65.
 Source: analytics.ptl_ab_testing_27july2026 (code, ab_group), mp_analytics_core.as_trip_payments (first FTL trip: ptl_flag = 0, trip_rank = 1, demand_time >= 2026-01-01), consigner_app_events_current_v2 (min_timestamp UTC epoch microseconds shifted +5:30 to IST; last 240 days), mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements (price_check_time / demand_time, IST); grain consignor.
 Cohort: consignors in analytics.ptl_ab_testing_27july2026 for the chosen arm whose first FTL trip is on/after 2026-01-01. Active till date = any app event in the 240-day lookback, or any PTL price check or demand; active 60d / 30d = last app event, last price check or last demand within 60 / 30 days. Stages (lifetime): opened = PTL screen event (ptl_home_page, ptl_pincode_input, ptl_package_details_input, ptl_service_type_input, ptl_select_transporter); requirement = requirement_flag = 1; demand = demand_flag = 1 (real + would-be); placement = placement_flag = 1 (booked + paid); trip = trip_flag = 1 (acquired). Stage counts are restricted to consignors in the respective active base.
 Filters: ab_group (Cohort arm, required: Test or Control). No region or date filters; the cohort table is the NCR retention cohort.
 Caveats: App-event signals (activity and PTL opened) only look back 240 days. PTL stages come only from fact_ptl_requirements, which starts in Jan 2026; pre-2026 PTL bookings are not counted.
SQL:
WITH ts AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.consigner_user_code AS cc FROM mp_analytics_core.as_trip_payments a
  JOIN analytics.ptl_ab_testing_27july2026 b ON b.code=a.consigner_user_code AND b.ab_group={{ab_group}}
  WHERE a.ptl_flag=0 AND a.trip_rank=1 AND a.demand_time::date>='2026-01-01'),
 ev AS (SELECT e.user_code AS cc,
  MAX(TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (e.min_timestamp/1000000)*INTERVAL '1 second' + INTERVAL '5:30') AS last_app,
  MAX(CASE WHEN e.screen_name IN ('ptl_home_page','ptl_pincode_input','ptl_package_details_input','ptl_service_type_input','ptl_select_transporter')
  THEN TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (e.min_timestamp/1000000)*INTERVAL '1 second' + INTERVAL '5:30' END) AS last_open
  FROM consigner_app_events_current_v2 e JOIN ts ON ts.cc = e.user_code
  WHERE TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (e.min_timestamp/1000000)*INTERVAL '1 second' + INTERVAL '5:30' >= CURRENT_DATE-240
  GROUP BY 1),
 -- PTL funnel from fact_ptl_requirements (demand = real + would-be)
 s AS (SELECT r.consigner_user_code AS cc,
  MAX(r.price_check_time) AS last_pc,
  MAX(CASE WHEN r.requirement_flag=1 THEN r.price_check_time END) AS last_rq,
  MAX(CASE WHEN r.demand_flag=1 THEN COALESCE(r.demand_time,r.price_check_time) END) AS last_dm,
  MAX(CASE WHEN r.placement_flag=1 THEN COALESCE(r.demand_time,r.price_check_time) END) AS last_pl,
  MAX(CASE WHEN r.trip_flag=1 THEN COALESCE(r.demand_time,r.price_check_time) END) AS last_tr
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements r JOIN ts ON ts.cc=r.consigner_user_code GROUP BY 1),
 u AS (SELECT t.cc,
  CASE WHEN ev.last_app IS NOT NULL OR s.last_pc IS NOT NULL OR s.last_dm IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS a_all,
  CASE WHEN ev.last_app >= CURRENT_DATE-60 OR s.last_pc >= CURRENT_DATE-60 OR s.last_dm >= CURRENT_DATE-60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS a_60,
  CASE WHEN ev.last_app >= CURRENT_DATE-30 OR s.last_pc >= CURRENT_DATE-30 OR s.last_dm >= CURRENT_DATE-30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS a_30,
  CASE WHEN ev.last_open IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS o,
  CASE WHEN s.last_rq IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rq,
  CASE WHEN s.last_dm IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS dm,
  CASE WHEN s.last_pl IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pl,
  CASE WHEN s.last_tr IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tr
  FROM ts t LEFT JOIN ev ON ev.cc=t.cc LEFT JOIN s ON s.cc=t.cc),
 agg AS (SELECT SUM(a_all) b_all, SUM(a_all*o) o_all, SUM(a_all*rq) rq_all, SUM(a_all*dm) dm_all, SUM(a_all*pl) pl_all, SUM(a_all*tr) tr_all,
  SUM(a_60) b_60, SUM(a_60*o) o_60, SUM(a_60*rq) rq_60, SUM(a_60*dm) dm_60, SUM(a_60*pl) pl_60, SUM(a_60*tr) tr_60,
  SUM(a_30) b_30, SUM(a_30*o) o_30, SUM(a_30*rq) rq_30, SUM(a_30*dm) dm_30, SUM(a_30*pl) pl_30, SUM(a_30*tr) tr_30 FROM u)
 SELECT '1. Active (base - capped by window)' AS stage, b_all AS till_date, ROUND(100.0*b_all/NULLIF(b_all,0),1) AS till_pct, NULL::numeric AS till_step, b_60 AS last_60_days, ROUND(100.0*b_60/NULLIF(b_60,0),1) AS pct_60d, NULL::numeric AS step_60d, b_30 AS last_30_days, ROUND(100.0*b_30/NULLIF(b_30,0),1) AS pct_30d, NULL::numeric AS step_30d, NULL::numeric AS target_step_pct, NULL::numeric AS step_gap_30d FROM agg
 UNION ALL SELECT '2. Ever opened PTL', o_all, ROUND(100.0*o_all/NULLIF(b_all,0),1), ROUND(100.0*o_all/NULLIF(b_all,0),1), o_60, ROUND(100.0*o_60/NULLIF(b_60,0),1), ROUND(100.0*o_60/NULLIF(b_60,0),1), o_30, ROUND(100.0*o_30/NULLIF(b_30,0),1), ROUND(100.0*o_30/NULLIF(b_30,0),1), 65.0, ROUND(100.0*o_30/NULLIF(b_30,0)-65.0,1) FROM agg
 UNION ALL SELECT '3. Ever raised a requirement', rq_all, ROUND(100.0*rq_all/NULLIF(b_all,0),1), ROUND(100.0*rq_all/NULLIF(o_all,0),1), rq_60, ROUND(100.0*rq_60/NULLIF(b_60,0),1), ROUND(100.0*rq_60/NULLIF(o_60,0),1), rq_30, ROUND(100.0*rq_30/NULLIF(b_30,0),1), ROUND(100.0*rq_30/NULLIF(o_30,0),1), NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric FROM agg
 UNION ALL SELECT '4. Ever created a demand (incl. would-be)', dm_all, ROUND(100.0*dm_all/NULLIF(b_all,0),1), ROUND(100.0*dm_all/NULLIF(rq_all,0),1), dm_60, ROUND(100.0*dm_60/NULLIF(b_60,0),1), ROUND(100.0*dm_60/NULLIF(rq_60,0),1), dm_30, ROUND(100.0*dm_30/NULLIF(b_30,0),1), ROUND(100.0*dm_30/NULLIF(rq_30,0),1), NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric FROM agg
 UNION ALL SELECT '5. Ever placed (booked + paid)', pl_all, ROUND(100.0*pl_all/NULLIF(b_all,0),1), ROUND(100.0*pl_all/NULLIF(dm_all,0),1), pl_60, ROUND(100.0*pl_60/NULLIF(b_60,0),1), ROUND(100.0*pl_60/NULLIF(dm_60,0),1), pl_30, ROUND(100.0*pl_30/NULLIF(b_30,0),1), ROUND(100.0*pl_30/NULLIF(dm_30,0),1), NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric FROM agg
 UNION ALL SELECT '6. Ever took a PTL trip (ACQUIRED)', tr_all, ROUND(100.0*tr_all/NULLIF(b_all,0),1), ROUND(100.0*tr_all/NULLIF(pl_all,0),1), tr_60, ROUND(100.0*tr_60/NULLIF(b_60,0),1), ROUND(100.0*tr_60/NULLIF(pl_60,0),1), tr_30, ROUND(100.0*tr_30/NULLIF(b_30,0),1), ROUND(100.0*tr_30/NULLIF(pl_30,0),1), NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric FROM agg
 ORDER BY 1

Metric: R2 · Retention cohort (NCR A/B) — consignor list (one row per consignor, same logic as R1)
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > Retention cohort (A/B) > card 51175
 
 Aliases: NCR retention A/B consignor list; retention cohort PTL stage list; Test vs Control consignor-level PTL funnel.
 
 One row per consignor in the chosen arm of the NCR FTL-retention A/B cohort, with activity flags, furthest PTL stage and first/last PTL milestone dates.
 Formula: list, no aggregation. furthest_ptl_stage = highest of 5 PTL trip (acquired), 4 placed no trip, 3 demand not placed, 2 requirement no demand, 1 opened PTL only, 0 no PTL activity. active_till_date / active_60d / active_30d = 'Yes' when any app event (240-day lookback), PTL price check or PTL demand falls in the window. Counts: requirements = count(requirement_flag = 1), ptl_trips = count(trip_flag = 1).
 Source: analytics.ptl_ab_testing_27july2026 (code, ab_group), mp_analytics_core.as_trip_payments (first FTL trip = min demand_time with ptl_flag = 0, trip_rank = 1, on/after 2026-01-01), consigner_app_events_current_v2 (min_timestamp UTC epoch microseconds shifted +5:30 to IST; last 240 days), mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements (price_check_time / demand_time, IST), mp_analytics_core.fact_leads (region, city, cx_business_category); grain consignor.
 Columns: consigner_user_code, cohort_arm, region, city, business_category, first_ftl_trip, last_app_event, active flags, furthest_ptl_stage, first/last PTL open (PTL screens ptl_home_page, ptl_pincode_input, ptl_package_details_input, ptl_service_type_input, ptl_select_transporter), first requirement, last price check, first demand (real + would-be), first placement, first PTL trip, requirements, ptl_trips. Sorted by first PTL trip, placement, demand, requirement (earliest first, nulls last), then 30-day active first.
 Filters: ab_group (Cohort arm, required: Test or Control). Filtering active_30d = 'Yes' gives the last-30-day active base.
 Caveats: Row-level list; volt returns aggregates only. App-event signals (activity, PTL open dates) only look back 240 days. PTL stages come only from fact_ptl_requirements, which starts in Jan 2026.
SQL:
-- R2 · Retention cohort (NCR A/B) — consignor list (9 Oct 2026). Same population and logic as R1 (card 51031), one row per consignor.
 -- Cohort = analytics.ptl_ab_testing_27july2026 arm {{ab_group}}, first FTL trip (as_trip_payments, trip_rank 1) on/after 1 Jan 2026.
 -- Active flags = app event (consigner_app_events_current_v2, last 240 days) OR PTL price check OR PTL demand in the window — identical to R1, so
 -- filtering active_30d = 'Yes' reproduces R1's last_30_days column. Stages are lifetime ('ever') from fact_ptl_requirements (demand = real + would-be).
 WITH ts AS (SELECT a.consigner_user_code AS cc, MIN(a.demand_time)::date AS first_ftl_trip, MAX(b.ab_group) AS ab_group
  FROM mp_analytics_core.as_trip_payments a
  JOIN analytics.ptl_ab_testing_27july2026 b ON b.code=a.consigner_user_code AND b.ab_group={{ab_group}}
  WHERE a.ptl_flag=0 AND a.trip_rank=1 AND a.demand_time::date>='2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1),
 ev AS (SELECT e.user_code AS cc,
  MAX(TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (e.min_timestamp/1000000)*INTERVAL '1 second' + INTERVAL '5:30') AS last_app,
  MIN(CASE WHEN e.screen_name IN ('ptl_home_page','ptl_pincode_input','ptl_package_details_input','ptl_service_type_input','ptl_select_transporter')
  THEN TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (e.min_timestamp/1000000)*INTERVAL '1 second' + INTERVAL '5:30' END) AS first_open,
  MAX(CASE WHEN e.screen_name IN ('ptl_home_page','ptl_pincode_input','ptl_package_details_input','ptl_service_type_input','ptl_select_transporter')
  THEN TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (e.min_timestamp/1000000)*INTERVAL '1 second' + INTERVAL '5:30' END) AS last_open
  FROM consigner_app_events_current_v2 e JOIN ts ON ts.cc = e.user_code
  WHERE TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (e.min_timestamp/1000000)*INTERVAL '1 second' + INTERVAL '5:30' >= CURRENT_DATE-240
  GROUP BY 1),
 s AS (SELECT r.consigner_user_code AS cc,
  MAX(r.price_check_time) AS last_pc,
  MIN(CASE WHEN r.requirement_flag=1 THEN r.price_check_time END) AS first_rq,
  MIN(CASE WHEN r.demand_flag=1 THEN COALESCE(r.demand_time,r.price_check_time) END) AS first_dm,
  MAX(CASE WHEN r.demand_flag=1 THEN COALESCE(r.demand_time,r.price_check_time) END) AS last_dm,
  MIN(CASE WHEN r.placement_flag=1 THEN COALESCE(r.demand_time,r.price_check_time) END) AS first_pl,
  MIN(CASE WHEN r.trip_flag=1 THEN COALESCE(r.demand_time,r.price_check_time) END) AS first_tr,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN r.requirement_flag=1 THEN 1 END) AS n_requirements,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN r.trip_flag=1 THEN 1 END) AS n_ptl_trips
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements r JOIN ts ON ts.cc=r.consigner_user_code GROUP BY 1),
 l AS (SELECT consigner_user_code AS cc, MAX(consigner_region) AS region, MAX(consigner_city) AS city, MAX(cx_business_category) AS business_category
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_leads WHERE consigner_user_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1)
 SELECT t.cc AS consigner_user_code, t.ab_group AS cohort_arm,
  l.region, l.city, l.business_category,
  t.first_ftl_trip,
  ev.last_app::date AS last_app_event,
  CASE WHEN ev.last_app IS NOT NULL OR s.last_pc IS NOT NULL OR s.last_dm IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS active_till_date,
  CASE WHEN ev.last_app >= CURRENT_DATE-60 OR s.last_pc >= CURRENT_DATE-60 OR s.last_dm >= CURRENT_DATE-60 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS active_60d,
  CASE WHEN ev.last_app >= CURRENT_DATE-30 OR s.last_pc >= CURRENT_DATE-30 OR s.last_dm >= CURRENT_DATE-30 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS active_30d,
  CASE WHEN s.first_tr IS NOT NULL THEN '5. PTL trip (acquired)'
  WHEN s.first_pl IS NOT NULL THEN '4. Placed, no trip'
  WHEN s.first_dm IS NOT NULL THEN '3. Demand, not placed'
  WHEN s.first_rq IS NOT NULL THEN '2. Requirement, no demand'
  WHEN ev.first_open IS NOT NULL THEN '1. Opened PTL only'
  ELSE '0. No PTL activity' END AS furthest_ptl_stage,
  ev.first_open::date AS first_ptl_open, ev.last_open::date AS last_ptl_open,
  s.first_rq::date AS first_requirement, s.last_pc::date AS last_price_check,
  s.first_dm::date AS first_demand, s.first_pl::date AS first_placement, s.first_tr::date AS first_ptl_trip,
  COALESCE(s.n_requirements,0) AS requirements, COALESCE(s.n_ptl_trips,0) AS ptl_trips
 FROM ts t LEFT JOIN ev ON ev.cc=t.cc LEFT JOIN s ON s.cc=t.cc LEFT JOIN l ON l.cc=t.cc
 ORDER BY first_ptl_trip ASC NULLS LAST, first_placement ASC NULLS LAST, first_demand ASC NULLS LAST, first_requirement ASC NULLS LAST,
  CASE WHEN ev.last_app >= CURRENT_DATE-30 OR s.last_pc >= CURRENT_DATE-30 OR s.last_dm >= CURRENT_DATE-30 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.cc

Metric: A1 · Sanity — market → PTL coverage (by FTL acquisition month) — v2 logic
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > Appendix — setup & sanity > card 51173
 
 Aliases: market to PTL coverage; PTL coverage of new FTL consignors; FTL acquisition month PTL sanity.
 
 For every newly FTL-acquired consignor, by month of first FTL trip: how many had PTL live (in the chosen freshness scope) and how many of those opened PTL, price-checked, raised a demand and took a PTL trip.
 Formula: per FTL acquisition month: new_ftl_consignors = count(all); ptl_live_selected = count(in scope); pct_ptl_live = in scope / all; ptl_opened, price_checked, ptl_demands, ptl_acquired = count(in scope with stage ever), each % = / in scope (no % for demands); matured_30d = count(in scope with current_date - sellable date >= 30); ptl_acquired_d30_pct = count(matured with first PTL trip <= sellable date + 30) / matured_30d.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (first FTL trip = min demand_date with trip_flag = 1, FTL trips, last login_date, region), fact_experiment_user_allocation (experiment_name 'SHOW_PTL', deleted = false; allocation date = UTC date of created), fact_leads (signup_date, region fallback, cx_business_category, app_potential), fact_cx_events_l24m (PTL screen views), fact_ptl_requirements, fact_ptl_bookings; stage dates on coalesce(demand_time, price_check_time) (IST); row month on first FTL trip date; grain consignor x FTL acquisition month.
 Definitions: base = consignors with first FTL trip on/after 2026-04-01; three internal test codes excluded. PTL live date = earliest of allocation date, first PTL screen view (ptl_home_page, ptl_pincode_input, ptl_package_details_input, ptl_service_type_input, ptl_select_transporter), first fact_ptl_requirements row and first fact_ptl_bookings demand. Sellable date = greatest(first FTL trip, PTL live date). In scope = has a live SHOW_PTL allocation and matches freshness. Stages: opened = PTL screen view; price check = fact_ptl_requirements row with browsing_id not like 'D/%'; demand = demand_flag = 1 (real + would-be) or any pre-2026 booking; trip = trip_flag = 1 or a pre-2026 booking with pickup_done_time not null and status not EXPIRED/CANCELLED.
 Filters: freshness (required: 'PTL live at FTL acquisition' = live date <= first FTL trip; 'FTL acquired before PTL live' = live date after first FTL trip; any other value = every allocated consignor); affects only in-scope columns. Optional: region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads); app_active ('Active (30d)' = last login within 30 days, else 'Inactive'); ftl_trips band (1 / 2-3 / 4+); clock_from / clock_to applied to first FTL trip date; signup_from / signup_to; min_potential (app_potential >=, null as 0); business_category ('SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)', 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER', or a single category). PTL-category and Window filters do not apply.
 Caveats: new_ftl_consignors is the whole market and never moves with the freshness filter. Stages are till date, including PTL use before the first FTL trip.
SQL:
-- REGION (15 Oct 2026): consigner_region from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (fallback fact_leads); consignors missing from fact_leads are no longer dropped.
 -- A1 v2 (9 Oct 2026): market -> PTL coverage by FTL acquisition month, on the Motion 1 v2 logic.
 -- PTL live date = EARLIEST of SHOW_PTL allocation OR first PTL activity (PTL open, price check, booking); cohort still needs the SHOW_PTL flag.
 -- Stages are till date from the PTL live date (= every PTL event). Opened from fact_cx_events_l24m; price check / demand (real + would-be) / trip from fact_ptl_requirements; pre-2026 bookings feed demand / trip.
 -- new_ftl_consignors = whole market; moves only with region / business category / potential / signup / app / trip-depth / FTL-acq-date filters, never with the PTL filter.
 with alloc as (select user_code, min((timestamp 'epoch'+created/1000000*interval '1 second')::date) as alloc_date
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  where experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' and deleted=false group by 1),
 ftl as (select consigner_user_code, min(case when trip_flag=1 then demand_date end)::date as t1,
  count(case when trip_flag=1 then 1 end) as ftl_trips, max(login_date)::date as last_login, max(consigner_region) as d_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1),
 l as (select consigner_user_code, min(signup_date) as signup_date, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region,
  max(cx_business_category) as cx_business_category, max(app_potential) as app_potential
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 evo as (select user_code as cc, min(event_date)::date as po1 from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m
  where screen_name in ('ptl_home_page','ptl_pincode_input','ptl_package_details_input','ptl_service_type_input','ptl_select_transporter') group by 1),
 rq as (select consigner_user_code as cc,
  min(coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time))::date as first_rq,
  min(case when browsing_id not like 'D/%' then price_check_time end)::date as pc1,
  min(case when demand_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as dm1,
  min(case when trip_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as tr1
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements group by 1),
 bk as (select consigner_user_code as cc, min(demand_time)::date as first_bk,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' then demand_time end)::date as dm0,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' and pickup_done_time is not null and coalesce(demand_status,'') not in ('EXPIRED','CANCELLED') then demand_time end)::date as tr0
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings group by 1),
 base as (
  select f.t1, a.alloc_date,
  least(a.alloc_date, coalesce(o.po1, a.alloc_date), coalesce(r.first_rq, a.alloc_date), coalesce(k.first_bk, a.alloc_date)) as live_date,
  o.po1, r.pc1, least(r.dm1, k.dm0) as dm1, least(r.tr1, k.tr0) as tr1,
  coalesce(f.d_region, l.consigner_region) as consigner_region, l.signup_date, l.cx_business_category, coalesce(l.app_potential,0) as app_potential,
  case when current_date - f.last_login <= 30 then 'Active (30d)' else 'Inactive' end as app_active,
  case when f.ftl_trips = 1 then '1' when f.ftl_trips <= 3 then '2-3' else '4+' end as ftl_trip_band
  from ftl f left join l on l.consigner_user_code=f.consigner_user_code
  left join alloc a on a.user_code=f.consigner_user_code
  left join evo o on o.cc=f.consigner_user_code
  left join rq r on r.cc=f.consigner_user_code
  left join bk k on k.cc=f.consigner_user_code
  where f.t1 >= '2026-04-01'
  and f.consigner_user_code not in ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979')),
 b2 as (
  select base.*, greatest(t1, live_date) as clock,
  case when alloc_date is null then 0
  when {{freshness}} = 'PTL live at FTL acquisition' then (case when live_date <= t1 then 1 else 0 end)
  when {{freshness}} = 'FTL acquired before PTL live' then (case when live_date > t1 then 1 else 0 end)
  else 1 end as in_scope
  from base)
 select to_char(t1,'YYYY-MM') as ftl_acquisition_month,
  count(*) as new_ftl_consignors,
  sum(in_scope) as ptl_live_selected,
  round(100.0*sum(in_scope)/count(*),1) as pct_ptl_live,
  count(case when in_scope=1 and po1 is not null then 1 end) as ptl_opened,
  round(100.0*count(case when in_scope=1 and po1 is not null then 1 end)/nullif(sum(in_scope),0),1) as ptl_opened_pct,
  count(case when in_scope=1 and pc1 is not null then 1 end) as price_checked,
  round(100.0*count(case when in_scope=1 and pc1 is not null then 1 end)/nullif(sum(in_scope),0),1) as price_checked_pct,
  count(case when in_scope=1 and dm1 is not null then 1 end) as ptl_demands,
  count(case when in_scope=1 and tr1 is not null then 1 end) as ptl_acquired,
  round(100.0*count(case when in_scope=1 and tr1 is not null then 1 end)/nullif(sum(in_scope),0),2) as ptl_acquired_pct,
  count(case when in_scope=1 and current_date-clock>=30 then 1 end) as matured_30d,
  round(100.0*count(case when in_scope=1 and current_date-clock>=30 and tr1 <= clock+30 then 1 end)
  /nullif(count(case when in_scope=1 and current_date-clock>=30 then 1 end),0),2) as ptl_acquired_d30_pct
 from b2
 where 1=1
  [[and consigner_region = {{region}}]]
  [[and app_active = {{app_active}}]]
  [[and ftl_trip_band = {{ftl_trips}}]]
  [[and t1 >= {{clock_from}}]]

  [[and signup_date >= {{signup_from}}]]
  [[and signup_date <= {{signup_to}}]]
  [[and app_potential >= {{min_potential}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')

Metric: A2 · Sanity — is PTL switching on at signup? (rollout + randomisation check) — v2 logic
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > Appendix — setup & sanity > card 51174
 
 Aliases: PTL rollout at signup; SHOW_PTL randomisation check; PTL live share of new signups.
 
 By signup month: how many new signups got PTL switched on (SHOW_PTL) and how fast, whether the PTL-live share is balanced among FTL-acquired signups, and how many of those PTL-live at FTL acquisition went on to take a PTL trip.
 Formula: per signup month: signups = count(*); ptl_live = count(first arm = SHOW_PTL); ptl_live_pct = ptl_live / signups; pct_live_at_signup = count(SHOW_PTL allocated within 1 day of signup) / ptl_live; not_allocated = count(no live SHOW_PTL or DISABLE_PTL allocation); ftl_acquired = count(first FTL trip exists), ftl_acq_pct = / signups; pct_live_among_ftl_acq_balance = SHOW_PTL share among FTL-acquired; ptl_live_at_ftl_acq = count(FTL-acquired with PTL live date <= first FTL trip); ptl_acquired_till_date = those with a PTL trip ever; ptl_acq_pct_of_eligible = ptl_acquired_till_date / ptl_live_at_ftl_acq.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_leads (signup_date, region fallback, cx_business_category, app_potential), fact_experiment_user_allocation (experiment_name SHOW_PTL / DISABLE_PTL, deleted = false; allocation date = UTC date of created), fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (first FTL trip = min demand_date with trip_flag = 1, last login_date, region), fact_cx_events_l24m (PTL screen views), fact_ptl_requirements, fact_ptl_bookings; row month on signup_date; grain consignor x signup month.
 Definitions: base = fact_leads consignors with signup_date on/after 2026-04-01; three internal test codes excluded. Arm = the consignor's earliest live allocation among SHOW_PTL and DISABLE_PTL (ties broken by experiment name). PTL live date (SHOW_PTL only) = earliest of allocation date, first PTL screen view (ptl_home_page, ptl_pincode_input, ptl_package_details_input, ptl_service_type_input, ptl_select_transporter), first fact_ptl_requirements row and first fact_ptl_bookings demand. PTL trip = trip_flag = 1 (dated on coalesce(demand_time, price_check_time), IST) or a pre-2026 booking with pickup_done_time not null and status not EXPIRED/CANCELLED; counted any time, including before the first FTL trip.
 Filters (all optional): region (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region, fallback fact_leads); app_active ('Active (30d)' = last login within 30 days, else 'Inactive'); signup_from / signup_to; min_potential (app_potential >=, null as 0); business_category ('SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)', 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER', or a single category). Freshness, FTL-trip band, sellable-date, PTL-category and Window filters do not apply.
 Caveats: Arm reflects current live allocations (deleted = false), not the arm held at an earlier point in time.
SQL:
-- REGION (15 Oct 2026): consigner_region from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (fallback fact_leads); consignors missing from fact_leads are no longer dropped.
 -- A2 v2 (9 Oct 2026): is PTL switching on at signup? Rollout + randomisation columns stay on the PTL-live FLAG (first arm per consignor).
 -- PTL-acquisition columns use the Motion 1 v2 logic: PTL live date = EARLIEST of SHOW_PTL allocation OR first PTL activity; acquired = PTL trip till date
 -- (fact_ptl_requirements trip_flag, plus pre-2026 bookings), including PTL taken before the first FTL trip.
 with alloc as (
  select user_code, experiment_name, min((timestamp 'epoch'+created/1000000*interval '1 second')::date) as alloc_date
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  where deleted=false and experiment_name in ('SHOW_PTL','DISABLE_PTL') group by 1,2),
 fa as (select user_code, experiment_name, alloc_date,
  row_number() over (partition by user_code order by alloc_date, experiment_name) as rn from alloc),
 ftl as (select consigner_user_code, min(case when trip_flag=1 then demand_date end)::date as t1,
  count(case when trip_flag=1 then 1 end) as ftl_trips, max(login_date)::date as last_login, max(consigner_region) as d_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1),
 l as (select consigner_user_code, min(signup_date) as signup_date, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region,
  max(cx_business_category) as cx_business_category, max(app_potential) as app_potential
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 evo as (select user_code as cc, min(event_date)::date as po1 from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m
  where screen_name in ('ptl_home_page','ptl_pincode_input','ptl_package_details_input','ptl_service_type_input','ptl_select_transporter') group by 1),
 rq as (select consigner_user_code as cc,
  min(coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time))::date as first_rq,
  min(case when browsing_id not like 'D/%' then price_check_time end)::date as pc1,
  min(case when demand_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as dm1,
  min(case when trip_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as tr1
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements group by 1),
 bk as (select consigner_user_code as cc, min(demand_time)::date as first_bk,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' then demand_time end)::date as dm0,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' and pickup_done_time is not null and coalesce(demand_status,'') not in ('EXPIRED','CANCELLED') then demand_time end)::date as tr0
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings group by 1),
 base as (
  select l.signup_date, coalesce(f.d_region, l.consigner_region) as consigner_region, l.cx_business_category, coalesce(l.app_potential,0) as app_potential,
  fa.experiment_name, fa.alloc_date, f.t1,
  case when fa.experiment_name = 'SHOW_PTL'
  then least(fa.alloc_date, coalesce(o.po1, fa.alloc_date), coalesce(r.first_rq, fa.alloc_date), coalesce(k.first_bk, fa.alloc_date)) end as live_date,
  least(r.tr1, k.tr0) as tr1,
  case when current_date - f.last_login <= 30 then 'Active (30d)' else 'Inactive' end as app_active
  from l left join fa on fa.user_code=l.consigner_user_code and fa.rn=1
  left join ftl f on f.consigner_user_code=l.consigner_user_code
  left join evo o on o.cc=l.consigner_user_code
  left join rq r on r.cc=l.consigner_user_code
  left join bk k on k.cc=l.consigner_user_code
  where l.signup_date >= '2026-04-01'
  and l.consigner_user_code not in ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979'))
 select to_char(signup_date,'YYYY-MM') as signup_month,
  count(*) as signups,
  count(case when experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' then 1 end) as ptl_live,
  round(100.0*count(case when experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' then 1 end)/count(*),1) as ptl_live_pct,
  round(100.0*count(case when experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' and alloc_date-signup_date<=1 then 1 end)
  /nullif(count(case when experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' then 1 end),0),1) as pct_live_at_signup,
  count(case when experiment_name is null then 1 end) as not_allocated,
  count(case when t1 is not null then 1 end) as ftl_acquired,
  round(100.0*count(case when t1 is not null then 1 end)/count(*),2) as ftl_acq_pct,
  round(100.0*count(case when t1 is not null and experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' then 1 end)
  /nullif(count(case when t1 is not null then 1 end),0),1) as pct_live_among_ftl_acq_balance,
  count(case when t1 is not null and live_date <= t1 then 1 end) as ptl_live_at_ftl_acq,
  count(case when t1 is not null and live_date <= t1 and tr1 is not null then 1 end) as ptl_acquired_till_date,
  round(100.0*count(case when t1 is not null and live_date <= t1 and tr1 is not null then 1 end)
  /nullif(count(case when t1 is not null and live_date <= t1 then 1 end),0),2) as ptl_acq_pct_of_eligible
 from base
 where 1=1
  [[and consigner_region = {{region}}]]
  [[and app_active = {{app_active}}]]
  [[and signup_date >= {{signup_from}}]]
  [[and signup_date <= {{signup_to}}]]
  [[and app_potential >= {{min_potential}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else cx_business_category = {{business_category}} end)]]
 group by 1 order by 1

Metric: A3 · Consignor list (v2 logic) — PTL live date, FTL acquisition, furthest PTL stage, first price check / demand / placement / trip
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > Appendix — setup & sanity > card 51147
 
 Aliases: Motion 1 consignor list; PTL-live FTL-acquired consignor list; furthest PTL stage list.
 
 One row per PTL-live, FTL-acquired (sellable) consignor with PTL live date and its source, FTL acquisition, activity, furthest PTL stage, PTL tutorial-banner exposure and first dates of each PTL stage.
 Formula: list, no aggregation. furthest_ptl_stage = highest of 5 PTL trip (acquired), 4 placed no trip, 3 demand not placed, 2 price checked no demand (price check or requirement), 1 opened PTL only, 0 no PTL activity. ptl_live_date_source = which input set the live date (PTL-live flag, first PTL screen open, first fact_ptl_requirements row labelled 'First PTL price check', else first PTL booking). Banner columns = v1_ptl_tutorial_view events (summed total_counts, distinct days, first/last date) on or after the first FTL trip date. days_ftl_acq_to_ptl_trip = first PTL trip - first FTL trip.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (experiment_name 'SHOW_PTL', deleted = false; allocation date = UTC date of created), fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (first FTL trip = min demand_date with trip_flag = 1, lifetime FTL trips, last login_date, region), fact_leads (signup_date, region fallback, cx_business_category, app_potential), fact_cx_events_l24m (PTL screen views; v1_ptl_tutorial_view from 2026-09-01), fact_ptl_requirements, fact_ptl_bookings, mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage (ptl_category); stage dates on coalesce(demand_time, price_check_time) (IST); grain consignor.
 Cohort: consignors with a live SHOW_PTL allocation and a first FTL trip; three internal test codes excluded. PTL live date = earliest of allocation date, first PTL screen view (ptl_home_page, ptl_pincode_input, ptl_package_details_input, ptl_service_type_input, ptl_select_transporter), first fact_ptl_requirements row and first fact_ptl_bookings demand. Sellable date = greatest(first FTL trip, PTL live date); only sellable date >= 2026-04-01. Stages: price check = fact_ptl_requirements row with browsing_id not like 'D/%'; requirement = requirement_flag = 1; demand = demand_flag = 1 (real + would-be) or any pre-2026 booking; placement = placement_flag = 1 or a pre-2026 picked-up booking; trip = trip_flag = 1 or a pre-2026 booking with pickup_done_time not null and status not EXPIRED/CANCELLED. ptl_category_group: 'PTL-NCR' = PTL-NCR, PTL-NCR-Not Intrested, PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS; 'Other tag'; 'Not tagged'.
 Filters (all optional): region; freshness ('PTL live at FTL acquisition' = live date <= first FTL trip, 'FTL acquired before PTL live', 'ALL (fresh + retro-fit)'); app_active ('Active (30d)' = last login within 30 days, else 'Inactive'); ftl_trips band (1 / 2-3 / 4+); clock_from / clock_to on sellable date; signup_from / signup_to; min_potential (app_potential >=, null as 0); ptl_cat; business_category ('SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)', 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER', or a single category). Sorted by first PTL trip, placement, demand, price check (earliest first, nulls last), then app-active first, then latest FTL acquisition.
 Caveats: Row-level list; volt returns aggregates only. The PTL tutorial banner (v1_ptl_tutorial_view) exists from 2026-09-15.
SQL:
-- PTL TUTORIAL BANNER (22 Oct 2026): ptl_banner_* columns = 'Part Load is LIVE' home tooltip (v1_ptl_tutorial_view, live from 15 Sep 2026) seen ON/AFTER the FTL acquisition date.
 -- REGION (15 Oct 2026): consigner_region from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (fallback fact_leads); consignors missing from fact_leads are no longer dropped.
 -- Consignor list (card 51147), TILL DATE v2 logic (8 Oct 2026); columns from old A3 (50679) added 9 Oct; PTL category (as_cx_ptl_stage) added 15 Oct: PTL live date = EARLIEST of SHOW_PTL allocation OR first PTL activity (PTL screen open, price check, demand/booking).
 -- Cohort still requires a SHOW_PTL allocation. Sellable = later of first FTL trip and that live date. Day 0 = done on/before sellable.
 -- Because the live date is never later than any PTL activity, every PTL event of the consignor counts (incl. pre-2026 bookings for demand / placement / trip).
 with ftl as (
  select consigner_user_code, min(case when trip_flag=1 then demand_date end)::date as t1,
  count(case when trip_flag=1 then 1 end) as ftl_trips, max(login_date)::date as last_login, max(consigner_region) as d_region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1),
 alloc as (select user_code, min((timestamp 'epoch'+created/1000000*interval '1 second')::date) as alloc_date
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' and deleted=false group by 1),
 lds as (select consigner_user_code, min(signup_date) as signup_date, max(consigner_region) as consigner_region,
  max(cx_business_category) as cx_business_category, max(app_potential) as app_potential
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 evo as (select user_code as cc, min(event_date)::date as po1 from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m
  where screen_name in ('ptl_home_page','ptl_pincode_input','ptl_package_details_input','ptl_service_type_input','ptl_select_transporter') group by 1),
 rq as (select consigner_user_code as cc,
  min(coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time))::date as first_rq,
  min(case when browsing_id not like 'D/%' then price_check_time end)::date as pc1,
  min(case when requirement_flag=1 then coalesce(price_check_time,demand_time) end)::date as rq1,
  min(case when demand_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as dm1,
  min(case when placement_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as pl1,
  min(case when trip_flag=1 then coalesce(demand_time,price_check_time) end)::date as tr1
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements group by 1),
 bk as (select consigner_user_code as cc, min(demand_time)::date as first_bk,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' then demand_time end)::date as dm0,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' and pickup_done_time is not null and coalesce(demand_status,'') not in ('EXPIRED','CANCELLED') then demand_time end)::date as tr0
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings group by 1),
 pcat as (select consigner_user_code as cc, max(ptl_category) as cat
  from mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 tut as (select user_code as cc, event_date::date as d, sum(total_counts) as n
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m where event_name = 'v1_ptl_tutorial_view' and event_date >= '2026-09-01' group by 1,2),
 b0 as (
  select a.user_code, pc.cat as ptl_category, a.alloc_date, o.po1 as first_open, r.first_rq, k.first_bk,
  least(a.alloc_date, coalesce(o.po1, a.alloc_date), coalesce(r.first_rq, a.alloc_date), coalesce(k.first_bk, a.alloc_date)) as live_date,
  f.t1, f.ftl_trips, f.last_login,
  coalesce(f.d_region, l.consigner_region) as consigner_region, l.signup_date, l.cx_business_category, coalesce(l.app_potential,0) as app_potential,
  o.po1, r.pc1, r.rq1, least(r.dm1, k.dm0) as dm1, least(r.pl1, k.tr0) as pl1, least(r.tr1, k.tr0) as tr1
  from alloc a join ftl f on f.consigner_user_code=a.user_code left join lds l on l.consigner_user_code=a.user_code
  left join evo o on o.cc = a.user_code left join rq r on r.cc = a.user_code left join bk k on k.cc = a.user_code
  left join pcat pc on pc.cc = a.user_code
  where f.t1 is not null and a.user_code not in ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979')),
 b1 as (
  select b0.*, greatest(t1, live_date) as clock,
  case when ptl_category in ('PTL-NCR','PTL-NCR-Not Intrested','PTL-NCR_CHURN_LEADS') then 'PTL-NCR'
  when ptl_category is not null then 'Other tag' else 'Not tagged' end as ptl_cat_group,
  case when live_date - t1 <= 0 then 'PTL live at FTL acquisition' else 'FTL acquired before PTL live' end as freshness,
  case when live_date - t1 <= 0 then 'A. PTL live at FTL acquisition (fresh)'
  when live_date - t1 <= 90 then 'B. FTL acquired 0-90d before PTL live'
  when live_date - t1 <= 365 then 'C. FTL acquired 91-365d before PTL live'
  else 'D. FTL acquired 365d+ before PTL live' end as freshness_bucket,
  case when current_date - last_login <= 30 then 'Active (30d)' else 'Inactive' end as app_active,
  case when ftl_trips = 1 then '1' when ftl_trips <= 3 then '2-3' else '4+' end as ftl_trip_band
  from b0 where greatest(t1, live_date) >= '2026-04-01'),
 x as (
  select b1.*, current_date - clock as age from b1
  where 1=1
  [[and consigner_region = {{region}}]]
  [[and (case when {{freshness}} = 'ALL (fresh + retro-fit)' then 1 when freshness = {{freshness}} then 1 else 0 end) = 1]]
  [[and app_active = {{app_active}}]]
  [[and ftl_trip_band = {{ftl_trips}}]]
  [[and clock >= {{clock_from}}]]
  [[and clock <= {{clock_to}}]]
  [[and signup_date >= {{signup_from}}]]
  [[and signup_date <= {{signup_to}}]]
  [[and app_potential >= {{min_potential}}]]
  [[and ptl_cat_group = {{ptl_cat}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then cx_business_category in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else cx_business_category = {{business_category}} end)]]),
 tb as (select x.user_code as cc, sum(t.n) as banner_views, count(distinct t.d) as banner_view_days,
  min(t.d) as first_banner, max(t.d) as last_banner
  from x join tut t on t.cc = x.user_code and t.d >= x.t1 group by 1)
 select user_code as consigner_user_code,
  consigner_region as region, cx_business_category as business_category,
  ptl_category, ptl_cat_group as ptl_category_group,
  signup_date,
  live_date as ptl_live_date,
  case when live_date = alloc_date then 'PTL-live flag'
  when live_date = first_open then 'First PTL screen open'
  when live_date = first_rq then 'First PTL price check'
  else 'First PTL booking' end as ptl_live_date_source,
  alloc_date as ptl_flag_date,
  t1 as ftl_acquisition_date,
  clock as sellable_date,
  age as days_since_sellable,
  freshness,
  app_active,
  current_date - last_login as days_since_last_login,
  ftl_trips,
  app_potential,
  case when tr1 is not null then '5. PTL trip (acquired)'
  when pl1 is not null then '4. Placed, no trip'
  when dm1 is not null then '3. Demand, not placed'
  when pc1 is not null or rq1 is not null then '2. Price checked, no demand'
  when po1 is not null then '1. Opened PTL only'
  else '0. No PTL activity' end as furthest_ptl_stage,
  coalesce(tb.banner_views, 0) as ptl_banner_views_after_ftl_acq,
  coalesce(tb.banner_view_days, 0) as ptl_banner_view_days,
  tb.first_banner as first_ptl_banner_view,
  tb.last_banner as last_ptl_banner_view,
  po1 as first_ptl_open,
  pc1 as first_ptl_price_check,
  rq1 as first_ptl_requirement,
  dm1 as first_ptl_demand,
  pl1 as first_ptl_placement,
  tr1 as first_ptl_trip,
  tr1 - t1 as days_ftl_acq_to_ptl_trip
 from x left join tb on tb.cc = x.user_code
 order by tr1 asc nulls last, pl1 asc nulls last, dm1 asc nulls last, pc1 asc nulls last,
  case when app_active = 'Active (30d)' then 0 else 1 end, t1 desc

Metric: PTL View — Where PTL is live & conversion (Region × Consignor set)
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > Appendix — setup & sanity > card 51131
 
 Aliases: PTL leadership view; where PTL is live and conversion; region x consignor set PTL conversion.
 
 For five consignor sets (NCR retention set, NCR and Non-NCR new FTL acquisitions since Apr 2026, NCR and Non-NCR all FTL-acquired), how many have PTL live and what share of them took a PTL trip, overall and among app-active consignors.
 Formula: per set: base = count(consignors); ptl_live = count(PTL live per set rule); live_pct = ptl_live / base; acquired = count(PTL live with a PTL trip ever); conv_live = acquired / ptl_live; app_active = count(PTL live and active 30d); acq_app_active = count(PTL live, active 30d, PTL trip ever); conv_app_active = acq_app_active / app_active. A '▶' marks the cell to read: conv_live on new-acquisition rows, conv_app_active on the others.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.as_trip_payments (first FTL trip = min demand_time with ptl_flag = 0, trip_rank = 1), fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (first FTL trip = min demand_date with trip_flag = 1; region), fact_leads (region fallback, cx_business_category), analytics.ptl_ab_testing_27july2026 (ab_group), fact_experiment_user_allocation (variant_id 17 and experiment_name 'SHOW_PTL', deleted = false; allocation date = UTC date of created), consigner_app_events_current_v2 (min_timestamp UTC epoch microseconds), fact_cx_events_l24m (PTL screen views), fact_ptl_requirements (price_check_time / demand_time IST, trip_flag), fact_ptl_bookings; grain consignor x set.
 Sets: universe = consignors with a first FTL trip in as_trip_payments or fact_consigner_demands_lead_source; three internal test codes excluded. Region = coalesce(fact_consigner_demands_lead_source, fact_leads) consigner_region: NCR vs Non-NCR; consignors with no region are excluded from the region rows. Retention set (labelled NCR, not region-filtered): first FTL trip (as_trip_payments) on/after 2026-01-01 and present in analytics.ptl_ab_testing_27july2026; PTL live = ab_group 'Test'. New FTL acq since Apr-26: first FTL trip (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source) on/after 2026-04-01; PTL live = live SHOW_PTL allocation and PTL live date (earliest of allocation date, first PTL screen view, first fact_ptl_requirements row, first PTL booking) on/before first FTL trip. All FTL acquired: first FTL trip in as_trip_payments; PTL live = variant_id 17 with deleted = false. PTL trip = trip_flag = 1 ever, or a pre-2026 booking with pickup_done_time not null and status not EXPIRED/CANCELLED. Active 30d = any app event since IST midnight 30 days ago, or a PTL price check or demand in the last 30 days.
 Filters: biz (Business category, required, default 'ALL'; 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)', 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER', or a single fact_leads.cx_business_category).
 Caveats: For Non-NCR consignors PTL stays enabled only when they have a PTL demand, so Non-NCR PTL-live is demand-selected and its conversion is not comparable with NCR. Rows use different FTL-acquisition sources and PTL-live rules by design.
SQL:
-- PTL Leadership View v11 (19 Oct 2026): compact layout (region merged into set label, short column names via column_title).
 -- v10: ▶ marks the conversion cell to read per row (retention + all FTL = app-active; new FTL acq = PTL live); app-active now filled on new-acq rows.
 -- v9: 5 rows — NCR {Retention set, New FTL acq since Apr-26, All FTL acquired}; Non-NCR {New FTL acq since Apr-26, All FTL acquired}
 -- Region (all rows except retention) = fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region (fallback fact_leads; no region -> excluded)
 -- Retention set: retention A/B cohort (analytics.ptl_ab_testing_27july2026), first FTL trip since 1 Jan 2026; PTL live = Test arm
 -- New FTL acq since Apr-26 (SAME LOGIC AS DASHBOARD 3053 card 0 / card 1): base = first FTL trip (fact_consigner_demands_lead_source trip_flag) on/after 1 Apr 2026;
 -- PTL live = SHOW_PTL flag AND PTL live date (earliest of flag / first PTL open / price check / booking) <= first FTL trip; acquired = PTL trip till date. App-active = same 30d definition as other rows.
 -- All FTL acquired: first FTL trip from as_trip_payments (all time); PTL live = variant_id 17 AND deleted = false
 -- Acquired (till date) = trip_flag = 1 (fact_ptl_requirements) OR pre-2026 booking with pickup done, status not EXPIRED/CANCELLED
 -- Conv % of PTL live = acquired / PTL live; Conv % of app-active = acquired among app-active 30d PTL-live / app-active PTL-live
 -- CAVEAT Non-NCR: the nightly scheduler turns PTL off for non-NCR consignors without a PTL demand, so Non-NCR PTL-live is demand-selected -> conversion is inflated.
 -- {{biz}}: ALL, SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER), MANUFACTURER + TRADER, or a single category (fact_leads.cx_business_category)
 with c17 as (select distinct user_code from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where variant_id = 17 and deleted = false),
 alloc as (select user_code, min((timestamp 'epoch'+created/1000000*interval '1 second')::date) as alloc_date
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where experiment_name='SHOW_PTL' and deleted=false group by 1),
 ab as (select code, max(ab_group) ab_group from analytics.ptl_ab_testing_27july2026 group by 1),
 ftl as (select consigner_user_code cc, min(demand_time)::date t1
  from mp_analytics_core.as_trip_payments where ptl_flag = 0 and trip_rank = 1 group by 1),
 dreg as (select consigner_user_code cc, max(consigner_region) r,
  min(case when trip_flag = 1 then demand_date end)::date as t1d
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1),
 lds as (select consigner_user_code cc, max(consigner_region) r, max(cx_business_category) cat
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 ev as (select distinct user_code cc from consigner_app_events_current_v2
  where min_timestamp >= (extract(epoch from (current_date - 30)::timestamp) - 19800)::bigint * 1000000),
 evo as (select e.user_code as cc, min(e.event_date)::date as po1 from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m e
  join alloc a0 on a0.user_code = e.user_code
  where e.screen_name in ('ptl_home_page','ptl_pincode_input','ptl_package_details_input','ptl_service_type_input','ptl_select_transporter') group by 1),
 pr as (select consigner_user_code cc,
  max(price_check_time) last_pc,
  max(case when demand_flag = 1 then coalesce(demand_time, price_check_time) end) last_dm,
  max(trip_flag) ever_trip,
  min(coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time))::date as first_rq
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements group by 1),
 bkd as (select consigner_user_code cc, min(demand_time)::date as first_bk,
  min(case when demand_time < '2026-01-01' and pickup_done_time is not null and coalesce(demand_status,'') not in ('EXPIRED','CANCELLED') then demand_time end)::date tr0
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings group by 1),
 u as (select cc from ftl union select cc from dreg where t1d is not null),
 x as (
  select u.cc,
  f.t1, dr.t1d, case when f.t1 is not null then 1 else 0 end f_ok,
  case when f.t1 >= '2026-01-01' and ab.code is not null then 1 else 0 end s1,
  case when ab.ab_group = 'Test' then 1 else 0 end live_ret,
  case when coalesce(dr.r, l.r) = 'NCR' then 'NCR' when coalesce(dr.r, l.r) is not null then 'Non-NCR' else 'NONE' end region,
  case when c.user_code is not null then 1 else 0 end live17,
  case when a.user_code is not null
  and least(a.alloc_date, coalesce(o.po1, a.alloc_date), coalesce(pr.first_rq, a.alloc_date), coalesce(bd.first_bk, a.alloc_date)) <= dr.t1d
  then 1 else 0 end live_new,
  case when ev.cc is not null or pr.last_pc >= current_date - 30 or pr.last_dm >= current_date - 30 then 1 else 0 end act30,
  case when coalesce(pr.ever_trip, 0) = 1 or bd.tr0 is not null then 1 else 0 end ptl_trip
  from u
  left join ftl f on f.cc = u.cc
  left join ab on ab.code = u.cc
  left join dreg dr on dr.cc = u.cc
  left join lds l on l.cc = u.cc
  left join c17 c on c.user_code = u.cc
  left join alloc a on a.user_code = u.cc
  left join ev on ev.cc = u.cc
  left join evo o on o.cc = u.cc
  left join pr on pr.cc = u.cc
  left join bkd bd on bd.cc = u.cc
  where u.cc not in ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979')
  and ({{biz}} = 'ALL'
  or ({{biz}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' and l.cat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER'))
  or ({{biz}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' and l.cat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER'))
  or l.cat = {{biz}})),
 t as (
  select 1 k, 'NCR' region, 'Retention set (FTL acq Jan-26+)' cset,
  sum(s1) base, sum(s1*live_ret) live, sum(s1*live_ret*act30) act, sum(s1*live_ret*act30*ptl_trip) acq_act, sum(s1*live_ret*ptl_trip) acq_live
  from x where f_ok = 1
  union all
  select 2, region, 'New FTL acq since Apr-26',
  count(*), sum(live_new), sum(live_new*act30), sum(live_new*act30*ptl_trip), sum(live_new*ptl_trip)
  from x where region <> 'NONE' and t1d >= '2026-04-01' group by 2
  union all
  select 3, region, 'All FTL acquired',
  count(*), sum(live17), sum(live17*act30), sum(live17*act30*ptl_trip), sum(live17*ptl_trip)
  from x where region <> 'NONE' and f_ok = 1 group by 2)
 select region || ' · ' || cset as cset, base, live as ptl_live,
  round(100.0*live/nullif(base,0),1) as live_pct,
  acq_live as acquired,
  case when k = 2 then '▶ ' else '' end || to_char(round(100.0*acq_live/nullif(live,0),1), 'FM990.0') || '%' as conv_live,
  act as app_active,
  acq_act as acq_app_active,
  case when k <> 2 then '▶ ' else '' end || to_char(round(100.0*acq_act/nullif(act,0),1), 'FM990.0') || '%' as conv_app_active
 from t
 order by case region when 'NCR' then 1 else 2 end, k

Metric: F1 · App → PTL funnel by period (app active → visible → opened → requirement → trip)
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > App → PTL funnel > card 51897
 
 Aliases: app PTL funnel by period; app to PTL funnel; app active to PTL trip funnel; PTL visibility and conversion funnel.
 
 Distinct consignors per period (latest period first) moving through the app PTL funnel: app active -> PTL visible -> opened PTL in app -> requirement -> demand -> placement -> trip, with step conversion %.
 Formula: app_active = count(distinct consignor with a login_date in the period); ptl_visible / opened_ptl = consignors flagged visible / opened; requirement / demand / placement / trip = consignors with any channel = 'APP' row in fact_ptl_requirements dated in the period with requirement_flag / demand_flag / placement_flag / trip_flag = 1; pct_* = step / previous step; pct_trip_of_start = trip / app_active. Side columns: portal_odin_demand / portal_odin_trip = same cohort with demand_flag / trip_flag = 1 on non-APP channels (web portal, ODIN, bulk upload); opened_while_not_visible = opened but not visible.
 PTL visible = first PTL booking (fact_ptl_bookings min demand_time) on or before period end, OR SHOW_PTL (variant 17) at any moment in the period, reconstructed from the live allocation (fact_experiment_user_allocation, variants 17/18, deleted = false, users on a single arm) plus the switch log mp_analytics_sandbox.as_user_show_ptl, OR present in the Redis PTL-live user list (embedded saved question returning a comma-separated code string). Opened = any fact_cx_events_l24m event with screen_name like 'ptl_%' on platform android / ios / web / mweb with a non-blank user_code.
 Source: fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (login_date); fact_cx_events_l24m (event_date, UTC); fact_ptl_requirements dated on coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time) (IST); fact_ptl_bookings; fact_experiment_user_allocation; as_user_show_ptl (switch times UTC + 330 min); fact_leads; dim_consigners; grain consignor x period.
 Filters: grain = day / week / month / range (default week; range = one row for the whole window); period_from / period_to (default last 56 days to yesterday; first and last periods are clipped to the window); start_at = App active (default) / PTL visible / Opened PTL restricts the cohort to consignors who reached that step; ptl_segment = New / 1 / 2 / 3 / 3+ is event-time: number of FULFILLED PTL bookings (fact_ptl_bookings, ordered by demand_time) completed before the action, and logins, PTL opens and requirements count only while the consignor was in that segment (one consignor can appear in two segments in a period; visibility stays period-level); ptl_live_now = Live now (currently variant 17, any PTL booking ever, or on the Redis list) / Not live now; region = consigner_region from fact_consigner_demands_lead_source, falling back to fact_leads; signup_from / signup_to on fact_leads min signup_date; cx_type = Signed up in this period / FTL acquired (dim_consigners.acquisition_date_ftl on or before period end) / Signed up earlier, no FTL trip; business_category on fact_leads cx_business_category (SHIPPERS ONLY = MANUFACTURER + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER; MANUFACTURER + TRADER; or a single value).
 Caveats: Counts are consignors, not trips. Requirement-to-trip steps are app channel only (APP includes consigner-web bookings) and are dated by the requirement, so a later trip on an earlier requirement stays in the earlier period. Stages are not strictly nested (a requirement can exist without a logged PTL screen open). fact_ptl_requirements starts Jan 2026.
SQL:
-- PTL app funnel (3053 tab "App → PTL funnel") — distinct consignors per day / week / month (latest period first)
 -- Cohort : consignors app-active in the period (any login_date in the period, fact_consigner_demands_lead_source)
 -- 'Funnel starts at' filter: App active (default) / PTL visible / Opened PTL -> cohort restricted to that step
 -- 'PTL live now' filter: Live now = TODAY flag 17, OR any PTL demand ever, OR on the Redis list; else Not live now
 -- 'PTL segment' filter (event-time, like dashboard 2938): segment at moment X = New until the 1st FULFILLED PTL trip
 -- (fact_ptl_bookings, by demand_time), then 1 / 2 / 3 until the 2nd / 3rd / 4th, then 3+ (X <= trip time stays in the
 -- earlier segment). When a segment is picked, logins (day), PTL screen opens and requirements count only if they happened
 -- while the consignor was in that segment -> one consignor can sit in two segments in the same period.
 -- PTL visible stays period-level.
 -- Stages : 1 App active / 2 PTL visible (PTL demand before period end OR flag 17 any moment in period OR Redis) /
 -- 3 Opened PTL in app (screen ptl_% on android/ios/web/mweb) / 4 Requirement / 5 Demand / 6 Placement / 7 Trip
 -- (fact_ptl_requirements channel APP, dated by price-check time). Side: same cohort's portal / ODIN / bulk demand & trip.
 -- Counts are CONSIGNORS (not trips) who logged into the app that period; app channel only.
 -- Flag at time t: config table value certain from its updated time (epochs IST); before that switch log (UTC +330 min).
 with prm as (
  select coalesce([[{{grain}},]] 'week', 'week')::varchar g,
  coalesce([[{{period_from}},]] current_date - 56, current_date - 56)::date f,
  coalesce([[{{period_to}},]] current_date - 1, current_date - 1)::date t,
  coalesce([[{{start_at}},]] 'App active', 'App active')::varchar sa,
  coalesce([[{{ptl_segment}},]] 'All', 'All')::varchar seg),
 tt as (
  select uc, max(case when rk = 1 then dt end) t1, max(case when rk = 2 then dt end) t2,
  max(case when rk = 3 then dt end) t3, max(case when rk = 4 then dt end) t4
  from (select consigner_user_code uc, demand_time dt, row_number() over (partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) rk
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings where demand_status = 'FULFILLED') z
  where rk <= 4 group by 1),
 act as (
  select distinct l.consigner_user_code uc,
  case prm.g when 'range' then prm.f when 'day' then l.login_date::date
  when 'month' then date_trunc('month', l.login_date)::date
  else date_trunc('week', l.login_date)::date end p
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source l cross join prm
  left join tt on tt.uc = l.consigner_user_code
  where l.login_date >= prm.f and l.login_date <= prm.t and l.consigner_user_code is not null
  and (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = (case when tt.t1 is null or l.login_date::timestamp <= tt.t1 then 'New'
  when tt.t2 is null or l.login_date::timestamp <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or l.login_date::timestamp <= tt.t3 then '2'
  when tt.t4 is null or l.login_date::timestamp <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end))),
 per as (
  select distinct a.p,
  greatest(a.p, prm.f) ps,
  least(case prm.g when 'range' then prm.t when 'day' then a.p
  when 'month' then (dateadd(month, 1, a.p) - 1)::date else a.p + 6 end, prm.t) pe,
  case prm.g when 'range' then prm.t when 'day' then a.p
  when 'month' then (dateadd(month, 1, a.p) - 1)::date else a.p + 6 end nat_pe
  from act a cross join prm),
 reg as (select consigner_user_code uc, max(consigner_region) region from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1),
 lds as (select consigner_user_code uc, min(signup_date)::date signup_date, max(consigner_region) region, max(cx_business_category) bizcat
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 dc as (select consigner_user_code uc, acquisition_date_ftl from mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners),
 dem as (select consigner_user_code uc, min(demand_time)::date fd from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings group by 1),
 redis as (select codes from {{#51896-ptl-redis-live-list}}),
 cfg as (select user_code, max(variant_id) v, max(timestamp 'epoch' + updated/1000000 * interval '1 second')::date u
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where variant_id in (17,18) and deleted = false
  group by 1 having count(distinct variant_id) = 1),
 base as (
  select a.uc, a.p, pr.ps, pr.pe, pr.nat_pe,
  coalesce(r.region, l.region) region, l.signup_date, l.bizcat,
  case when l.signup_date between pr.ps and pr.pe then 'Signed up in this period'
  when d.acquisition_date_ftl is not null and d.acquisition_date_ftl <= pr.pe then 'FTL acquired'
  else 'Signed up earlier, no FTL trip' end cx_type
  from act a join per pr on pr.p = a.p
  left join reg r on r.uc = a.uc left join lds l on l.uc = a.uc left join dc d on d.uc = a.uc),
 b0 as (
  select * from base where 1 = 1
  [[and region = {{region}}]]
  [[and signup_date >= {{signup_from}}]]
  [[and signup_date <= {{signup_to}}]]
  [[and cx_type = {{cx_type}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else bizcat = {{business_category}} end)]]),
 b as (
  select * from (
  select b0.*,
  case when c.v = 17 or dm.uc is not null or position(',' || b0.uc || ',' in rd.codes) > 0 then 'Live now' else 'Not live now' end live_now
  from b0 cross join redis rd left join cfg c on c.user_code = b0.uc left join dem dm on dm.uc = b0.uc) z
  where 1 = 1
  [[and live_now = {{ptl_live_now}}]]),
 -- PTL visible
 sw as (select user_code, old_variant_id ov, new_variant_id nv, switched_at::timestamp + interval '330 minutes' st
  from mp_analytics_sandbox.as_user_show_ptl where new_variant_id is not null),
 lb as (select user_code, max(case when new_variant_id is null then old_variant_id end) base_v,
  min(created_at::timestamp + interval '330 minutes') lcr from mp_analytics_sandbox.as_user_show_ptl group by 1),
 fsw as (select user_code, ov v0, st first_st from (select user_code, ov, st, row_number() over (partition by user_code order by st) rn from sw) where rn = 1),
 iv as (
  select user_code, nv v, st vf, lead(st) over (partition by user_code order by st) vt from sw
  union all
  select lb.user_code, coalesce(f.v0, lb.base_v), lb.lcr, f.first_st from lb left join fsw f on f.user_code = lb.user_code),
 l17 as (
  select distinct b.uc, b.p from b
  left join cfg c on c.user_code = b.uc
  join iv on iv.user_code = b.uc and iv.v = 17
  and iv.vf::date <= case when c.v = 18 then least(b.pe, c.u) else b.pe end
  and coalesce(iv.vt::date, '2099-12-31') >= b.ps
  and (c.v is null or c.v = 17 or b.ps <= c.u)),
 vis as (
  select b.uc, b.p,
  case when d.fd is not null and d.fd <= b.pe then 1 else 0 end v_dem,
  case when (c.v = 17 and c.u <= b.pe) or l.uc is not null then 1 else 0 end v_flag,
  case when position(',' || b.uc || ',' in r.codes) > 0 then 1 else 0 end v_redis
  from b cross join redis r
  left join dem d on d.uc = b.uc left join cfg c on c.user_code = b.uc left join l17 l on l.uc = b.uc and l.p = b.p),
 -- opened PTL in app (event time checked against the segment)
 ev as (
  select distinct e.user_code uc,
  case prm.g when 'range' then prm.f when 'day' then e.event_date::date
  when 'month' then date_trunc('month', e.event_date)::date
  else date_trunc('week', e.event_date)::date end p
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m e cross join prm
  left join tt on tt.uc = e.user_code
  where e.event_date >= prm.f and e.event_date <= prm.t and e.screen_name like 'ptl\\_%'
  and e.user_code <> '' and e.event_platform in ('android','ios','web','mweb')
  and (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = (case
  when tt.t1 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t1 then 'New'
  when tt.t2 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t3 then '2'
  when tt.t4 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end))),
 -- requirement -> trip (price-check time checked against the segment)
 rq as (
  select r.consigner_user_code uc,
  case prm.g when 'range' then prm.f when 'day' then coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time)::date
  when 'month' then date_trunc('month', coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time))::date
  else date_trunc('week', coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time))::date end p,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.requirement_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) rq,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.demand_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) dm,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.placement_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) pl,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.trip_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) tr,
  max(case when r.channel <> 'APP' and r.demand_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) o_dm,
  max(case when r.channel <> 'APP' and r.trip_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) o_tr
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements r cross join prm
  left join tt on tt.uc = r.consigner_user_code
  where coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) >= prm.f
  and coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) < prm.t + 1
  and (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = (case
  when tt.t1 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t1 then 'New'
  when tt.t2 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t3 then '2'
  when tt.t4 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end))
  group by 1,2),
 f as (

-- F2 funnel: totals over the whole selected period (grain ignored). Logic identical to F1 (card 51897).
 -- 'PTL segment' is event-time (like 2938): logins / PTL opens / requirements count only while the consignor was in that segment.
 with prm as (
  select coalesce([[{{period_from}},]] current_date - 56, current_date - 56)::date f,
  coalesce([[{{period_to}},]] current_date - 1, current_date - 1)::date t,
  coalesce([[{{start_at}},]] 'App active', 'App active')::varchar sa,
  coalesce([[{{ptl_segment}},]] 'All', 'All')::varchar seg),
 tt as (
  select uc, max(case when rk = 1 then dt end) t1, max(case when rk = 2 then dt end) t2,
  max(case when rk = 3 then dt end) t3, max(case when rk = 4 then dt end) t4
  from (select consigner_user_code uc, demand_time dt, row_number() over (partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) rk
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings where demand_status = 'FULFILLED') z
  where rk <= 4 group by 1),
 act as (
  select distinct l.consigner_user_code uc, prm.f p
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source l cross join prm
  left join tt on tt.uc = l.consigner_user_code
  where l.login_date >= prm.f and l.login_date <= prm.t and l.consigner_user_code is not null
  and (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = (case when tt.t1 is null or l.login_date::timestamp <= tt.t1 then 'New'
  when tt.t2 is null or l.login_date::timestamp <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or l.login_date::timestamp <= tt.t3 then '2'
  when tt.t4 is null or l.login_date::timestamp <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end))),
 per as (select distinct a.p, prm.f ps, prm.t pe from act a cross join prm),
 reg as (select consigner_user_code uc, max(consigner_region) region from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1),
 lds as (select consigner_user_code uc, min(signup_date)::date signup_date, max(consigner_region) region, max(cx_business_category) bizcat
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 dc as (select consigner_user_code uc, acquisition_date_ftl from mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners),
 dem as (select consigner_user_code uc, min(demand_time)::date fd from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings group by 1),
 redis as (select codes from {{#51896-ptl-redis-live-list}}),
 cfg as (select user_code, max(variant_id) v, max(timestamp 'epoch' + updated/1000000 * interval '1 second')::date u
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where variant_id in (17,18) and deleted = false
  group by 1 having count(distinct variant_id) = 1),
 base as (
  select a.uc, a.p, pr.ps, pr.pe,
  coalesce(r.region, l.region) region, l.signup_date, l.bizcat,
  case when l.signup_date between pr.ps and pr.pe then 'Signed up in this period'
  when d.acquisition_date_ftl is not null and d.acquisition_date_ftl <= pr.pe then 'FTL acquired'
  else 'Signed up earlier, no FTL trip' end cx_type
  from act a join per pr on pr.p = a.p
  left join reg r on r.uc = a.uc left join lds l on l.uc = a.uc left join dc d on d.uc = a.uc),
 b0 as (
  select * from base where 1 = 1
  [[and region = {{region}}]]
  [[and signup_date >= {{signup_from}}]]
  [[and signup_date <= {{signup_to}}]]
  [[and cx_type = {{cx_type}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')

  select distinct b.uc, b.p from b
  left join cfg c on c.user_code = b.uc
  join iv on iv.user_code = b.uc and iv.v = 17
  and iv.vf::date <= case when c.v = 18 then least(b.pe, c.u) else b.pe end
  and coalesce(iv.vt::date, '2099-12-31') >= b.ps
  and (c.v is null or c.v = 17 or b.ps <= c.u)),
 vis as (
  select b.uc, b.p,
  case when (d.fd is not null and d.fd <= b.pe) or position(',' || b.uc || ',' in r.codes) > 0

  from b cross join redis r
  left join dem d on d.uc = b.uc left join cfg c on c.user_code = b.uc left join l17 l on l.uc = b.uc and l.p = b.p),
 ev as (
  select distinct e.user_code uc
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m e cross join prm
  left join tt on tt.uc = e.user_code
  where e.event_date >= prm.f and e.event_date <= prm.t and e.screen_name like 'ptl\\_%'
  and e.user_code <> '' and e.event_platform in ('android','ios','web','mweb')
  and (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = (case
  when tt.t1 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t1 then 'New'
  when tt.t2 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t3 then '2'
