  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.demand_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) dm,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.placement_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) pl,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.trip_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) tr
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements r cross join prm
  left join tt on tt.uc = r.consigner_user_code
  where coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) >= prm.f
  and coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) < prm.t + 1
  and (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = (case
  when tt.t1 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t1 then 'New'
  when tt.t2 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t3 then '2'
  when tt.t4 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end))
  group by 1),
 f as (
  select b.uc, v.visible, case when e.uc is not null then 1 else 0 end opened,
  coalesce(q.rq,0) rq, coalesce(q.dm,0) dm, coalesce(q.pl,0) pl, coalesce(q.tr,0) tr
  from b join vis v on v.uc = b.uc and v.p = b.p
  left join ev e on e.uc = b.uc
  left join rq q on q.uc = b.uc),
 fc as (
  select f.* from f cross join prm
  where (case prm.sa when 'PTL visible' then f.visible when 'Opened PTL' then f.opened else 1 end) = 1),
 agg as (select count(*) a, sum(visible) v, sum(opened) o, sum(rq) rq, sum(dm) dm, sum(pl) pl, sum(tr) tr from fc),
 st as (select 1 o union all select 2 union all select 3 union all select 4 union all select 5 union all select 6 union all select 7)
 select case st.o when 1 then '1. App active' when 2 then '2. PTL visible' when 3 then '3. Opened PTL in app'
  when 4 then '4. Requirement' when 5 then '5. Demand' when 6 then '6. Placement' else '7. Trip' end as stage,
  case st.o when 1 then g.a when 2 then g.v when 3 then g.o when 4 then g.rq when 5 then g.dm when 6 then g.pl else g.tr end as users
 from agg g cross join st cross join prm
 where st.o >= case prm.sa when 'PTL visible' then 2 when 'Opened PTL' then 3 else 1 end
 order by st.o

  when 'month' then date_trunc('month', e.event_date)::date
  else date_trunc('week', e.event_date)::date end p
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m e cross join prm
  left join tt on tt.uc = e.user_code
  where e.event_date >= prm.f and e.event_date <= prm.t and e.screen_name like 'ptl\\_%'
  and e.user_code <> '' and e.event_platform in ('android','ios','web','mweb')
  and (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = (case
  when tt.t1 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t1 then 'New'
  when tt.t2 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t3 then '2'
  when tt.t4 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end))),
 rq as (
  select r.consigner_user_code uc,
  case prm.g when 'range' then prm.f when 'day' then coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time)::date
  when 'month' then date_trunc('month', coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time))::date
  else date_trunc('week', coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time))::date end p,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.requirement_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) rq,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.demand_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) dm,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.placement_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) pl,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.trip_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) tr
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements r cross join prm
  left join tt on tt.uc = r.consigner_user_code
  where coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) >= prm.f
  and coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) < prm.t + 1
  and (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = (case
  when tt.t1 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t1 then 'New'
  when tt.t2 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t3 then '2'
  when tt.t4 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end))
  group by 1,2),
 f as (
  select b.p, b.uc, b.nat_pe, v.visible, case when e.uc is not null then 1 else 0 end opened,
  coalesce(q.rq,0) rq, coalesce(q.dm,0) dm, coalesce(q.pl,0) pl, coalesce(q.tr,0) tr
  from b join vis v on v.uc = b.uc and v.p = b.p
  left join ev e on e.uc = b.uc and e.p = b.p
  left join rq q on q.uc = b.uc and q.p = b.p),
 fc as (
  select f.* from f cross join prm
  where (case prm.sa when 'PTL visible' then f.visible when 'Opened PTL' then f.opened else 1 end) = 1),
 agg as (
  select p, max(nat_pe) nat_pe, count(*) a, sum(visible) v, sum(opened) o, sum(rq) rq, sum(dm) dm, sum(pl) pl, sum(tr) tr
  from fc group by 1),
 ranked as (
  select agg.*, prm.sa, case prm.sa when 'PTL visible' then 2 when 'Opened PTL' then 3 else 1 end so,
  row_number() over (order by case when agg.nat_pe <= prm.t then 0 else 1 end, agg.p desc) rk
  from agg cross join prm),
 st as (select 1 o union all select 2 union all select 3 union all select 4 union all select 5 union all select 6 union all select 7)
 select case st.o when 1 then '1. App active' when 2 then '2. PTL visible' when 3 then '3. Opened PTL in app'
  when 4 then '4. Requirement' when 5 then '5. Demand' when 6 then '6. Placement' else '7. Trip' end
  || case when st.o = r.so then ' (period of ' || to_char(r.p, 'DD Mon YY') || ')' else '' end as stage,
  case st.o when 1 then r.a when 2 then r.v when 3 then r.o when 4 then r.rq when 5 then r.dm when 6 then r.pl else r.tr end as users
 from ranked r cross join st
 where r.rk = 1 and st.o >= r.so
 order by st.o

Metric: F4 · App → PTL funnel — consignor-level rows (one row per consignor × period)
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > App → PTL funnel > card 51900
 
 Aliases: app PTL funnel consignor list; app to PTL funnel raw rows; PTL funnel drop-off list; furthest PTL stage by consignor.
 
 Row-level list of every app-active consignor in each day / week / month period with their app PTL funnel status: furthest stage reached, Yes/No per stage, how PTL was visible, and profile and calling attributes.
 Formula: one row per consignor x period. App active = any login_date in the period. ptl_visible = Yes if first PTL booking (fact_ptl_bookings min demand_time) on or before period end, OR SHOW_PTL (variant 17) at any moment in the period, reconstructed from the live allocation (fact_experiment_user_allocation, variants 17/18, deleted = false, users on a single arm) plus the switch log mp_analytics_sandbox.as_user_show_ptl, OR on the Redis PTL-live user list (embedded saved question returning a comma-separated code string); visible_via lists which of PTL demand / Flag 17 / Redis applied. opened_ptl = any fact_cx_events_l24m event with screen_name like 'ptl_%' on android / ios / web / mweb. requirement / demand / placement / trip = any channel = 'APP' row in fact_ptl_requirements dated in the period with requirement_flag / demand_flag / placement_flag / trip_flag = 1; portal_odin_demand / portal_odin_trip = same flags on non-APP channels. furthest_stage = highest of 7 Trip, 6 Placement, 5 Demand, 4 Requirement, 3 Opened PTL, 2 PTL visible, 1 App active only. Other columns: region, business_category, signup_date, consignor_type, ptl_segment (selected segment, else segment at period start), ptl_live_now, ptl_category_calling and last_call_reason (mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage, latest call per consignor; 'Not in calling sheet' if absent).
 Source: fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (login_date); fact_cx_events_l24m (event_date, UTC); fact_ptl_requirements dated on coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time) (IST); fact_ptl_bookings; fact_experiment_user_allocation; as_user_show_ptl (switch times UTC + 330 min); fact_leads; dim_consigners; as_cx_ptl_stage; grain consignor x period.
 Filters: grain = day / week / month (default week; any other value is treated as week); period_from / period_to (default last 56 days to yesterday; first and last periods clipped to the window); start_at = App active (default) / PTL visible / Opened PTL keeps only consignors who reached that step; ptl_segment = New / 1 / 2 / 3 / 3+ is event-time: number of FULFILLED PTL bookings (fact_ptl_bookings, ordered by demand_time) completed before the action, and logins, PTL opens and requirements count only while in that segment; ptl_live_now = Live now (currently variant 17, any PTL booking ever, or on the Redis list) / Not live now; region = consigner_region from fact_consigner_demands_lead_source, falling back to fact_leads; signup_from / signup_to on fact_leads min signup_date; cx_type = Signed up in this period / FTL acquired (dim_consigners.acquisition_date_ftl on or before period end) / Signed up earlier, no FTL trip; business_category on fact_leads cx_business_category (SHIPPERS ONLY = MANUFACTURER + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER; MANUFACTURER + TRADER; or a single value); furthest_stage restricts to one furthest stage.
 Caveats: Row-level list; volt returns aggregates only. Calling columns hold only the latest call and carry no call date, so the tag may come from a call outside the period. Requirement-to-trip steps are app channel only (APP includes consigner-web bookings). fact_ptl_requirements starts Jan 2026.
SQL:
-- F4 consignor-level rows behind F1 (card 51897): one row per consignor x period, same cohort / filters / stage logic.
 -- 'PTL segment' is event-time (like 2938): logins / PTL opens / requirements count only while the consignor was in that segment.
 -- Column ptl_segment = the selected segment, or (no segment selected) the segment at the start of the period.
 -- Calling columns (6 Nov 2026): ptl_category_calling + last_call_reason from mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage (calling team's sheet,
 -- one row per consignor = LATEST call only, no call date -> the tag may come from a call before or after the period).
 with prm as (
  select coalesce([[{{grain}},]] 'week', 'week')::varchar g,
  coalesce([[{{period_from}},]] current_date - 56, current_date - 56)::date f,
  coalesce([[{{period_to}},]] current_date - 1, current_date - 1)::date t,
  coalesce([[{{start_at}},]] 'App active', 'App active')::varchar sa,
  coalesce([[{{ptl_segment}},]] 'All', 'All')::varchar seg),
 tt as (
  select uc, max(case when rk = 1 then dt end) t1, max(case when rk = 2 then dt end) t2,
  max(case when rk = 3 then dt end) t3, max(case when rk = 4 then dt end) t4
  from (select consigner_user_code uc, demand_time dt, row_number() over (partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) rk
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings where demand_status = 'FULFILLED') z
  where rk <= 4 group by 1),
 act as (
  select distinct l.consigner_user_code uc,
  case prm.g when 'day' then l.login_date::date
  when 'month' then date_trunc('month', l.login_date)::date
  else date_trunc('week', l.login_date)::date end p
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source l cross join prm
  left join tt on tt.uc = l.consigner_user_code
  where l.login_date >= prm.f and l.login_date <= prm.t and l.consigner_user_code is not null
  and (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = (case when tt.t1 is null or l.login_date::timestamp <= tt.t1 then 'New'
  when tt.t2 is null or l.login_date::timestamp <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or l.login_date::timestamp <= tt.t3 then '2'
  when tt.t4 is null or l.login_date::timestamp <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end))),
 per as (
  select distinct a.p,
  greatest(a.p, prm.f) ps,
  least(case prm.g when 'day' then a.p
  when 'month' then (dateadd(month, 1, a.p) - 1)::date else a.p + 6 end, prm.t) pe
  from act a cross join prm),
 reg as (select consigner_user_code uc, max(consigner_region) region from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1),
 lds as (select consigner_user_code uc, min(signup_date)::date signup_date, max(consigner_region) region, max(cx_business_category) bizcat
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 dc as (select consigner_user_code uc, acquisition_date_ftl from mp_analytics_core.dim_consigners),
 dem as (select consigner_user_code uc, min(demand_time)::date fd from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings group by 1),
 redis as (select codes from {{#51896-ptl-redis-live-list}}),
 cfg as (select user_code, max(variant_id) v, max(timestamp 'epoch' + updated/1000000 * interval '1 second')::date u
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where variant_id in (17,18) and deleted = false
  group by 1 having count(distinct variant_id) = 1),
 base as (
  select a.uc, a.p, pr.ps, pr.pe,
  coalesce(r.region, l.region) region, l.signup_date, l.bizcat,
  case when l.signup_date between pr.ps and pr.pe then 'Signed up in this period'
  when d.acquisition_date_ftl is not null and d.acquisition_date_ftl <= pr.pe then 'FTL acquired'
  else 'Signed up earlier, no FTL trip' end cx_type
  from act a join per pr on pr.p = a.p
  left join reg r on r.uc = a.uc left join lds l on l.uc = a.uc left join dc d on d.uc = a.uc),
 b0 as (
  select * from base where 1 = 1
  [[and region = {{region}}]]
  [[and signup_date >= {{signup_from}}]]
  [[and signup_date <= {{signup_to}}]]
  [[and cx_type = {{cx_type}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else bizcat = {{business_category}} end)]]),
 b as (
  select * from (
  select b0.*,
  case when c.v = 17 or dm.uc is not null or position(',' || b0.uc || ',' in rd.codes) > 0 then 'Live now' else 'Not live now' end live_now,
  case when prm.seg <> 'All' then prm.seg
  when tt.t1 is null or b0.ps::timestamp <= tt.t1 then 'New' when tt.t2 is null or b0.ps::timestamp <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or b0.ps::timestamp <= tt.t3 then '2' when tt.t4 is null or b0.ps::timestamp <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end ptl_seg
  from b0 cross join redis rd cross join prm left join cfg c on c.user_code = b0.uc left join dem dm on dm.uc = b0.uc
  left join tt on tt.uc = b0.uc) z
  where 1 = 1
  [[and live_now = {{ptl_live_now}}]]),
 sw as (select user_code, old_variant_id ov, new_variant_id nv, switched_at::timestamp + interval '330 minutes' st
  from mp_analytics_sandbox.as_user_show_ptl where new_variant_id is not null),
 lb as (select user_code, max(case when new_variant_id is null then old_variant_id end) base_v,
  min(created_at::timestamp + interval '330 minutes') lcr from mp_analytics_sandbox.as_user_show_ptl group by 1),
 fsw as (select user_code, ov v0, st first_st from (select user_code, ov, st, row_number() over (partition by user_code order by st) rn from sw) where rn = 1),
 iv as (
  select user_code, nv v, st vf, lead(st) over (partition by user_code order by st) vt from sw
  union all
  select lb.user_code, coalesce(f.v0, lb.base_v), lb.lcr, f.first_st from lb left join fsw f on f.user_code = lb.user_code),
 l17 as (
  select distinct b.uc, b.p from b
  left join cfg c on c.user_code = b.uc
  join iv on iv.user_code = b.uc and iv.v = 17
  and iv.vf::date <= case when c.v = 18 then least(b.pe, c.u) else b.pe end
  and coalesce(iv.vt::date, '2099-12-31') >= b.ps
  and (c.v is null or c.v = 17 or b.ps <= c.u)),
 vis as (
  select b.uc, b.p,
  case when d.fd is not null and d.fd <= b.pe then 1 else 0 end v_dem,
  case when (c.v = 17 and c.u <= b.pe) or l.uc is not null then 1 else 0 end v_flag,
  case when position(',' || b.uc || ',' in r.codes) > 0 then 1 else 0 end v_redis
  from b cross join redis r
  left join dem d on d.uc = b.uc left join cfg c on c.user_code = b.uc left join l17 l on l.uc = b.uc and l.p = b.p),
 ev as (
  select distinct e.user_code uc,
  case prm.g when 'day' then e.event_date::date
  when 'month' then date_trunc('month', e.event_date)::date
  else date_trunc('week', e.event_date)::date end p
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m e cross join prm
  left join tt on tt.uc = e.user_code
  where e.event_date >= prm.f and e.event_date <= prm.t and e.screen_name like 'ptl\\_%'
  and e.user_code <> '' and e.event_platform in ('android','ios','web','mweb')
  and (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = (case
  when tt.t1 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t1 then 'New'
  when tt.t2 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t3 then '2'
  when tt.t4 is null or (timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes') <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end))),
 rq as (
  select r.consigner_user_code uc,
  case prm.g when 'day' then coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time)::date
  when 'month' then date_trunc('month', coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time))::date
  else date_trunc('week', coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time))::date end p,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.requirement_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) rq,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.demand_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) dm,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.placement_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) pl,
  max(case when r.channel = 'APP' and r.trip_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) tr,
  max(case when r.channel <> 'APP' and r.demand_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) o_dm,
  max(case when r.channel <> 'APP' and r.trip_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) o_tr
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements r cross join prm
  left join tt on tt.uc = r.consigner_user_code
  where coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) >= prm.f
  and coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) < prm.t + 1
  and (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = (case
  when tt.t1 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t1 then 'New'
  when tt.t2 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t3 then '2'
  when tt.t4 is null or coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end))
  group by 1,2),
 f as (
  select b.p, b.uc, b.region, b.bizcat, b.signup_date, b.cx_type, b.live_now, b.ptl_seg, v.v_dem, v.v_flag, v.v_redis,
  greatest(v.v_dem, v.v_flag, v.v_redis) visible, case when e.uc is not null then 1 else 0 end opened,
  coalesce(q.rq,0) rq, coalesce(q.dm,0) dm, coalesce(q.pl,0) pl, coalesce(q.tr,0) tr,
  coalesce(q.o_dm,0) o_dm, coalesce(q.o_tr,0) o_tr
  from b join vis v on v.uc = b.uc and v.p = b.p
  left join ev e on e.uc = b.uc and e.p = b.p
  left join rq q on q.uc = b.uc and q.p = b.p),
 fc as (
  select f.* from f cross join prm
  where (case prm.sa when 'PTL visible' then f.visible when 'Opened PTL' then f.opened else 1 end) = 1),
 x as (
  select fc.*,
  case when tr = 1 then '7 Trip' when pl = 1 then '6 Placement' when dm = 1 then '5 Demand' when rq = 1 then '4 Requirement'
  when opened = 1 then '3 Opened PTL' when visible = 1 then '2 PTL visible' else '1 App active only' end furthest
  from fc)
 select x.uc as consigner_user_code, x.p as period_start, x.region, x.bizcat as business_category, x.signup_date, x.cx_type as consignor_type,
  x.ptl_seg as ptl_segment, x.live_now as ptl_live_now,
  x.furthest as furthest_stage,
  coalesce(nullif(trim(cs.ptl_category), ''), case when cs.consigner_user_code is not null then '(blank)' else 'Not in calling sheet' end) as ptl_category_calling,
  nullif(trim(cs.lead_stage), '') as last_call_reason,
  case when x.visible = 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as ptl_visible,
  trim(', ' from case when x.v_dem = 1 then 'PTL demand, ' else '' end || case when x.v_flag = 1 then 'Flag 17, ' else '' end || case when x.v_redis = 1 then 'Redis' else '' end) as visible_via,
  case when x.opened = 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as opened_ptl,
  case when x.rq = 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as requirement,
  case when x.dm = 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as demand,
  case when x.pl = 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as placement,
  case when x.tr = 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as trip,
  case when x.o_dm = 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as portal_odin_demand,
  case when x.o_tr = 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as portal_odin_trip
 from x
 left join mp_analytics_sandbox.as_cx_ptl_stage cs on cs.consigner_user_code = x.uc
 where 1 = 1
  [[and x.furthest = {{furthest_stage}}]]
 order by x.p desc, x.furthest desc, x.uc

Metric: W2 · Web portal funnel by period (portal active → rate estimate → requirement → demand (Create PRQ) → placement (Book now) → trip)
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > Web portal funnel > card 51904
 
 Aliases: web portal funnel by period; PTL web portal conversion; portal active to trip funnel; Create PRQ funnel.
 
 Distinct consignors per period (latest period first) moving through the PTL web portal funnel: portal active -> rate estimate viewed -> requirement -> demand (Create Pickup Request) -> placement (Book now / paid) -> trip, with step conversion %.
 Formula: portal_active = count(distinct consignor with a portal PTL event OR a web-portal requirement in the period); rate_estimate_viewed = consignors with event v1_rate_estimate_view; requirement / demand_create_prq / placement_book_now / trip = consignors with a channel = 'WEB PORTAL', requirement_flag = 1 row in fact_ptl_requirements dated in the period, flagged on max(requirement_flag) / demand_flag = 1 / placement_flag / trip_flag of those rows. pct_view_of_active = rate_estimate_viewed / portal_active; pct_req_of_active = requirement / portal_active; pct_dem_of_req, pct_plc_of_dem, pct_trip_of_plc = step / previous step.
 Portal events = fact_cx_events_l24m rows with blank event_platform and (screen_name like 'ptl_%' OR event_name like 'v1_ptl%'); the consignor code is read from the payload key "uc" (fallback "user") and must start with 'WE'. Demand = Create Pickup Request: the backend demand after the 16 Oct 2026 portal demand-creation change, and the backfilled v1_create_prq would-be demand before it, so the step is comparable across the change. Trip = picked up / in transit / delivered, not cancelled or expired.
 Source: fact_cx_events_l24m (min_timestamp, UTC epoch microseconds converted to IST; window filter on event_date); fact_ptl_requirements dated on coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time) (IST); fact_ptl_bookings (segment); fact_consigner_demands_lead_source and fact_leads (region, business category); grain consignor x period.
 Filters: grain = day / week / month / range (default week; range = one row for the whole window); period_from / period_to (default last 56 days to yesterday); ptl_segment = New / 1 / 2 / 3 / 3+ is event-time: number of FULFILLED PTL bookings (fact_ptl_bookings, ordered by demand_time) completed before the event or requirement; region = consigner_region from fact_consigner_demands_lead_source, falling back to fact_leads; business_category on fact_leads cx_business_category (SHIPPERS ONLY = MANUFACTURER + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER; MANUFACTURER + TRADER; or a single value). A channel filter is accepted but does not change results (the card is web portal only).
 Caveats: Logged-out website visitors (no consignor code) are not countable. Only consignors present in fact_consigner_demands_lead_source or fact_leads are counted. Steps are not strictly nested (a requirement counts the consignor as portal active even without a logged event). Portal events are tracked from Jan 2026.
SQL:
-- W2 · Web portal funnel per period (distinct consignors), latest period first.
 -- 1 Portal active = any portal PTL event carrying the consignor code (fact_cx_events_l24m, blank platform, payload "uc"/"user"),
 -- or a web-portal requirement in the period
 -- 2 Rate estimate viewed = v1_rate_estimate_view (portal event)
 -- 3 Requirement = web-portal price check / requirement (fact_ptl_requirements channel WEB PORTAL, requirement_flag = 1)
 -- 4 Demand = Create Pickup Request (demand_flag: backend demand after the 16 Oct 2026 portal cutover; before it, the
 -- v1_create_prq would-be demand backfilled in fact_ptl_requirements) -> same definition across the cutover
 -- 5 Placement = Book now / paid (placement_flag)
 -- 6 Trip = picked up / in transit / delivered, not cancelled or expired (trip_flag)
 -- Steps 3-6 all come from fact_ptl_requirements so they stay consistent before and after the demand-creation change.
 -- Logged-out website visitors (no consignor code) are not countable. PTL segment = event-time.
 with prm as (

  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')

 pe as (
  select coalesce(nullif(split_part(split_part(e.miscellaneous, '"uc":"', 2), '"', 1), ''),

  e.event_name, timestamp 'epoch' + e.min_timestamp/1000000 * interval '1 second' + interval '330 minutes' evt_ts
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l24m e cross join prm
  where e.event_date >= prm.f and e.event_date <= prm.t and coalesce(e.event_platform, '') = ''

  round(100.0 * sum(pl) / nullif(sum(dm), 0), 1) as pct_plc_of_dem,
  round(100.0 * sum(tr) / nullif(sum(pl), 0), 1) as pct_trip_of_plc
 from f group by 1 order by 1 desc

Metric: W1 · Web portal funnel, whole selected period (funnel)
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > Web portal funnel > card 51905
 
 Aliases: web portal funnel total; PTL web portal funnel chart; portal active to trip funnel whole period.
 
 Funnel chart of distinct consignors over the whole selected window through the PTL web portal stages: 1 Portal active -> 2 Rate estimate viewed -> 3 Requirement (price check) -> 4 Demand (Create pickup request) -> 5 Placement (Book now / paid) -> 6 Trip.
 Formula: Portal active = count(distinct consignor with a portal PTL event OR a web-portal requirement in the window); Rate estimate viewed = consignors with event v1_rate_estimate_view; Requirement / Demand / Placement / Trip = consignors with a channel = 'WEB PORTAL', requirement_flag = 1 row in fact_ptl_requirements dated in the window, flagged on max(requirement_flag) / demand_flag = 1 / placement_flag / trip_flag of those rows.
 Portal events = fact_cx_events_l24m rows with blank event_platform and (screen_name like 'ptl_%' OR event_name like 'v1_ptl%'); the consignor code is read from the payload key "uc" (fallback "user") and must start with 'WE'. Demand = Create Pickup Request: the backend demand after the 16 Oct 2026 portal demand-creation change, and the backfilled v1_create_prq would-be demand before it, so the step is comparable across the change. Trip = picked up / in transit / delivered, not cancelled or expired.
 Source: fact_cx_events_l24m (min_timestamp, UTC epoch microseconds converted to IST; window filter on event_date); fact_ptl_requirements dated on coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time) (IST); fact_ptl_bookings (segment); fact_consigner_demands_lead_source and fact_leads (region, business category); grain consignor x whole window.
 Filters: period_from / period_to (default last 56 days to yesterday; no grain, totals over the whole window); ptl_segment = New / 1 / 2 / 3 / 3+ is event-time: number of FULFILLED PTL bookings (fact_ptl_bookings, ordered by demand_time) completed before the event or requirement; region = consigner_region from fact_consigner_demands_lead_source, falling back to fact_leads; business_category on fact_leads cx_business_category (SHIPPERS ONLY = MANUFACTURER + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER; MANUFACTURER + TRADER; or a single value). A channel filter is accepted but does not change results (the card is web portal only).
 Caveats: Logged-out website visitors (no consignor code) are not countable. Only consignors present in fact_consigner_demands_lead_source or fact_leads are counted. Steps are not strictly nested (a requirement counts the consignor as portal active even without a logged event). Portal events are tracked from Jan 2026.

Metric: T1 · PTL trips by pickup date, by channel (stacked)
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > PTL trips & channels > card 51901
 
 Aliases: PTL trips by channel; PTL trips by pickup date; all-channel PTL trips; PTL trip volume by booking channel.
 
 Count of PTL trips per period (latest first), dated by pickup and stacked by booking channel, across all channels.
 Formula: trips = count(*) of fact_ptl_bookings rows with pickup_done_time in the period, demand_status <> 'EXPIRED', vib_demand_status <> 'CANCELLED' and vib_demand_state <> 'CANCELLED', grouped by period and channel.
 Channel (first match wins): Bulk upload = demand_id appears as a non-would-be demand on a channel = 'BULK_UPLOAD' row of fact_ptl_requirements; ODIN (KAM) = source 'ODIN'; Web portal = source 'WEB PORTAL' or app_platform 'WEB_PORTAL'; Consigner web = app_platform 'CONSIGNER_WEB'; App = source like 'APP%' or app_platform in ('CONSIGNER_APP', 'IOS_CONSIGNER_APP'); else Other.
 Source: fact_ptl_bookings dated on pickup_done_time (IST); fact_ptl_requirements (bulk-upload tagging); fact_consigner_demands_lead_source and fact_leads (region, business category); grain trip (booking) x period x channel.
 Filters: grain = day / week / month / range (default week; range = one bar for the whole window); period_from / period_to (default last 56 days to yesterday); channel = App / Consigner web / Web portal / ODIN (KAM) / Bulk upload / Other (default All); ptl_segment = New / 1 / 2 / 3 / 3+ = consignor segment when the trip's demand was created, i.e. number of FULFILLED PTL bookings (fact_ptl_bookings, ordered by demand_time) with demand_time before this demand (New = first trip); region = consigner_region from fact_consigner_demands_lead_source, falling back to fact_leads; business_category on fact_leads cx_business_category (SHIPPERS ONLY = MANUFACTURER + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER; MANUFACTURER + TRADER; or a single value).
 Caveats: Only consignors present in fact_consigner_demands_lead_source or fact_leads are counted. Trips are counted by pickup date regardless of when the demand was created.
SQL:
-- T1 · PTL trips by PICKUP date, stacked by channel (all channels; the business number).
 -- Trip = pickup done and not cancelled / expired (fact_ptl_bookings). Channel: Bulk upload (via fact_ptl_requirements) / ODIN (KAM) /
 -- Web portal / Consigner web / App. PTL segment = consignor's segment when the trip's demand was created (New = their first trip).
 with prm as (
  select coalesce([[{{grain}},]] 'week', 'week')::varchar g,
  coalesce([[{{period_from}},]] current_date - 56, current_date - 56)::date f,
  coalesce([[{{period_to}},]] current_date - 1, current_date - 1)::date t,
  coalesce([[{{ptl_segment}},]] 'All', 'All')::varchar seg,
  coalesce([[{{channel}},]] 'All', 'All')::varchar ch),
 tt as (
  select uc, max(case when rk = 1 then dt end) t1, max(case when rk = 2 then dt end) t2,
  max(case when rk = 3 then dt end) t3, max(case when rk = 4 then dt end) t4
  from (select consigner_user_code uc, demand_time dt, row_number() over (partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) rk
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings where demand_status = 'FULFILLED') z
  where rk <= 4 group by 1),
 cx as (
  select coalesce(r.uc, l.uc) uc, coalesce(r.region, l.region) region, l.bizcat
  from (select consigner_user_code uc, max(consigner_region) region from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1) r
  full outer join (select consigner_user_code uc, max(consigner_region) region, max(cx_business_category) bizcat
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1) l on l.uc = r.uc),
 cxf as (
  select uc from cx where 1 = 1
  [[and region = {{region}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else bizcat = {{business_category}} end)]]),
 bulk as (select distinct demand_id from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements where channel = 'BULK_UPLOAD' and demand_id not like 'B/%' and demand_id <> ''),
 bk as (
  select b.consigner_user_code uc, b.demand_id, b.demand_time, b.pickup_done_time pt,
  case when k.demand_id is not null then 'Bulk upload'
  when b.source = 'ODIN' then 'ODIN (KAM)'
  when b.source = 'WEB PORTAL' or b.app_platform = 'WEB_PORTAL' then 'Web portal'
  when b.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' then 'Consigner web'
  when b.source like 'APP%' or b.app_platform in ('CONSIGNER_APP','IOS_CONSIGNER_APP') then 'App'
  else 'Other' end channel
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings b cross join prm
  left join bulk k on k.demand_id = b.demand_id::varchar
  where b.pickup_done_time >= prm.f and b.pickup_done_time < prm.t + 1
  and coalesce(b.demand_status, '') <> 'EXPIRED' and coalesce(b.vib_demand_status, '') <> 'CANCELLED' and coalesce(b.vib_demand_state, '') <> 'CANCELLED'),
 x as (
  select case prm.g when 'range' then prm.f when 'day' then (bk.pt)::date when 'month' then date_trunc('month', bk.pt)::date else date_trunc('week', bk.pt)::date end p, bk.*, (case when tt.t1 is null or bk.demand_time <= tt.t1 then 'New' when tt.t2 is null or bk.demand_time <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or bk.demand_time <= tt.t3 then '2' when tt.t4 is null or bk.demand_time <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end) seg_at_trip
  from bk cross join prm join cxf on cxf.uc = bk.uc left join tt on tt.uc = bk.uc
  where (prm.ch = 'All' or prm.ch = bk.channel))
 select x.p as period_start, x.channel, count(*) as trips
 from x cross join prm where (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = x.seg_at_trip)
 group by 1,2 order by 1 desc, 2

  [[and region = {{region}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else bizcat = {{business_category}} end)]]),
 bulk as (select distinct demand_id from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements where channel = 'BULK_UPLOAD' and demand_id not like 'B/%' and demand_id <> ''),
 bk as (
  select b.consigner_user_code uc, b.demand_id, b.demand_time, b.pickup_done_time pt,
  case when k.demand_id is not null then 'Bulk upload'
  when b.source = 'ODIN' then 'ODIN (KAM)'
  when b.source = 'WEB PORTAL' or b.app_platform = 'WEB_PORTAL' then 'Web portal'
  when b.app_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' then 'Consigner web'
  when b.source like 'APP%' or b.app_platform in ('CONSIGNER_APP','IOS_CONSIGNER_APP') then 'App'
  else 'Other' end channel
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings b cross join prm
  left join bulk k on k.demand_id = b.demand_id::varchar
  where b.pickup_done_time >= prm.f and b.pickup_done_time < prm.t + 1
  and coalesce(b.demand_status, '') <> 'EXPIRED' and coalesce(b.vib_demand_status, '') <> 'CANCELLED' and coalesce(b.vib_demand_state, '') <> 'CANCELLED'),
 x as (
  select case prm.g when 'range' then prm.f when 'day' then (bk.pt)::date when 'month' then date_trunc('month', bk.pt)::date else date_trunc('week', bk.pt)::date end p, bk.*, (case when tt.t1 is null or bk.demand_time <= tt.t1 then 'New' when tt.t2 is null or bk.demand_time <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or bk.demand_time <= tt.t3 then '2' when tt.t4 is null or bk.demand_time <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end) seg_at_trip
  from bk cross join prm join cxf on cxf.uc = bk.uc left join tt on tt.uc = bk.uc
  where (prm.ch = 'All' or prm.ch = bk.channel))
 select x.p as period_start,
  count(*) as trips,
  sum(case when channel = 'App' then 1 else 0 end) as app,
  sum(case when channel = 'Consigner web' then 1 else 0 end) as consigner_web,
  sum(case when channel = 'Web portal' then 1 else 0 end) as web_portal,
  sum(case when channel = 'ODIN (KAM)' then 1 else 0 end) as odin_kam,
  sum(case when channel = 'Bulk upload' then 1 else 0 end) as bulk_upload,
  sum(case when channel = 'Other' then 1 else 0 end) as other,
  count(distinct uc) as trip_consignors,
  count(distinct case when seg_at_trip = 'New' then uc end) as first_ptl_trip_consignors,
  round(100.0 * sum(case when channel in ('App','Consigner web') then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) as pct_app_incl_web
 from x cross join prm where (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = x.seg_at_trip)
 group by 1 order by 1 desc

Metric: T3 · All-channel funnel by requirement date (requirement → demand → placement → trip, per channel)
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Acquisition v2 (3053) > PTL trips & channels > card 51903
 
 Aliases: all-channel PTL funnel; PTL requirement to trip by channel; requirement-dated PTL funnel; PTL conversion by channel.
 
 Per period and booking channel, PTL requirements and how many converted to demand (including would-be demands), placement and trip, as both distinct consignors and volumes, with step conversion %.
 Formula: base = fact_ptl_requirements rows with requirement_flag = 1 dated in the period. req_consignors = count(distinct consignor); demand_consignors / placement_consignors / trip_consignors = distinct consignors with demand_flag = 1 / placement_flag = 1 / trip_flag = 1 on those rows; requirements = count(*); demands / placements / trips = sum of the flags; pct_dem_of_req = demands / requirements; pct_plc_of_dem = placements / demands; pct_trip_of_plc = trips / placements; pct_trip_of_req = trips / requirements.
 Channel: channel 'APP' split into Consigner web (booking_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB') and App (all other APP rows, including unbooked consigner-web requirements); 'WEB PORTAL' = Web portal; 'ODIN' = ODIN (KAM); 'BULK_UPLOAD' = Bulk upload; anything else = Unknown. Demand includes would-be demands (demand_id 'B/<browsing_id>').
 Source: fact_ptl_requirements dated on coalesce(price_check_time, demand_time) (IST); fact_ptl_bookings (segment); fact_consigner_demands_lead_source and fact_leads (region, business category); grain requirement x period x channel.
 Filters: grain = day / week / month / range (default week; range = whole window per channel); period_from / period_to (default last 56 days to yesterday); channel = App / Consigner web / Web portal / ODIN (KAM) / Bulk upload / Unknown (default All); ptl_segment = New / 1 / 2 / 3 / 3+ is event-time at the requirement: number of FULFILLED PTL bookings (fact_ptl_bookings, ordered by demand_time) completed before it; region = consigner_region from fact_consigner_demands_lead_source, falling back to fact_leads; business_category on fact_leads cx_business_category (SHIPPERS ONLY = MANUFACTURER + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER; MANUFACTURER + TRADER; or a single value).
 Caveats: Dated by requirement, so placement and trip for recent periods keep rising for about two weeks. Bulk upload rows are back-entered after booking; read them for volume, not conversion. Only consignors present in fact_consigner_demands_lead_source or fact_leads are counted. fact_ptl_requirements starts Jan 2026.
SQL:
-- T3 · All-channel funnel by REQUIREMENT date: requirement -> demand (incl. would-be) -> placement -> trip, per period x channel.
 -- Source fact_ptl_requirements (requirement_flag = 1 rows). Channel: App / Consigner web (APP rows whose booking platform is CONSIGNER_WEB;
 -- unbooked consigner-web rows stay in App) / Web portal / ODIN (KAM) / Bulk upload (exclude from conversion: back-entered) / Unknown.
 -- Consignor columns = distinct consignors reaching the step; volume columns = requirements / demands / placements / trips.
 -- Recent periods: placement / trip keep rising for ~2 weeks. PTL segment = event-time at the requirement.
 with prm as (
  select coalesce([[{{grain}},]] 'week', 'week')::varchar g,
  coalesce([[{{period_from}},]] current_date - 56, current_date - 56)::date f,
  coalesce([[{{period_to}},]] current_date - 1, current_date - 1)::date t,
  coalesce([[{{ptl_segment}},]] 'All', 'All')::varchar seg,
  coalesce([[{{channel}},]] 'All', 'All')::varchar ch),
 tt as (
  select uc, max(case when rk = 1 then dt end) t1, max(case when rk = 2 then dt end) t2,
  max(case when rk = 3 then dt end) t3, max(case when rk = 4 then dt end) t4
  from (select consigner_user_code uc, demand_time dt, row_number() over (partition by consigner_user_code order by demand_time) rk
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings where demand_status = 'FULFILLED') z
  where rk <= 4 group by 1),
 cx as (
  select coalesce(r.uc, l.uc) uc, coalesce(r.region, l.region) region, l.bizcat
  from (select consigner_user_code uc, max(consigner_region) region from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source group by 1) r
  full outer join (select consigner_user_code uc, max(consigner_region) region, max(cx_business_category) bizcat
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1) l on l.uc = r.uc),
 cxf as (
  select uc from cx where 1 = 1
  [[and region = {{region}}]]
  [[and (case when {{business_category}} = 'SHIPPERS ONLY (MFR + TRADER + SERVICE PROVIDER)' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER','SERVICE_PROVIDER','SERVICE PROVIDER')
  when {{business_category}} = 'MANUFACTURER + TRADER' then bizcat in ('MANUFACTURER','TRADER')
  else bizcat = {{business_category}} end)]]),
 r as (
  select r.consigner_user_code uc, coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) t,
  case r.channel when 'APP' then (case when r.booking_platform = 'CONSIGNER_WEB' then 'Consigner web' else 'App' end)
  when 'WEB PORTAL' then 'Web portal' when 'ODIN' then 'ODIN (KAM)' when 'BULK_UPLOAD' then 'Bulk upload' else 'Unknown' end channel,
  case when r.demand_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end dm, coalesce(r.placement_flag, 0) pl, coalesce(r.trip_flag, 0) tr
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_requirements r cross join prm
  where r.requirement_flag = 1 and coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) >= prm.f and coalesce(r.price_check_time, r.demand_time) < prm.t + 1),
 x as (
  select case prm.g when 'range' then prm.f when 'day' then (r.t)::date when 'month' then date_trunc('month', r.t)::date else date_trunc('week', r.t)::date end p, r.*
  from r cross join prm join cxf on cxf.uc = r.uc left join tt on tt.uc = r.uc
  where (prm.ch = 'All' or prm.ch = r.channel) and (prm.seg = 'All' or prm.seg = (case when tt.t1 is null or r.t <= tt.t1 then 'New' when tt.t2 is null or r.t <= tt.t2 then '1'
  when tt.t3 is null or r.t <= tt.t3 then '2' when tt.t4 is null or r.t <= tt.t4 then '3' else '3+' end)))
 select p as period_start, channel,
  count(distinct uc) as req_consignors, count(distinct case when dm = 1 then uc end) as demand_consignors,
  count(distinct case when pl = 1 then uc end) as placement_consignors, count(distinct case when tr = 1 then uc end) as trip_consignors,
  count(*) as requirements, sum(dm) as demands, sum(pl) as placements, sum(tr) as trips,
  round(100.0 * sum(dm) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) as pct_dem_of_req,
  round(100.0 * sum(pl) / nullif(sum(dm), 0), 1) as pct_plc_of_dem,
  round(100.0 * sum(tr) / nullif(sum(pl), 0), 1) as pct_trip_of_plc,
  round(100.0 * sum(tr) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) as pct_trip_of_req
 from x group by 1,2 order by 1 desc, trips desc

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Ops (3132) > SL/Manifestation/LR Doc > card 51777
 
 Aliases: shipping label click RCA list; SL download raw; shipping label availability by demand.
 
 Demand-level list of PTL shipment-tracking shipping-label download clicks in the date window, enriched with booking and manifestation details and a root-cause bucket for whether a shipping label was available.
 Formula: per demand_id, clicks = SUM(total_counts) of event v1_ptl_doc_download on screen ptl_shipment_tracking whose miscellaneous doc type = 'shipping_label'; rca_bucket = first match of: 1 no demand_id on event; 2 demand not in fact_ptl_bookings; 3 is_manifested = 0; 6 SL available (shippingLabelDocCodeMap not empty/{}/null); 4a demand not in status table; 4b status row updated before the first click; else 5 SL missing.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m (event_date UTC, shifted +330 min to IST); mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings; mp_analytics_sandbox.as_vibheeshan_demand_status (metadata.shippingLabelDocCodeMap, updated_at UTC epoch microseconds); dated on click time (IST); grain demand_id (clicks without demand_id grouped as '(none)').
 Filters: start_date / end_date (IST, inclusive); blank = last 7 completed IST days (today-7 to today-1). Three hardcoded test consignor codes are excluded from the bookings join only, so their clicks fall in bucket 2. Columns: consignor, source, app_platform, transporter, demand state/sub-state, should_be_manifested, is_manifested, failure reason, LR number, placement/pickup/trip-end times, first/last click IST, clicks, click_days, status_updated_ist, sl_map.
 Caveats: Row-level list; volt returns aggregates only. Shipping-label clicks only; label availability is the current status-table state, not as of click time.
SQL:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT COALESCE([[{{start_date}}::date,]] NULL::date, DATE(GETDATE() + INTERVAL '330 minutes') - 7) AS s_day,
  COALESCE([[{{end_date}}::date,]] NULL::date, DATE(GETDATE() + INTERVAL '330 minutes') - 1) AS e_day
 ),
 clicks AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(e.demand_id, ''), '(none)') AS demand_id,
  MIN(e.event_date + INTERVAL '330 minutes') AS first_click_ist,
  MAX(e.event_date + INTERVAL '330 minutes') AS last_click_ist,
  MIN(e.event_date) AS first_click_utc,
  SUM(e.total_counts) AS clicks,
  COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.event_date + INTERVAL '330 minutes')) AS click_days
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m e
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE e.event_name = 'v1_ptl_doc_download'
  AND e.screen_name = 'ptl_shipment_tracking'
  AND split_part(split_part(e.miscellaneous, '::', 1), ':', 2) = 'shipping_label'
  AND e.event_date >= p.s_day::timestamp - INTERVAL '330 minutes'
  AND e.event_date < (p.e_day + 1)::timestamp - INTERVAL '330 minutes'
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 bk AS (
  SELECT demand_id::varchar AS demand_id, consigner_user_code, consigner_name, source, app_platform,
  transporter_name, vib_demand_state, vib_demand_sub_state, should_be_manifested, is_manifested,
  manifested_failure_reason, lr_number, placement_time, pickup_done_time, trip_end_time
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  WHERE COALESCE(consigner_user_code, '') NOT IN ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979')
 ),
 sl AS (
  SELECT demand_id::varchar AS demand_id,
  TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + (updated_at / 1000000) * INTERVAL '1 second' AS status_updated_utc,
  json_extract_path_text(metadata, 'shippingLabelDocCodeMap', true) AS sl_map
  FROM mp_analytics_sandbox.as_vibheeshan_demand_status
 )
 SELECT c.demand_id, b.consigner_user_code, b.consigner_name, b.source, b.app_platform, b.transporter_name,
  b.vib_demand_state, b.vib_demand_sub_state,
  b.should_be_manifested, b.is_manifested, b.manifested_failure_reason, b.lr_number,
  b.placement_time, b.pickup_done_time, b.trip_end_time,
  c.first_click_ist, c.last_click_ist, c.clicks, c.click_days,
  s.status_updated_utc + INTERVAL '330 minutes' AS status_updated_ist,
  s.sl_map,
  CASE WHEN c.demand_id = '(none)' THEN '1. No demand_id on event'
  WHEN b.demand_id IS NULL THEN '2. Demand not in PTL bookings'
  WHEN COALESCE(b.is_manifested, 0) = 0 THEN '3. Not manifested'
  WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(s.sl_map, ''), '{}') NOT IN ('{}', 'null') THEN '6. SL available'
  WHEN s.demand_id IS NULL THEN '4a. SL missing - not in status table'
  WHEN s.status_updated_utc < c.first_click_utc THEN '4b. SL missing - status row older than click (likely stale)'
  ELSE '5. SL missing - true gap'
  END AS rca_bucket
 FROM clicks c
 LEFT JOIN bk b ON b.demand_id = c.demand_id
 LEFT JOIN sl s ON s.demand_id = c.demand_id
 ORDER BY rca_bucket, c.clicks DESC

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Ops (3132) > SL/Manifestation/LR Doc > card 51540
 
 Aliases: manifestation rate; manifested % of eligible; should-be-manifested vs manifested; daily manifest %.
 
 Daily count of PTL placements and how many manifest-eligible placements were manifested with the transporter, by placement date.
 Formula: Manifested % of eligible = count(eligible AND is_manifested = 1) / count(eligible), where eligible = should_be_manifested = 1 AND demand source in (APP, WEB PORTAL); Manifested % of placements = the same numerator / all placements. Other columns: Placements (all placement_flag = 1), Should be manifested (flag), Manual (Odin) – not eligible, Eligible for manifest, Invoice available (eligible with non-empty material_invoice), Manifested, Not manifested, Not manifested – active (not vib_demand_status CANCELLED).
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (placement_flag = 1); demand source from the latest mp_analytics_sandbox.as_vibheeshan_demand_status row per demand (by _event_time, lsn), falling back to fact_ptl_bookings.source; dated on trunc(placement_time) (IST); grain placement day.
 Filters: start_date / end_date on placement date, default current_date - 14 to current_date inclusive (today partial). transporter: Delhivery = transporter_name DELHIVERY, every other transporter labelled DP World. consigner_type: Retention = consignor had at least one earlier demand (by demand_time) with trip_flag = 1, else New. demand_source: Consigner (APP/WEB PORTAL) or Manual (Odin) (any other source). advance_eligible: Yes when advance_eligible = 1. invoice_available: Yes when material_invoice is non-empty. Three hardcoded test consignor codes excluded.
SQL:
with b as (
  select f.*,
  coalesce(sum(coalesce(f.trip_flag,0)) over (partition by f.consigner_user_code order by f.demand_time, f.demand_id rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding),0) as prior_trips
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings f
 ),
 p as (
  select * from b
  where placement_flag = 1
  and coalesce(consigner_user_code,'') not in ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979')
  and trunc(placement_time) >= [[{{start_date}} --]] current_date - 14
  and trunc(placement_time) <= [[{{end_date}} --]] current_date
 ),
 s as (
  select demand_id, source as vsource,
  json_extract_path_text(metadata,'lrExceptionMap','reason',true) as tech_reason,
  row_number() over (partition by demand_id order by _event_time desc, lsn desc) as rk
  from mp_analytics_sandbox.as_vibheeshan_demand_status
  where demand_id in (select demand_id from p) and is_valid_json(metadata)
 ),
 x as (
  select p.*,
  s.tech_reason,
  nullif(replace(coalesce(p.manifested_failure_reason,''),'Blank trace',''),'') as analytics_message,
  case when p.transporter_name = 'DELHIVERY' then 'Delhivery' else 'DP World' end as transporter,
  case when p.prior_trips > 0 then 'Retention' else 'New' end as consigner_type,
  case when upper(coalesce(s.vsource,p.source,'')) in ('APP','WEB PORTAL') then 'Consigner' else 'Manual (Odin)' end as demand_source,
  case when coalesce(p.advance_eligible,0) = 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as advance_flag,
  case when coalesce(p.material_invoice,'') <> '' then 1 else 0 end as invoice_available,
  case when p.vib_demand_status = 'CANCELLED' then 1 else 0 end as is_cancelled
  from p left join s on s.demand_id = p.demand_id and s.rk = 1
 ),
 y as (
  select x.*,
  case when should_be_manifested = 1 and demand_source = 'Consigner' then 1 else 0 end as eligible,
  case
  when demand_source = 'Manual (Odin)' then 'Not eligible – manual (Odin)'
  when coalesce(is_manifested,0) = 1 then 'Manifested'
  when analytics_message is not null then analytics_message
  when tech_reason = 'TPT_API_ERROR' then 'TPT API 400 Bad Request'
  when tech_reason = 'INVOICE_DOC_FETCH_FAILED' then 'Invoice doc fetch failed'
  when tech_reason = 'POLL_TIMEOUT' then 'Delhivery job poll timeout'
  when tech_reason = 'INVOICE_FIELDS_INCOMPLETE' then 'Eway/HSN mandatory (invoice value)'
  when invoice_available = 0 then 'No invoice found'
  else 'Invoice present, no error logged'
  end as issue
  from x
  where 1 = 1
  [[and transporter = {{transporter}}]]
  [[and consigner_type = {{consigner_type}}]]
  [[and demand_source = {{demand_source}}]]
  [[and advance_flag = {{advance_eligible}}]]
  [[and (case when invoice_available = 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end) = {{invoice_available}}]]
 )
 select
  trunc(placement_time) as "Placement date",
  count(*) as "Placements",
  sum(case when should_be_manifested = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as "Should be manifested (flag)",
  sum(case when should_be_manifested = 1 and demand_source = 'Manual (Odin)' then 1 else 0 end) as "Manual (Odin) – not eligible",
  sum(eligible) as "Eligible for manifest",
  sum(case when eligible = 1 and invoice_available = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as "Invoice available",
  sum(case when eligible = 1 and coalesce(is_manifested,0) = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as "Manifested",
  sum(case when eligible = 1 and coalesce(is_manifested,0) = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as "Not manifested",
  sum(case when eligible = 1 and coalesce(is_manifested,0) = 0 and is_cancelled = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as "Not manifested – active",
  round(100.0 * sum(case when eligible = 1 and coalesce(is_manifested,0) = 1 then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(sum(eligible),0), 1) as "Manifested % of eligible",
  round(100.0 * sum(case when eligible = 1 and coalesce(is_manifested,0) = 1 then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(*),0), 1) as "Manifested % of placements"
 from y
 group by 1
 order by 1 desc

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Ops (3132) > SL/Manifestation/LR Doc > card 51541
 
 Aliases: manifestation failure list; not-manifested demands; manifest issue owner list.
 
 Demand-level list of PTL placements with should_be_manifested = 1, showing whether each was manifested with the transporter, the failure issue and the owning team.
 Formula: one row per placement (placement_flag = 1, should_be_manifested = 1). Issue = first match of: Not eligible – manual (Odin) (source not APP/WEB PORTAL); Manifested (is_manifested = 1); manifested_failure_reason with 'Blank trace' removed; tech reason from metadata lrExceptionMap.reason (TPT_API_ERROR, INVOICE_DOC_FETCH_FAILED, POLL_TIMEOUT, INVOICE_FIELDS_INCOMPLETE); No invoice found (empty material_invoice); else Invoice present, no error logged.  Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings; latest mp_analytics_sandbox.as_vibheeshan_demand_status row per demand (by _event_time, lsn) for source, lrExceptionMap reason and trace; dated on placement_time (IST); grain demand.
 Filters: start_date / end_date on placement date, default current_date - 14 to current_date inclusive. transporter (DELHIVERY = Delhivery, any other = DP World); consigner_type (Retention = earlier demand with trip_flag = 1, else New); demand_source (Consigner / Manual (Odin)); advance_eligible Yes/No; invoice_available Yes/No; manifested Yes/No; cancelled Yes/No (vib_demand_status CANCELLED); issue (exact issue text). Three hardcoded test consignor codes excluded.

SQL:
with b as (

 p as (

 ),
 s as (

 ),
 x as (

 ),
 y as (

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Ops (3132) > SL/Manifestation/LR Doc > card 51768
 
 Aliases: shipping label availability %; SL availability; shipping label download clicks.
 
 Daily shipping-label download clicks on the PTL shipment-tracking screen and the share of clicks on manifested demands for which a shipping label was available.
 Formula: sl_availability_pct = SUM(total_counts where demand is manifested AND shippingLabelDocCodeMap is not empty/{}/null) / SUM(total_counts where demand is manifested). Other columns: clicks (all), clicks_no_demand (event has no demand_id), clicks_not_manifested (demand_id present but not manifested), clicks_manifested_base, clicks_sl_available.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m, event v1_ptl_doc_download on screen ptl_shipment_tracking with miscellaneous doc type 'shipping_label'; manifested = any mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings row with is_manifested = 1; label availability from mp_analytics_sandbox.as_vibheeshan_demand_status metadata.shippingLabelDocCodeMap; dated on event_date + 330 min (IST day); grain IST day; unit = click events (total_counts), not demands.
 Filters: start_date / end_date (IST, inclusive); blank = last 7 completed IST days (today-7 to today-1). Three hardcoded test consignor codes are excluded from the manifested set, so their clicks count as not manifested.
 Caveats: Shipping-label clicks only; LR document clicks are not counted. Label availability is the current status-table state, not as of click time.
SQL:
-- Shipping label visibility (GALAXY/Redshift). LR removed.
 -- Dates are IST, inclusive. Blank = last 7 completed IST days.
 -- SL source: mp_analytics_sandbox.as_vibheeshan_demand_status (one row per demand; sandbox table, confirm refresh)
 WITH params AS (
  SELECT COALESCE([[{{start_date}}::date,]] NULL::date, DATE(GETDATE() + INTERVAL '330 minutes') - 7) AS s_day,
  COALESCE([[{{end_date}}::date,]] NULL::date, DATE(GETDATE() + INTERVAL '330 minutes') - 1) AS e_day
 ),
 clicks AS (
  SELECT DATE(e.event_date + INTERVAL '330 minutes') AS ist_day,
  NULLIF(e.demand_id, '') AS demand_id,
  e.total_counts
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l12m e
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE e.event_name = 'v1_ptl_doc_download'
  AND e.screen_name = 'ptl_shipment_tracking'
  AND split_part(split_part(e.miscellaneous, '::', 1), ':', 2) = 'shipping_label'
  AND e.event_date >= p.s_day::timestamp - INTERVAL '330 minutes'
  AND e.event_date < (p.e_day + 1)::timestamp - INTERVAL '330 minutes'
 ),
 manifested AS ( -- same logic as Q51540
  SELECT demand_id::varchar AS demand_id
  FROM mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings
  WHERE COALESCE(is_manifested, 0) = 1
  AND COALESCE(consigner_user_code, '') NOT IN ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979')
  GROUP BY 1
 ),
 sl AS (
  SELECT demand_id::varchar AS demand_id, metadata AS md
  FROM mp_analytics_sandbox.as_vibheeshan_demand_status
 ),
 base AS (
  SELECT c.ist_day, c.demand_id, c.total_counts,
  CASE WHEN m.demand_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_manifested,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract_path_text(s.md, 'shippingLabelDocCodeMap', true), ''), '{}')
  NOT IN ('{}', 'null') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS available
  FROM clicks c
  LEFT JOIN manifested m ON m.demand_id = c.demand_id
  LEFT JOIN sl s ON s.demand_id = c.demand_id
 )
 SELECT ist_day,
  SUM(total_counts) AS clicks,
  SUM(CASE WHEN demand_id IS NULL THEN total_counts ELSE 0 END) AS clicks_no_demand,
  SUM(CASE WHEN demand_id IS NOT NULL AND is_manifested = 0 THEN total_counts ELSE 0 END) AS clicks_not_manifested,
  SUM(is_manifested * total_counts) AS clicks_manifested_base,
  SUM(is_manifested * available * total_counts) AS clicks_sl_available,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_manifested * available * total_counts)
  / NULLIF(SUM(is_manifested * total_counts), 0), 1) AS sl_availability_pct
 FROM base
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1

Metric: Daily · PTL assignment & scheduler removal — 0-trip vs 1+ FTL-trip consignors (last 30 days)
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Ops (3132) > PTL Roll Out > card 51620
 
 Aliases: PTL daily assignment tracker; scheduler removal tracker; SHOW vs DISABLE assignment by FTL-trip band.
 
 Per IST day for the last 30 days, consignors allocated to SHOW_PTL (17) or DISABLE_PTL (18), how many the nightly scheduler flipped from 17 to 18, how many are still on 17, and app-active consignors, each split into 0-FTL-trip vs 1+ FTL-trip consignors.
 Formula: removed = variant 18 row whose updated - created > 5 min; PTL ON assigned = variant 17 rows + removed rows created that day; PTL OFF assigned = variant 18 rows not removed; % ON = ON / (ON + OFF); still live = currently variant 17; still live NON-NCR = variant 17 and the consignor's lead-source regions are all non-NCR (no region = not counted); active on app = consignors with any fact_cx_events_l3m event that day. Band: 1+ trip = first FTL trip (min demand_date with trip_flag = 1) strictly before the day; else 0-trip (incl. no trip).
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (variant_id 17/18, deleted = false; created/updated epoch microseconds, used as IST); mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (first trip, consigner_region); mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l3m (event_date cast to date); dated on allocation created date; grain day x band.
 Filters: none; fixed window today-30 to today (IST). note column marks today (partial, scheduler not yet run) and yesterday (scheduler ran 01:00 IST). Three hardcoded test consignor codes excluded from allocation counts.
 Caveats: The allocation table holds current state only, so each consignor is counted once on its created date with its current variant.
SQL:
-- PTL daily assignment & removal tracker (26 Oct 2026)
 -- Rule being checked: only 0-FTL-trip consignors get the 50/50 Show PTL (17) / Disable PTL (18) split;
 -- the 01:00 IST nightly scheduler flips non-NCR Show PTL rows to Disable PTL (17 -> 18, `updated` set, `created` kept).
 -- Removed by scheduler = config 18 row whose `updated` is > 5 min after `created` (i.e. was PTL-on, then flipped).
 -- PTL-on assigned that day = still config 17 + removed (flipped) rows created that day.
 -- FTL trip band = any FTL trip (trip_flag = 1) on a day BEFORE the assignment / app-active day.
 -- Region = fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region (NCR if any FTL demand is NCR).
 -- Active on app = any event in fact_cx_events_l3m that day. All dates IST.
 with alloc as (
  select user_code, variant_id as cfg,
  (timestamp 'epoch' + created/1000000 * interval '1 second') as a_ts,
  case when variant_id = 18 and updated - created > 300000000 then 1 else 0 end as removed
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation
  where variant_id in (17,18) and deleted = false),
 ft as (
  select consigner_user_code,
  min(case when trip_flag = 1 then demand_date end)::date as first_trip,
  max(case when consigner_region = 'NCR' then 1 when consigner_region is not null then 0 end) as any_ncr
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source
  where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 today as (select (getdate() + interval '330 minutes')::date as d),
 act_day as (
  select e.d, sum(case when f.first_trip < e.d then 0 else 1 end) as z_active, sum(case when f.first_trip < e.d then 1 else 0 end) as t_active
  from (select user_code, event_date::date as d from mp_analytics_core.fact_cx_events_l3m
  where event_date >= (getdate() + interval '330 minutes')::date - 30 group by 1,2) e
  left join ft f on f.consigner_user_code = e.user_code
  group by 1),
 al_day as (
  select a.a_ts::date as d,
  sum(case when not (f.first_trip < a.a_ts::date) or f.first_trip is null then (case when a.cfg = 17 or a.removed = 1 then 1 else 0 end) else 0 end) as z_on,
  sum(case when not (f.first_trip < a.a_ts::date) or f.first_trip is null then (case when a.cfg = 18 and a.removed = 0 then 1 else 0 end) else 0 end) as z_off,
  sum(case when not (f.first_trip < a.a_ts::date) or f.first_trip is null then a.removed else 0 end) as z_removed,
  sum(case when not (f.first_trip < a.a_ts::date) or f.first_trip is null then (case when a.cfg = 17 then 1 else 0 end) else 0 end) as z_live,
  sum(case when not (f.first_trip < a.a_ts::date) or f.first_trip is null then (case when a.cfg = 17 and f.any_ncr = 0 then 1 else 0 end) else 0 end) as z_live_nonncr,
  sum(case when f.first_trip < a.a_ts::date then (case when a.cfg = 17 or a.removed = 1 then 1 else 0 end) else 0 end) as t_on,
  sum(case when f.first_trip < a.a_ts::date then (case when a.cfg = 18 and a.removed = 0 then 1 else 0 end) else 0 end) as t_off,
  sum(case when f.first_trip < a.a_ts::date then a.removed else 0 end) as t_removed,
  sum(case when f.first_trip < a.a_ts::date then (case when a.cfg = 17 then 1 else 0 end) else 0 end) as t_live,
  sum(case when f.first_trip < a.a_ts::date then (case when a.cfg = 17 and f.any_ncr = 0 then 1 else 0 end) else 0 end) as t_live_nonncr
  from alloc a left join ft f on f.consigner_user_code = a.user_code
  where a.a_ts >= (getdate() + interval '330 minutes')::date - 30
  and a.user_code not in ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979')
  group by 1)
 select coalesce(l.d, a.d) as day_ist,
  case when coalesce(l.d, a.d) = t.d then 'Today (partial, scheduler not run)' when coalesce(l.d, a.d) = t.d - 1 then 'Yesterday (scheduler ran 01:00)' else '' end as note,
  a.z_active as "0-trip · active on app",
  l.z_on as "0-trip · PTL ON assigned",
  l.z_off as "0-trip · PTL OFF assigned",
  round(100.0 * l.z_on / nullif(l.z_on + l.z_off, 0), 1) as "0-trip · % ON",
  l.z_removed as "0-trip · removed by scheduler",
  l.z_live as "0-trip · still live",
  l.z_live_nonncr as "0-trip · still live NON-NCR (leak)",
  a.t_active as "1+ trip · active on app",
  l.t_on as "1+ trip · PTL ON assigned (BUG)",
  l.t_off as "1+ trip · PTL OFF assigned",
  l.t_removed as "1+ trip · removed by scheduler",
  l.t_live as "1+ trip · still live (BUG)",
  l.t_live_nonncr as "1+ trip · still live NON-NCR"
 from al_day l full outer join act_day a on a.d = l.d cross join today t
 where coalesce(l.d, a.d) >= t.d - 30
 order by 1 desc

Metric: Leak 2 · By region × how long PTL has been live
Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Ops (3132) > PTL Roll Out > card 51156
 
 Aliases: non-NCR PTL-live without demand by region; PTL rollout monitor by region and days live.
 
 Count of non-NCR consignors currently on SHOW_PTL (live since yesterday or earlier, IST) who have no PTL demand, by region, split by entry path and by how many days PTL has been live.
 Formula: count of consignors per region where variant 17 is live (min created, deleted = false), live date < today, all lead-source regions are non-NCR, and no demand_id in fact_ptl_bookings. Columns: total; at signup (live within 300 s of fact_leads.signup_time); not at signup (>300 s after signup); unknown signup time (no fact_leads signup); days_live = today - live date bucketed 1, 2-7, 8-30, >30. A final 'TOTAL non-NCR' row sums all regions.
 Source: mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation (created epoch microseconds, used as IST); mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source (consigner_region; region shown = max(consigner_region) across the consignor's demands); mp_analytics_core.fact_leads (signup_time, IST); mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings (any channel); dated on PTL live date; grain consignor.
 Filters: none; snapshot relative to today (IST). Consignors with no lead-source region (no FTL demand) are excluded. Three hardcoded test consignor codes excluded.
SQL:
-- PTL non-NCR rollout leak monitor (updated 15 Oct 2026)
 -- Region: fact_consigner_demands_lead_source.consigner_region (NCR if ANY FTL demand is NCR); no FTL demand -> no region -> excluded.
 -- PTL live: variant_id 17 (SHOW_PTL), deleted = false, made live YESTERDAY OR EARLIER (IST, relative to run date).
 -- No PTL demand: no demand_id in fact_ptl_bookings. Allocation `created` and fact_leads.signup_time are already IST.
 -- Entry path: 'At signup' = PTL live within 5 min of signup; 'Not at signup' = >5 min after signup; 'Unknown' = no signup_time in fact_leads.
 with live as (select user_code, min(timestamp 'epoch' + created/1000000 * interval '1 second') as live_ts
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where variant_id = 17 and deleted = false group by 1),
 reg as (select consigner_user_code, max(case when consigner_region = 'NCR' then 1 else 0 end) as any_ncr, max(consigner_region) as region
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source where consigner_user_code is not null and consigner_region is not null group by 1),
 su as (select consigner_user_code, min(signup_time::timestamp) as signup_ts
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),
 dem as (select distinct consigner_user_code from mp_analytics_core.fact_ptl_bookings where demand_id is not null),
 today as (select (getdate() + interval '330 minutes')::date as d),
 leak as (
  select v.user_code, r.region, t.d - v.live_ts::date as days_live,
  case when s.signup_ts is null then 'Unknown signup time'
  when datediff(second, s.signup_ts, v.live_ts) <= 300 then 'At signup (<=5 min)'
  else 'Not at signup (>5 min after signup)' end as entry_path
  from live v cross join today t
  join reg r on r.consigner_user_code = v.user_code and r.any_ncr = 0
  left join su s on s.consigner_user_code = v.user_code
  left join dem d on d.consigner_user_code = v.user_code
  where d.consigner_user_code is null and v.live_ts::date < t.d
  and v.user_code not in ('WE180649','WE5273773','WE6413979'))
 select region,
  count(*) as bug_total_live_1plus_days,
  count(case when entry_path like 'At signup%' then 1 end) as bug_live_at_signup_5min,
  count(case when entry_path like 'Not at signup%' then 1 end) as bug_not_live_at_signup,
  count(case when entry_path like 'Unknown%' then 1 end) as bug_unknown_signup_time,
  count(case when days_live = 1 then 1 end) as live_since_yesterday,
  count(case when days_live between 2 and 7 then 1 end) as live_2_7_days,
  count(case when days_live between 8 and 30 then 1 end) as live_8_30_days,
  count(case when days_live > 30 then 1 end) as live_30plus_days
 from leak group by 1
 union all
 select 'TOTAL non-NCR', count(*),
  count(case when entry_path like 'At signup%' then 1 end),
  count(case when entry_path like 'Not at signup%' then 1 end),
  count(case when entry_path like 'Unknown%' then 1 end),
  count(case when days_live = 1 then 1 end),
  count(case when days_live between 2 and 7 then 1 end), count(case when days_live between 8 and 30 then 1 end),
  count(case when days_live > 30 then 1 end)
 from leak
 order by 1

-- PTL non-NCR rollout leak monitor (updated 15 Oct 2026)

 -- PTL live: variant_id 17 (SHOW_PTL), deleted = false, made live YESTERDAY OR EARLIER (IST, relative to run date); last 30 days shown.
 -- No PTL demand: no demand_id in fact_ptl_bookings. Entry path threshold: 5 min from signup.
 with live as (select user_code, min(timestamp 'epoch' + created/1000000 * interval '1 second') as live_ts
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where variant_id = 17 and deleted = false group by 1),
 reg as (select consigner_user_code, max(case when consigner_region = 'NCR' then 1 else 0 end) as any_ncr
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source where consigner_user_code is not null and consigner_region is not null group by 1),
 su as (select consigner_user_code, min(signup_time::timestamp) as signup_ts
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_leads where consigner_user_code is not null group by 1),

 today as (select (getdate() + interval '330 minutes')::date as d)

  when datediff(second, s.signup_ts, v.live_ts) <= 300 then 'At signup (<=5 min)'

  count(*) as consignors

 join reg r on r.consigner_user_code = v.user_code and r.any_ncr = 0

SQL:
-- PTL non-NCR rollout leak monitor (updated 15 Oct 2026) - same logic as question 51378

 -- PTL live: variant_id 17 (SHOW_PTL), deleted = false, made live YESTERDAY OR EARLIER (IST, relative to run date).
 -- No PTL demand: no demand_id in fact_ptl_bookings. Entry path threshold: 5 min from signup.
 with live as (select user_code, min(timestamp 'epoch' + created/1000000 * interval '1 second') as live_ts
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_experiment_user_allocation where variant_id = 17 and deleted = false group by 1),
 reg as (select consigner_user_code, max(case when consigner_region = 'NCR' then 1 else 0 end) as any_ncr,
  max(consigner_region) as region, min(demand_date)::date as first_ftl_demand, max(demand_date)::date as last_ftl_demand
  from mp_analytics_core.fact_consigner_demands_lead_source where consigner_user_code is not null and consigner_region is not null group by 1),

  datediff(minute, s.signup_ts, v.live_ts) as mins_signup_to_live,

Meaning / Logic:
Dashboard: PTL Ops (3132) > PTL Roll Out > card 51794
 
 Aliases: PTL flag switch log; SHOW/DISABLE switch history per consignor; Test/Control switch type.
 
 Consignor-level history of SHOW_PTL (17) / DISABLE_PTL (18) flag states from the flow-config audit log, keeping each consignor's final state and every row where the next audit row has a different variant.
 Formula: from audit rows with flowTypeConfig.id in (17, 18), per userCode ordered by payload created: new_variant_id = LEAD(variant), switched_at = LEAD(from_unixtime(created/1000)). Rows kept when new_variant_id is null (latest row) or differs from old_variant_id. switch_type: Test (last row, 17), Control (last row, 18), Test -> Control (17 followed by 18), Control -> Test (18 followed by 17).
 Source: data_platform.vasooli_user_flow_config_audit (JSON payload: userCode, created epoch milliseconds, flowTypeConfig.id), queried on the data-platform (Trino-style SQL) database; dated on payload created via from_unixtime (UTC); grain audit row per consignor.
 Filters: none; partition dpyear = 2026 only.
 Caveats: Row-level list; volt returns aggregates only. switched_at is the payload created value of the next audit row, not a separate audit event time. Audit rows before 2026 are not read.
SQL:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
  json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.userCode') AS user_code,
  CAST(json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.created') AS BIGINT) AS created,
  CAST(json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.flowTypeConfig.id') AS BIGINT) AS variant_id
  FROM data_platform.vasooli_user_flow_config_audit
  WHERE dpyear = 2026
  AND CAST(json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.flowTypeConfig.id') AS BIGINT) IN (17, 18)
  
 ),
 alloc AS (
  SELECT
  user_code,
  variant_id,
  from_unixtime(created / 1000.0) AS created_at,
  LEAD(variant_id) OVER (PARTITION BY user_code ORDER BY created) AS switch_variant_id,
  LEAD(from_unixtime(created / 1000.0))
  OVER (PARTITION BY user_code ORDER BY created) AS switched_at
  FROM base
 )
 SELECT
  user_code,
  variant_id AS old_variant_id,
  switch_variant_id AS new_variant_id,
  created_at,
  -- COALESCE(switched_at, current_timestamp) AS 
 switched_at,
  CASE
  WHEN switch_variant_id IS NULL AND variant_id = 17 THEN 'Test'
  WHEN switch_variant_id IS NULL AND variant_id = 18 THEN 'Control'
  WHEN variant_id = 17 THEN 'Test -> Control'
  ELSE 'Control -> Test'
  END AS switch_type
 FROM alloc
 WHERE 
 switch_variant_id IS NULL
  OR switch_variant_id <> variant_id
 ORDER BY user_code, created_at
